Flood of joy o'er my soul like the
sea billows roll
Since Jesus came into my heart.

stanzas.text:
I have ceased from my wand’ring and
going astray
Since Jesus came into my heart
And my sins which were many are
all washed away
Since Jesus came into my heart.

I’m possessed of a hope that is
streadfast and sure
Since Jesus came into my heart
And no dark clouds of doubt now my
pathway obscure,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

I shall go there to dwell in that City I know
Since Jesus came into my heart
And I'm happy so happy as onward I go
Since Jesus came into my heart.
stanzas.chorus:
Since Jesus came into my heart
Since Jesus came into my heart
Flood of joy o'er my soul like the
sea billows roll
Since Jesus came into my heart.

stanzas.text:
THE Church has waited long
Hear absent Lord to see
And still in Ioneliness she waits
A friendless stranger she is
Age after age has gone
Sun after sun has set
And still, of her dear Lord bereft
She weeps, a mounder yet
Come then, Lord Jesus, come!

Saint after saint on earth
Has lived, and loved, and died
And as they left us one by one
We laid them side by side
We laid them down to sleep
But not in hope forlorn
We laid them but to slumber there
Till the last glorious morn
Come then, Lord Jesus came!

The serpent brood increase
The  pow'rs of hell grow hold
The conflict thickens, faith is low
And love is waxing cold
How long, O Lord our God
Holy, and true, and good
Wilt Thou not Judge Thy suffering Church
Her sights, her tears, and blood?
Come then, Lord Jesus, come!

We long to hear Thy voice,
To see Thee Face to Face
To share Thy crown and glory then
As now we share Thy grace
Come, Lord, and wipe away
The curse, the sin, the stain
And make this blighted world of ours
Thine own fair world again
Come then, Lord Jesus, come!

224.englishTitle: THOU art coming O! my Lord

stanzas.text:
THOU art coming O! my Lord
Thou on coming O! my King
In brightness of thy Beauty
In honour of Thy Glory.
stanzas.chorus:
Be ready, by ready
Thy Bridegroom will soon appear
In the night the blast will sound
Rise to meet the Lord of Host.

stanzas.text:
Righteous Virgins for the Lord
Ever ready for the Lord
Time of rejoicing is near
Time of oppressing over.

Surely Thou art coming Lord
By the way shall we meet Thee
By Grace Holy Communion
Shall recognise thee at once.

lts difficult for the rich
To enter in His Glory
Faith with full service to God
Will access in His Glory.

Five out of Ten Virgins called
Who by patience saw the Lord
Five by their shortage of Oil
Prove of their lack of God‘s Love.

God's vengeance is ever great
To those who lack of His Love
Rejecting shall their lot be
As goats set on the left-hand,

We beg Thee O! Our God
To be some of your elect
With Cherub Seraf Above
To reign with thee at the End.
stanzas.chorus:
Be ready, by ready
Thy Bridegroom will soon appear
In the night the blast will sound
Rise to meet the Lord of Host.

stanzas.text:
ON Jordan‘s bank the Baptist's cry
Announces that the Lord is nigh
Come then and hearken, for he brings
Glad tidings from the king of kings.

Then cleans‘d be every breast from sin,
Make straight the way for God within
Prepare we in our hearts a home
Where such a mighty Guest may come.

For thou art our Salvation, Lord,
Our refuge, and our great reward
Without thy grace we waste away
Like flow'rs that wither and decay.

Stretch forth thine hand, to heal our sore
And make us rise to fall no more
Once more upon thy people shine
And fill the world with love divine.

All praise, eternal Son, to thee
Whose advent sets thy people free
Whom with the Father we adore
And Holy Ghost for evermore.

226.englishTitle: GREAT God what do I see

stanzas.text:
GREAT God what do I see and hear
The end of things created
The judge of mankind doth appear
On clouds of glory seated
The trumpet sounds, the graves restore
The dead which they contained before
Prepare my soul to meet Him.

The dead in Christ shall first arise
At the last trumpets sounding
Caught up to meet him in the skies
With joy their Lord sur‐rounding
No gloomy fear their souls dismay
His presence shed eternal day
On those prepared to meet him.

But sinners, fi’lld with guilty fears
Behold His wrath revealing
For they shall rise and also find
Their tears and sights are unvailing
Trembling they stand before the Throne
All unprepared to meet Him.

Great God what do I see and hear
The end of things created
The Judge of mankind doth appear
On clouds of glory seated
Low at His cross I view the day
When heaven and earth shall pass away
And thus prepared to meet Him.

When Jesus comes to reward His servants
Whether it be noon or night
Faithful to Him will He find us watching
With our lamps all trimmed and bright.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh can we say we are ready Brother
Ready for the Soul's bright home
Say will He find you and me still watching
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come.

stanzas.text:
If at the dawn of the early morning
He shall call us one by one
When to Thee Lord we restore our talents
He will answer Thee "Well done"

Are we being toned to the trust He left us
Do we seek to do our best
If in our hearts there is naght condemns us
We shall have a glorious crwon.

Blessed are those whom the Lord finds
watching
In His glory they shall share
If He shall come at the dawwn or midnight
Will He find us watching there.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh can we say we are ready Brother
Ready for the Soul's bright home
Say will He find you and me still watching
Waiting, waiting when the Lord shall come.

stanzas.text:
HARK, ‘tis the watchman’s cry
Wake, brethren. wake
Jesus himself is nigh
Wake brethren, wake
Sleep is for Sons of night
Ye are children of the light
Yours is the glory bright
Wake, brethren, wake.

Call to each wakening band
Watch brethren, watch;
Clear is our Lord‘s command
Watch, brethren, watch;
Be ye as men that wait
Always at their master’s gate
Even though He tarry late
Watch brethren, watch.

Heed we the steward‘s call
Work, brethren, work
There's room enough for all
work brethren work
This Vineyard of the Lord
Constant labour will afford
He will your work reward
Work, brethren, work.

Hear we the Shepherd's Voice
Pray brethren pray
Would ye His heart rejoice
Pray, brethren pray
Sin calls for ceaseless fear
Weakness needs the strong one near
Long as ye struggle here
Pray brethren pray.

Sound now the final chord
Praise brethren, praise,
Thrice Holy is the Lord
Praise, brethren, praise,
What more befits the tongues
Soon to join the Angels' songs?
While'st heaven the note prolongs
Praise, brethren, Praise.

DAY of judgement, day of wrath
A day Jesus thine soul seek
What a great day it shall be.

Loudly shall the trumet sound
All the graves shall loose their hold
All the dead shall to life rise.

Death shall thus metamorphose
Creatures shall resurrect
Call of God, all to attend.

The books shall be opened up
Contents there-in shall be read
For by them shall all be judged.

Jesus Christ the Righteous Judge
Atone for my sins I plead
Ere the judgement day shall come.

DRAW nigh, Draw nigh, Emmanuel
And ransom captive Israel
That mourns in lonely exile be
Until the Son of God appear.
stanzas.chorus:
Rejoice rejoice Emmanuel Shall come
to thee oh Scraphim
Rejoice, rejoice Emmanuel
Shall came to thee Oh! Cherubim.

stanzas.text:
Draw nigh, O Jesse's rod, draw nigh
To free us from the enemy
From hell’s internal pit to save
And give us victory o’er the grave.

Draw nigh, Thou Day spring who shall cheer
And comfort by Thine Advent here
And banish far the brooding gloom
Of sinful night and endless doom.

Draw nigh, draw nigh, O David's key,
The heavenly gate will open to thee;
Make safe the way that leads on high
And close the path of misery.

Draw nigh, draw nigh, O Lord of might
Who to Thy tribes from Sinai‘s height
ln Ancient time did‘st give the law
In loud, and majesty. and awe.
stanzas.chorus:
Rejoice rejoice Emmanuel Shall come
to thee oh Scraphim
Rejoice, rejoice Emmanuel
Shall came to thee Oh! Cherubim.

stanzas.text:
THE great judge is coming
The dead all, shall arise
No one may try to yet escape
From the light of His face.

His holy, righteous lips
It shall condemn all those
Who turned and spurned His mercy great
And practise Wickedness.

Depart and go from me
To everlasting hell
That was for the devil prepared
Who against me rebelled.

Thou hast waited too long
The day is drawing nigh
When earth and heav‘n shall fly away
And at His coming melt.

OUR Lord doth come, the world will quake
And every mountain shall be moved
And all the stars of heaven too
Shall cease to shine nor give nor give their light.

Our Lord doth come, unlike before
When He came in humility
When He was slain the Lamb of God
Our suffering Saviour who has died.

Our Lord doth come, doth come in fear
In flamming fire and in great wrath
Coming, on Cherub wings doth fly
Coming, the great Jugde of the earth.

Is this the One who walked on earth
Just like a pilgrim on life's road
Was persecuted and oppressed,
Is this the One, He that was slain.

The wicked hid themselves in vain
Hid in the rocks and in the dens
But faith that has the victory,
Shall sing at last, "the Lord has come".

HARK! the glad sound! The Saviour comes
The Saviour promise long
Let every heart prepare a throne
And every voice a song.

He comes the prisoners to release
In Satan‘s bondage held,
The gates of brass before Him burst
The Iron fetters yield.

He comes from thickest films of voice
To clear the mental ray
And on the eye balls of the blind
To pour Celestial day.

He comes the broken heart to bind
The bleeding soul to cure
And with the treasures of his grace
Enrich the humble poor.

Our glad hossanas, Prince of peace
Thy welcome shall proclaim
And heaven‘s eternal arches ring
With Thy beloved name.

234.englishTitle: TODAY is the day of our blessing

stanzas.text:
Rejoice, all ye believers
And let your lights appear
The evening is advancing
And darker night is near
The Bridegroom is arising
As soon will he draw nigh
Up, pray and watch and wrestle
At midnight comes the cry.

See that your lamps are burning
Replenish them with oil
Look now for your Salvation
The end of earthly toil
The watchers on the Mountain
Proclaim the Bridegroom near
Go meet him, as He cometh
With Halleluyahs shout.

Ye wise and Holy virgins
Now raise your voices high
Until in songs of triumph
They meet the Angel choir
The marriage feast is waiting
The gates wide open stand
Up Up, ye heirs of glory:
The Bridegroom is at hand.

Our hope and expectation
O Jesus now appear
Arise, Thou Sun, so long'd for
O'er this benighted sphere
With hearts and hands uplifted
We plead, O Lord to see
The day of our redemption
That brings us unto thee.

Our hope and expectation
O Jesus now appear,
Thou Righteous Sun, so long'd for
O'er this benighted sphere
With hearts and hands uplifted
We plead, O Lord to see
The day of our redemption
That brings us unto thee.

O my brethren sow a good seed
At the time of our seedlings
Labour in the name of Jesus
Until He comes back again.
stanzas.chorus:
And then with joy we shall
reap the fruit
The harvester shall gather
them in barn.

stanzas.text:
The Saviour has now commanded
Us to work when It is day
O be prepared, night is coming
The farmer will soon be here.

Old and young are jointly saying
Thou art our helper O Lord
Make us to plant the seed of faith
Fruit of acceptance to reap.

The struggle for work will soon end
And its reward will soon come
If He now return in glory
He will tell us to stop.
stanzas.chorus:
And then with joy we shall
reap the fruit
The harvester shall gather
them in barn.

stanzas.text:
THAT day of wrath, that dreadful day
When heaven and earth shall pass away
What power shall be the sinner's stay?
How shall we meet the dreadful day?

When, shrivelling like a parched scroll
The flaming heavens together call
When louder yet, and yet more dreed
Swells the high trump that wakes the dead.

O! On that day, that wrathful day
When man to judgement wakes from clay
Be Thou, O Christ, the sinner away
Though heavcn and earth shall pass away.

LO! He comes with clouds descending
Once for favoured sinners slain
Thousand thousand saints attending
Swell the triumph of His train
Hallelujah!

Every eye shall now behold Him
Robbed in dreadful majesty
Those who set at nought and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing
shall the true Messiah see.

Every Island. sea. and mountain
Heaven and earth, shall flee away
All who hate Him must, confounded
Hear the trump proclaim the day;
Come to judgement!
Come to judgement! come away!

Now redemption, long expected
See in solemn pomp appear
All His saints, by men rejected
Now shall meet Him in the air
Hallelujah!
See the day of God appear.

238.englishTitle: JESUS the most high in heaven

stanzas.text:
JESUS the most high in heaven
Made the world His mighty
Thou who left Thy great majesty
That the world might be saved.

Tho humbly He came to the world
In the likeness of men
That all souls in humility
May thru the Lord be sav'd.

The angels marvell’d at His sight
At great love He bestowed
We have the priviledge of life
Which the angels have not.

Therefore rejoice thy time has come
And shout, O ye for joy
Deliverance cometh for sinners
Through Jesus Christ our Lord.

Let Thy return on earth O Lord
To us at second time
That waiting for Thee all our days
In joy, may we be found.

239.englishTitle: THE Great Judge now is come

stanzas.text:
THE Great Judge now is come, He’s come
Thus the sound of the seventh trump
The lightening and the thunders strike
How great shall be believers joy.

We hark the Angel sayeth thus
That Christ Jesus our Lord is crowned
With grace His girdle He gird on
And with glory His face is veiled.

Thou hath descendeth from Thine throne
The reigns receiveth all for Thee
Thine reigns acceptable to all
Receiveth as God conqueror.

Rejoice ye all the heav’ly host
All ye of earth below rejoice
Our Saviour Lord, glory hath earned
Shall reign for ever and evermore.

COME Thou long‐expected Jesus
Born to set Thy people free
From our fears and Sins release us,
Let us find our rest in Thee.

Israel’s strength and consolation,
Hope of all the earth Thou art
Dear Desire of every nation,
Joy of every longing heart.

Born, Thy people to deliver
Born, a child and yet a king
Born, to reign in us for ever
Now Thy gracious kingdom bring.

By Thine own eternal Spirit
Rule in all our hearts alone
By Thine all‐sufficient merit
Raise us to Thy glorious throne.

COME ye of the world, hark the word of Christ
Oh our Lord the is the world He can save
Ye soldiers of Christ, His way ye all make plain
Christ Jesus shall come to reign Over the world.

Ye of all tribes come, hark the word of Christ
Oh our Lord He is. the world He can save
Ye soldiers of Chrisi. His way ye all make plain
Christ Jesus shall come to reign over the world.

All ye the redeemed, hark the word of Christ
Oh our Lord He is, the world He can save
Ye soldiers of Christ, His way ye all make plain
Christ Jesus shall come to reign over the world.

Ye of diverse faiths, hark the word of Christ
Oh our Lord He is, the world He can save
Ye soldier of Christ His way ye all make plain
Christ Jesus shall come to reign over the world.

All ye beloved, hark the word of Christ
Oh our Lord He is, the world He can save
Ye soldier of Christ His way ye all make plain
Christ Jesus shall come to reign over the world.

242.englishTitle: OUR hearts are full of joy today

stanzas.text:
OUR hearts are full of joy today
We have found the golden way
Its light is shinning on our way
We have found the golden way
It‘s long our hearts have craved for it
In all the changing scenes of Iife
We have almost entire failed
In finding the golden way.
stanzas.chorus:
Then sing, ah, sing a song of joy
Sing from a joyful heart and shout
The light has come and we are home
We have found the golden way.

stanzas.text:
We were called from this sinful world,
We have found the golden way
Our friends and neighbours are still there
We have found the golden way
We have answered the call divine
May we ne‘er miss that heavenly place
With Jesus, we are going home
We have found the golden way.
stanzas.chorus: Then sing, ah, sing a song...

stanzas.text:
Our light afflictions are all past
We have found the golden way
The joy of home makes us forget
We have found the golden way
The storm and mist will soon be past
Our storm tossed hearts will take their rest
We set sails, our boat comes to shore
We have found the golden way.
stanzas.chorus: Then sing, ah, sing a song...

stanzas.text:
With hearts of gratitude to God
We have found the golden way
Sometime, before, we have lost it
We have found the golden way
We will soon be with the Saviour
Jesus will gladly receive us
But only by His grace alone
We have found the goldenway.
stanzas.chorus: Then sing, ah, sing a song...

stanzas.text:
We give thanks to our God on high
That we found the golden way
Give glory, praise, thanks and honour
To the father and the son
And also to the Holy Ghost
To the eternal Trinity
We shall praise Him world without end
That we found the golden way
Thanks be to thee thou Elshadai
Praise be to Jehovah Royal
Halleluyah sing songs of praise
To the blessed three in one.

A great day cometh forth
The Great Auditor shall come
All living soul shall catch the glimpse
Great trembling shall pervade the earth.

Whereforth is thy faith brethren
Thou faithless infidel
On mortal men thy faith rely
And thou rejected the Lord.

A great joy there exist
In the heart where Jesus dwells
This sinful world they rejected
And receiveth Holy Spirit.

We hail thee ministers
And salute thee all brethren
We plead that Father Almighty
Bestow blessings on us all.

WE praise Thee Father above
Thine light sent forth to earth
Divine Rays upon us shone
Darkness ever dispel
Angels rcnd sacred chorus
Glory to the new born King
In the city of David
Christ Saviour Lord He is.

All earthly dwellers chorus
Heav‘nly host join the strain
To Holy Son of David
The promised Sacred Son
Praises to Prince of Glory
Glorious crown adorneth
Blessings ordaineth the day
May we ever partake.

ln reverence He appeareth
Divine course He taught
He leadeth, us  to follow
His promise receives
Hark! Heav‘nly Host are singing
Praises to Sacred Saviour
Peace be upon earthly plain
Christ mediate for us.

Liberty for the captives
Redemption purchaseth
Freedom from sin proclaimeth
Salvation ever won
Praises, Glory and Power
Unto Father above
Glory to His Holy Son
And to the Trinity.

Cherubirn and Seraphim
Proclaim unto the world
The Kingdom of God is nigh
The world shall no more be
Christ Jesus here shall return
Not in reverence but (a) Judge
May we joyfully meet Him
Father hark to our plea.

Then to the watchful shepherds it was told.
Who heard the angelic herald's voice
Behold: I bring good tidings of a
Saviour’s birth
To you and all the nations upon earth;
This day hath God fulfilled
His promised word
This day is born a Saviour,
Christ the Lord.

He spake, and straightway the celestial choir
In hymns of joy, unknown before, conspire,
The praises of redeeming love they sang,
And heaven’s whole or with hallelujahs rang:
God's highest glory was their an them still,
Peace upon earth and unto men good will.

To Bethlehem straight the enlightened
shepherds ran
To see the wonder God had wrought for man:
Then to their flocks still praising God return,
And their glad hearts with holy rapture burn
Amazed, the wondrous tidings they proclaim
The first apostles of His infant flame.

O may we keep and ponder in our mind
God's wonderous love in saving all mankind
Trace we the Babe, who hath retrieved our loss
From the poor manger to the bitter Cross,
Tren in His steps, assisted by His grace,
Till man's first heavenly state takes place.

Then may we hope, the angels hosts amongst
To sing, redeemer. a glad Triumphal song
He that was born upon this joyful day
Around us all His glory shall distroy
Saved by His love, incessant we shall sing
Eternal praise to heaven’s Almighty King.

ANGELS from the realms of glory
Wing your flight o‘er all the earth,
Ye, who sang creation‘s story
Now proclaim Messiah's birth
Come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King.

Shepherds in the field abiding
Watching o’er your flocks by night
God with man is now residing
Yonder shines the infant light
Come and worship, come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-bom King.

Sages, leave your contemplation
Brighter visions beam afar
Seek the great Desire of nations
Ye have seen His natal star
Come and worship, come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-bom King.

Saints, before the altar bending
Watching long with hope and fear
Suddenly the Lord, descending
In His temple shall appear
Come and worship, come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-bom King.

All creation, join in praising
GOD the FATHER, SPIRIT, SON-
Evermore your voices raising
To th’Eternal three in One
Come and worship, come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King.

O come all ye faithful
Joyful and triumphant,
Come ye O come ye to Bethlehem
Come and behold Him
Born the King of angels;
O come let us adore Him x3
Christ the Lord.

True God of true God
Light of Light eternal,
Lo! He abhors not the Virgin’s womb
Son of the Father,
Begotten not created;
O come let us adore Him x3
Christ the Lord.

Sing choirs of Angels,
Sing in exultation,
Sing all ye citizens of heaven above
Glory to God In the highest;
O come let us adore Him x3
Christ the Lord.

Yea, Lord we greet Thee,
Born this happy morning;
Jesus to Thee be glory given,
Word of the Father
Now in flesh appearing;
O come let us adore Him x3
Christ the Lord.

ONCE in royal David’s city
Stood a lowly cattle shed
Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed
Mary was that Mother mild
Jesus Christ her little child.

He came down to earth from heaven
Who is God and Lord of all
And his shelter was a stable
And His cradle was a stall
With the poor, the mean and lowly
Lived on earth our Saviour Lord.

And through all His wondrous childhood
He would honour and obey
Love and watch the lowly Maiden
In whose gentle arms he lay
Christian children all must be
Mild, obedient, good as He.

For He is our Childhood's pattern
Day by day like us He grew
He was little, weak, and helpless
Tears and smiles like us He knew
He feeleth for our sadness
And shareth in our gladness.

And our eyes at last shall see Him
Through His own redeeming love
For that Child so dear and gentle
ls our Lord in heaven above
And He leads His children on
To the place where He is gone.

Not in that poor lowly stable
With the oxen standing by
We shall see Him, but in heaven
Set at God's right hand on high
Where like stars His children crowned
All in whites shall wait around.

249.englishTitle: JOY fills our most heart to day

stanzas.text:
JOY fills our most heart to day
The royal Child is born;
And Angels hosts in glad array
His Advent keep this morn.
stanzas.chorus:
Rejoice, rejoice! The incarntate Word
Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this
is heard-Emmanuel.

stanzas.text:
Low at the cradle throne we bend
We wander and adore
And feel no bliss can ours transcend,
No joy was sweet before.

For us the world must loose its charms
Before the manger shine,
When, folded in Thy mother‘s arms
We see Thee, Babe divine.

Thou Light of uncreated Light
Shine on us, Holy Child;
That we may keep Thy birthday bright
With service undefiled.
stanzas.chorus:
Rejoice, rejoice! The incarntate Word
Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this
is heard-Emmanuel.

250.englishTitle: JOY to the world the Lord is come

stanzas.text:
JOY to the world; the Lord is come
Let earth receive her King;
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And heaven and nature sing.

Joy to the world; the Saviour reigns!
Let men their Songs employ
While fields and floods, rock, hills, and plains,
Repeat the sounding joy.

No more let sins and sorrow grow
Nor thorns infest the ground
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found x2
Far as, far as the curse is found.

He rules the world With truth and grace!
And makes the actions prove
The glories of His righteousness
And wonders of His love.

OH, spread the tidings round
Wherever man is found
Wherever human hearts and human
woes abound
Let every Christian tongues proclaim
the joyful sound
The Comforter has come!
stanzas.chorus:
The Comforter has come
the comforter has come
The Holy Ghost from heaven, the
father’s promise given
Oh, spread the tidings round, wherever
man is found
The Comforter has come!

stanzas.text:
Lo, the great King of Kings,
with healing in His wings
To, every captive sound a full
deliverance brings
And through the vacant cells the songs
of triumph rings.

O boundless Love divine! how shall
this tongues of mine
To wandring mortals tell the
matchless grace divine
That I, a child of hell, should in
His image shine!

Sing, till the echoes fly above the
Vaulted sky
And all the saints above to all blow reply
In strain of endless love, the song
that ne’er will die;
stanzas.chorus:
The Comforter has come
the comforter has come
The Holy Ghost from heaven, the
father’s promise given
Oh, spread the tidings round, wherever
man is found
The Comforter has come!

stanzas.text:
HARK! the herald angels sing
Glory to the new born King
Peace on earth and mercy mild,
God and sinners reconciled
Joyful, all ye nations rise
Join the triumph of the skies
With angelic host proclaim
Christ is born in Bethlehem.
stanzas.chorus:
Hark the herald angels sing
Glory to the new born King.

stanzas.text:
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth
Born to give them second birth
Hail the heaven-born Prince of peace
Hail the Sun of righteousness
Light and life to all He brings
Risen With healing in His wings

Christ, by highest heaven adored,
Christ, the everlasting Lord
Late in time behold His come,
Offering of a Virgin's womb
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see,
Hail the incarnate Deity:
Pleased as man with men to dwell,
Jesus our Emmanuel.
stanzas.chorus:
Hark the herald angels sing
Glory to the new born King.

253.englishTitle: ALL ye Christians burst into joy

stanzas.text:
ALL ye Christians burst into joy
Great day this hath been to us
Hark as the host of Angels sing
Glorious praises unto God.
stanzas.chorus:
O! Perfect peace, O! perfect peace
Be unto all ye man kind.
O! Perfect peace, O! perfect peace
Be unto all ye man kind.

stanzas.text:
Let all who dwell on earth rejoice
And give glory unto God
His only Son He hath offered
Begotten of a virgin.
stanzas.chorus:
Wonderful Being, Wonderful Being
Is He that is born today.
Wonderful Being, Wonderful Being
Is He that is born today.

stanzas.text:
Through all the temptest and turmoil
And the wickedness on earth
In great tribulations of sin
Son of God us to redeem.
stanzas.chorus:
O! Counsellor, O! Counsellor
Oh The Royal Prince of peace.
O! Counsellor, O! Counsellor
Oh The Royal Prince of peace.

stanzas.text:
Almighty, Omnipotent God
Like a babe is born today
Everlasting Father and Being
Our Royal Ruler He is.
stanzas.chorus:
Burst into joy, burst into joy
The Son of David reigneth.
Burst into joy, burst into joy
The Son of David reigneth.

stanzas.text:
From sin He hath come to save us
Our Mediating help He is
Stronghold of satan to pull down
Our King of Glory he is.
stanzas.chorus:
Felicitate, Felicitate
From the pang of death we're saved.
Felicitate, Felicitate
From the pang of death we're saved.

254.englishTitle: THE happy day at last has dawned

stanzas.text:
THE happy day at last has dawned
Long awaited by all kindred
When the promised Saviour appears
Here on the earth in human form.

Shepherd in the fields abiding
Watching over their flocks by night
First e‘er the glad tiding were told
Glad tiding of the Saviour‘s birth.

Angels, God‘s ministering spirits
Who came in shinning white app‘rel
Brought to them the blessed message
The true, glad tidings of great joy.

A mighty dread had seized their mind
Because of this strange sight they saw;
‘Fear not' was the comforting words
That came from the angelic lips.

Christ the Saviour is born today
Yet Christ the Lord on earth is He
ln David’s city is He born
In a humble manager forlon.

‘All glory be God on high
Will be the chorus by all clime
For His tender and endless love
That to a world in need brought peace.

SI-LENT night, Ho-ly night
All is calm, all is bright
Round you Vir-gin Mother and child
Ho-ly In-fant so tender and mild
Sleep in heav-enly peace
Sleep in heav-enly peace.

Si‐lent night, holy night,
Dark-ness flee, all is light
Shepherds hear the angels sing
“Al-lelu-ia; hail the King!
Christ the Sav-iour is born
Christ the Sav-iour is born.

Si-lent night, holy night
Guide‐in Star, lend thy light
See the east-ern wise men bring
Gifts and hom-age to our King!
Christ the Sav-iour is born
Christ the Sav-iour is born.

Si-lent night, holy night,
Wondrous Star, lend thy light
With the Angels let us sing,
Al‐le-lu-ia to our King!
Christ the Sav-iour is born
Christ the Sav-iour is born.

256.englishTitle: O GOD the Rock of Ages

stanzas.text:
O GOD, the Rock of Ages
Who evermore hast been
What time the tempest rages
Our dwelling place serene
Before Thy first creations
O Lord, the same as now
To endless generations
Thou everlasting King.

Our years are like the shadows
On sunny hills that lie,
Or grasses in the meadows
That blossom but to tilt
A sleep a dream a story
By Stranger quickly told
An unremaintng glory
Of thing that soon are old.

O Thou‘ who canst not slumber
Whose light grows never pale
Teach us aright to number
Our years before they fail
On us Thy mercy lighten
On usThy spirit brighten
The hearts Thyself hast blessed.

Lord, crown our faith’s endeavour
With beauty and with grace
Till, clothed in light for ever
We see Thee face to face
A joy no language measure
A fountain brimming o‘er
And endless How of pleasures
An ocean without shore.

AFTER a few more year
After a few more times
We shall be gathered with all those
Who are slept in the tomb.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus my Lord and God
Helped me prepare for Thee,
Wash Thou me in Thy precious blood
And take my sins away.

stanzas.text:
After a few more days
Spent in this wicked world
We'll reach the land where there‘s no sun
A land of fadeless day.

After a few more storms
On this wave beaten shore
We’ll leave the stormy seas and reach
A shore that’s ever calm.

After a few troubles
After partings are done
After our sad and bitter tears
There will be no more tears.

A few more days of rest
Is all we have on earth
We shall get to a place of rest
Where it shall never end.

A few more days to wait
And He, Christ shall return
The One who died that we may live
And reign with Him for aye.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus my Lord and God
Helped me prepare for Thee,
Wash Thou me in Thy precious blood
And take my sins away.

stanzas.text:
DAYS and moments quickly flying
Speed us onward to the dead
Oh, how soon shall we be lying
Each within his narrow bed!

Jesus, merciful Redeemer
Rouse dead souls to hear Thy voice
Wake, oh wake each idle dreamer
Now to make the eternal choice.

Mark we whither we are wending
Ponder how we soon must go
To inherit bliss unending
Or eternal of woe.

Life passeth soon, death, draweth near
Keep us, Lord till Thou appear
With Thee to live with Thee to die
With Thee to reign evermore.

As a shadow life is fleeting
As a vapour so it flies
For the bygone years retreating
Pardon grant, and make us wise.

Wise that we our days may number
Strive and wrestle with our sin
Stay not in our work nor slumber
Till Thy holy rest we win.

Soon before the Judge all glorious
We with all the dead shall stand
Saviour, over death victorious
Peace us then on Thy right hand.

Life passeth soon death drawth near
Keep us, Lord till thou appear
With Thee to live with Thee to die
With Thee to reign evermore.

259.englishTitle: MY times are in Thy Hand

stanzas.text:
MY times are in Thy Hand, O Lord
My God, I wish them there
My life, My friend my soul I leave
Entirely to thy care.

My times are in Thy hand, O Lord
Whatever it may be
Passing o painful, dark or bright
As best may seem to Thee.

My times are in Thy hand, O Lord
Who should I doubt or fear?
A father’s hand will never cause
His child a needless tears.

My times are in Thy hand, O Lord
Jesus is crucified
The hand my cruel sins had pierced
ls now my guard and guide.

My times are in Thy hand, O Lord
I’ll always trust in Thee,
And after death at Thy right hand
I shall forever be.

BLOW ye the trumpet blow
The gladly solemn sound
Let all the nations know
To earth‘s remotest bound.
stanzas.chorus:
The year of jubilee is come
Return ye ransom'd
sinners home.

stanzas.text:
Extol the Lamb of God
The all-atoning Lamb
Redemption by His blood
Throughout the world proclaim.

Ye who have sold for nought
Your heritage above
Receive it back unbought
The gift of Jesus’s Love.

Jesus our great High Priest,
Hath full atonement made:
Ye weary spirits, rest:
Ye mournful souls, be glad

Hearts that are weary, come
Rest on the Saviour's breast
Disconsolate heart, come
Be cheerful and rejoice.
stanzas.chorus:
The year of jubilee is come
Return ye ransom'd
sinners home.

stanzas.text:
LET all shrines of satanic worships
And pagan altars on the earth
Be convened to Church of Jesus
Sincere plea of the Seraphim.
stanzas.chorus:
Redeem us oh Lord to be Thine
Thine from now and ever more
Sake of Christ Jesus Son of Father
Spare us all in the Seraphim.

stanzas.text:
May all shrines of ancestral worships
Of thunder, lightning. lesser gods
Be coonverted to Church of Jesus
Sincere plea of the Seraphirn.

May all the altars of the devil
And satanic worships on earth
Be convened to Church of Jesus
Sincere plea of the Seraphim.

May all altars of idol worships
Of river goddess and the stars
Be converted to Church of Jesus
Sincere plea of the Seraphim.

Let all the priest the Kings and elders
In all countries of the world
Accept to serve the King of Glory
Amidst the Band of Seraphim.

May all the shrines of idol worships
Of masquerades and galaxies
Be converted to Church of Jesus
Sincere plea of the Seraphim.

Pagans. infidels be converted
The barbaric and all the crude
Come, bow in worship of Christ Jesus
Sincere plea of the Seraphim.

May all worshippers of effigies
In all shrines and groves on earth
Come, bow in worship of Christ Jesus
Sincere plea of the Cherubim.

Members of the Band of Seraphim
And all ye of the Cherubim
Come, bow in worship of Christ Jesus
Sincere plea of the Cherubim.

Members of the earthly Choristers
And the Band of the Prayerists
Members of the Elders in Council
Thine cross bear with thy girdle tied.

Our Praying Father Son of Jesus
God be with you forever more
Your works will for ever progressing
And Crown of Glory will be yours.

Glory give unto Father above
Glory give unto Holy Son
Glory give unto Holy Spirit
To the Trinity, praises due.
stanzas.chorus:
Redeem us oh Lord to be Thine
Thine from now and ever more
Sake of Christ Jesus Son of Father
Spare us all in the Seraphim.

stanzas.text:
SMILE on the beautiful Morning Star
From celestial above
Reveal the love the Father have
In bright and lovely smile.
stanzas.chorus:
Shine on, Shine on
Shine on, Shine on
Oh beautifitl beautiful Star.

stanzas.text:
Smile on the Glorious Morning Star
Our eyes are up to thee
On the Celestial throne of God
We view thy glorious glide.

Beautiful Star of promise
Shining when waves are dark
Into its long-sought heaven
Guiding the lonely bark.

Beautiful Cherubim Seraph Star
Guide with thy Brightening Power
Till joyful light encompassed
With everlasting glee.

And when the last blast given
To home the call is made
With you ever rejoicing
And shine forever more.
stanzas.chorus:
Shine on, Shine on
Shine on, Shine on
Oh beautifitl beautiful Star.

stanzas.text:
JESUS the highest name on earth
And heaven the throne above
The Angels ever kneel for Him
While Satan tears and flee.
stanzas.chorus:
There is no longer argument
No other railing now
Surely Christ died for you and me
For all the sinful soul.

stanzas.text:
Cherubim Seraphim above
Surround the Father's throne
Always in His presence above
Singing the songs of praise.

Christ Saviour, cruel death He o'ercame
Find Satan‘s kingdom fall
All creatures now hurst forth with joy
The Father glorify.

Cherubim and ye Seruphim
Let there be love within
The, Angelic Hosts all in love
Worship Father above.

Jesus the Captain of our Band
Bless us on earth below
May we not lack nor be in want
Now and through all our lives.

Jehovah Jireh God our King
Praises be to thy name
Let not the Wicked of this world
Harm us throughout our life.

Jesus has broken Satan's strength
Thou art the glorious King
Praises and thanks to Father be
And to The Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
There is no longer argument
No other railing now
Surely Christ died for you and me
For all the sinful soul.

stanzas.text:
THE New year arrives, we rejoice,
We should rejoice and be joyful,
Cherubim Seraphim,
Will never forget the past year
May this year bring good things to us
Look gay in the New Year.

Members of Cherub Seraphim
Be truthful throughout all your lives;
Be steadfast in prayers,
Do not follow evil people
Be loyal to all your elders
Look gay in the New Year.

Ye, praying Band of this Order,
Remember all the Visions seen
Be good in your dealings
Join together in fervent prayers,
Let unity reign in your midst,
Look gay in The New Year.

Those who believe not God's vision,
Likened to unyielding Pagan
Who know not what is good
Ask Jenny Winful to relay
Ere she delivered her new babe
Look gay in the New Year.

Leave all members of division
To love and help our neighbours all
In the New year we are,
Let us refrain from backbiting
Casting away all quarreling
Look gay in the New Year.

In the New Year we ushered in
The barren shall have new children
Mothers shall be blessed more
The debtors shall pay all be relieved
Witches and Wizards shall have no power,
Look gay in the New Year.

In messy state our nation be
Pestilence and sickness abound,
Divine healing we plead
By lasting and constant prayers,
May we abide in love and peace
Look gay in the New Year.

None to purchase and none to sell
None in charity all to share
Money is nought to spend
Chastisement of the Lord it be
Remorsefully shall we repent
Look gay in the New Year.

When the end of the world shall come
Father, son may not recognise
Oh! Lord, remember me
To hear the gentle voice from Thee,
“Come all ye faithful good servants,
And receive glorious crowns.

MARVELLOUS grace of our loving Lord
Grace that exceeds our sin and our guilt!
Yonder on Calvary’s mount out poured
There where the blood of the Lamb was spilt.
stanzas.chorus:
Grace, grace
Grace that will pardon and cleanse
within Grace, grace, God's grace
Grace that is greater than all our sin!

stanzas.text:
Sin and despair, like the sea waves cold
Threaten the soul with infinite loss
Grace that is greatest yes, grace untold
Points to the Refuge the mighty cross.

Dark is the stain that we cannot hide
What can avail to wash it away?
Look! there is flowing a crim-son tide
Whiter than snow you may be today.

Marvellous, infinite, matchless grace
Freely stowed on all who believed?
You are longing to see His Face
Will you this moment Hisgrace receive.

267.englishTitle: WE bid thee merry happy year

stanzas.text:
WE bid thee merry happy year
We rejoice with thee at this new year
Let‘s offer thanks unto the Lord
For keeping our souls till today.

Host of the young and of the old
Long in expectation of this day
Many/hath passed to the great beyond
En-ve-loped with earth down below.

Band of restoration, elders
Hail thee for restoring the Band
Father above abide with thee
Thou shall fulfil thy call unend.

We bid mayor happy new year
Hail thee all the subordinates
We/hail thee for keeping the state
May the Lord beof help to thee.

Be not afrightened believers!
Jesus shall provide all thine needs
The/barren wombs shall now be blessed
The maternal ones shall he saved.

After the life coal shall be ashes
Bannana tree shall re-incarnate
We/know and we are rest assured
Our children shall live after us.

We greet thee all our well wishers
And ye all our dearly beloved
Jesus/shall keep thee and all thine
He shall bestow blessings on thee.

We bid thee all happy new year
This new and happy blessed year
May/Divine God our souls preserve
That we may withness many more.

268.englishTitle: O Lord my God Thou art my hope

stanzas.text:
O Lord my God Thou art my hope
Thy word is food to me
Thy hand raised me from infancy
And through my childhood days.

And yet I tell the wondrous news
Of Thy care, year to year,
I leave the last remaining days
Under Thy watchful care.

BeThou my guide when strength
shall fail
And when my hairs turn grey
Let Thy great glory shine around
When it’s my time to die.

269.englishTitle: O GOD our help in ages past

stanzas.text:
O GOD, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy blast,
And our eternal home.

Under the shadow of thy throne
Thy saints have dwelt secure:
Sufficient is thine arm alone,
And our defense is sure.

Before the hills in order stood,
Or earth received her frame,
From everlasting Thou art God,
To endless years the same.

Time, like an ever-rolling stream,
Bears all its sons away;
They fly forgotten, as a dream
Dies at the opening day.

A thousand ages in thy sight
Are like an evening gone;
Short as the watch that ends the night
Before the rising sun.

ANOTHER year is dawning
Dear Father, let it be
In working or in waiting
Another year with Thee
Another year of progress
Another year of praise
Another year of proving
Thy presence all the days.

Another year of mercies
Of faithfulness and grace
Another year of gladncss
The glory of Thy face
Another year of learning
Upon Thy loving breast
Another year of trusting
Of quiet, happy rest.

Another year of service
Of witness for Thy love
Another year of training
For holier work above
Another year is dawning
Dear Father, let it be
On earth, or else in heaven
Another year for Thee.

ANOTHER year has rolled by
The time flies so quickly by,
This year which is to pass by
May be the last year for some
It's Thy mercy kept us through
Have we been benefited?
We should ask, are we prepared
If we are called home this year?

This world is a battle ground
Thousands are falling down dead
The arrows of death that fly
Can be sent to me, to you
When the word is preached, we hear
Help our hearts to meditate
Eternity's close at hand
We are standing on the brink.

If we are saved from our sins
By the grace of God divine
We shall hear Him say, “Come home"
May we see His face in heav’n;
For Thy people here on earth
Grant us mercy this new year
The year that‘s more full of joy
Is the one that sees them home.

272.englishTitle: A day of joy thanksgiving day

stanzas.text:
A day of joy thanksgiving day
All ye Angels here rejoice with us
For this great joy God sent to us
Amidst the Seraphim here below.
stanzas.chorus:
Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
Raise up your voice, all ye Seraph
Rejoice with us rejoice with us
Sing praises to Holy Trinity.

stanzas.text:
Our souls give praises to the King
Our hearts rejoice to our Father
God For great mercy bestowed on us
Lest enemies could have mocked at us.

All ye Angels rejoice with us
All ye who dwell face to face with God
The sun, the moon, come worship Him
And all the world come and hallow Him.

His strength He has shown to the world
As He has shown to our fore-fathers
He leads us quietly to Him
And saves us from all our enemies.

The strong He overthrown for us
And on His throne he has raised the meek
Who shall we praise like unto Thee
Praise Him Praise Him
All the World praise Him.

We thank Thee oh our Father God
For thy mercy on the Seraphim
Praise Him Praise Him
All His creatures
All ye Heavens hallowed ye Jesus.
stanzas.chorus:
Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
Raise up your voice, all ye Seraph
Rejoice with us rejoice with us
Sing praises to Holy Trinity.

stanzas.text:
ALMIGHTY God grant that Thy praise
All our voices employ
Thy hand has made the days go by
Another year has come.

Our sacrifice rise to Thee Lord
Father of all goodness
For Thy mercy, from year to year
That flows from Thy bosom.

In all the changing scenes of life
May Thy mercy endure
As much as Thy goodness to us
So let our praises be.

In all the changing scenes of life
We feel Thy anxious care
Let that same mercy, Lord we plead
Bless the year new begun.

And if Thou gives joy, may the same
Draw us closer to Thee
And if suffering, then we shall sing
As long as Thou bless us.

STANDING at the portal of the op'ning year
Words of comfort meet us hushing ev’ry fear
Spoken through the silence by our
Father's voice
Tender, strong, and faithful making us rejoice.
stanzas.chorus:
Onward, then and fear not
Children of the day!
For His Word shall never
Never pass away!

stanzas.text:
l, the Lord, am with thee be thou not afraid
I will help and strengthen be
thou not dismayed!
Yea, I will uphold thee with
My own right hand
Thou art called and chosen
In my sight to stand.

For the year before us O
what rich supplies.
For the poor and needy
Living streams shall rise
For the sad and sinful shall
His grace abound
For the faint and feeble
Perfect strength be found.

He will never fail us
He will not forsake
His eternal covenant He will
never break
Resting on His promises what
have we to fear
God is all sufficient for the
coming year.
stanzas.chorus:
Onward, then and fear not
Children of the day!
For His Word shall never
Never pass away!

275.englishTitle: ALMIGHTY Thou God of our peace

stanzas.text:
ALMIGHTY, Thou God of our peace
Decreed that the year roll by
Thy children have come to thank Thee
For the new year just begun
Praise ye the Lord, praise ye the Lord
The great king who spared our lives.

We thank Thee for our protection
In the year that is far spent
We implore Thee for Thy help, Lord
For all of us this new year
Let Thy flock here, let Thy flock here
Keep growing in Jesus Christ.

May the adult themselves prepare
Thee to serve in one accord
May the sibblings too be ready
Thee to Seek with heart so pure
May the Lord's peace, may the Lord’s peace
Be the crown of this new year.

May the Holy Ghost from on high
Come upon us, this new year
May the pastor and the teacher
And all the congregation
Prepare themselves, prepare
themselves
To do service for the Lord.

ANOTHER year is dawning
A path unknown, untried
He would fill me with foreboding
Had I no hand to guide
But He who walked beside me
All through the yester year
Whatever may betide me
He’s promised to be near.

Another year with Jesus
Ah, then, no dread I know
His love is ever precious
Howe‘er the winds may blow
E‘en when the storm is fiercest,
In Him my soul may rest
And find sweet peace and comfort
In Thy bossom we plead.

Another year to trust Him
Yes, I can trust Him still
Who never yet has failed me
As I have sought His will
His rod and staff He giveth
To be my strength and stay
And tenderly He leadeth
Along the homeward way.

Another year to serve Him
To labour for Him here
E‘en while the shadows lengthen
And night is drawing near
I know not when He’ll call me
To lay my sickle by
Oh, may I then be faithful
While now the moments fly!

Another year to love Him
Whom I have loved so long
Another year to praise Him
In glad triumphant song
Whate‘er the future holdest
Of sorrow, toil, or pain
His precious Love-enduret
Forevermore the same.

Another year with Jesus
I thank Thee, Lord, today
For Thy unfailing presence
Along life's rugged way
Guide me, O blest Redeemer,
Teach me to do Thy will
And Thine own perfect purpose
In me each day fulfil.

ALL we the belieivers
Who still in sin abide
Let‘s offer thanks to God
For keeping us till now.
stanzas.chorus:
Be-lo-ved brothers and sisters
We bid they all happy new year
We bid, we bid thee all happy
new year.

stanzas.text:
Christ Jesus our dear Lord
Holy Ghost is our guard
Fainting souls shall revive
And the sick shall be healed.

Divine King, Trinity
Holy Tripartite God
All creatures reverence Thee
Above and here below.

The recent year gone bye
In memory ever be
A host of men on earth
Struck dead by diseases.

So much are unemployed
Wares rakes in less profit
Many have migrated
For lot of unpaid debts.

Our Jehovah, Jireh
Shall preserve us this year
Our Jehovah Nissi
Hath made way for His own.

We habour no more fear
Since God is all for us
Amen, Amen, the seal
Assuringly be it.
stanzas.chorus:
Be-lo-ved brothers and sisters
We bid they all happy new year
We bid, we bid thee all happy
new year.

stanzas.text:
O GOD of Bethel, by whose hand
Thy people still are fed,
Who through this weary pilgrimage
Ha stall our fathers led.

Our vows, our prayer, we now present
Before thy throne of grace;
God of our fathers, be the God
Of their succeed in grace.

Through each perplexing path of life
Our wandering footsteps guide:
Give us each day our daily bread,
And raiment fit provide.

O spread thy covering wings around,
Till all our wandering cease
And at our father‘s loved abode
Our souls arrive in peace.

Such blessings from thy gracious hand
Our humble prayers implore
And thou shalt be our chosen God
And portionevermore.

HOW perfect be their feet
Who in Zion doth wail
Who gospel of salvation brought
Who revealeth their joy.

How pleasant be their voice
How pleasant be the news
Zion behold thy God thine King
As He hath conquered here.

How great our ears rejoice
Hearing the words of joy
The Prophet and, King waiting on
They sought but found Him not.

How great our eyes rejoice
That hath seen light divine
The Prophet and King they hath sought
They passed on, Him not found.

Reveal Thine strength oh Lord
Over, above the earth
Let all the nations of the world
Look unto God.their King.

280.englishTitle: O Lord God of our salvation

stanzas.text:
O Lord, God of our salvation
Our guide, our leader and our might
Has brought us together tonight,
Let us lift our Ebenezer
The old year that we have gone through
Has the Lord crowned with His goodness
Each morning, new is Thy mercy
Let our appreciation increase.

Jesus who sits upon the Throne
We raise Helleluyah to Thee
Because of Thee and Thee alone
We have been spared to come and sing
Help us to have contrition for
The many sins of the past year
Help us to spend this coming year
To praise Thee more than
the past year.

281.englishTitle: I HAVE found a joy in sorrow

stanzas.text:
I‘ve found a joy in sorrow
A secret balm for pain
A beautiful to-morrow
Of sunshine after rain I've
Near every bitter spring.
stanzas.chorus:
A Whispered promise stealing
O’er every broken string,
A Whispered promise stealing
O’er every broken string.

stanzas.text:
I’ve found a glad hosannah
For every woe and trial
A handful of wee: manna
When desert wells are dry.

An Elim with its coolness
lts fountain and its shade
A blessing in its fullness
When buds of promise fade
O’er tear of soft contrition
I’v seen a rainbow light.

My Saviour, Thee possessing
l have the joy, the balm
The healing and the blessing
The sunshine and the Psalm
The promise for the fearful
The Elim for the faint.
stanzas.chorus:
A Whispered promise stealing
O’er every broken string,
A Whispered promise stealing
O’er every broken string.

stanzas.text:
FOUR scores, ten and nine tenderly lie
In the cool shadow of the Lord
But one went astray on the mountain wild
Farther from the golden plain
Farther from the fold to the mountain wild
Farther, away from sacred shepherd Christ.

Four scores, ten and nine thine portion here
Jesus, Thy desire fulfilled?
Christ Jesus Shepherd flash a response thus
All hath wander'd far from Me
Dreary ever though the way all may be
To the dreadful wilderness there I'll go
In Search of the meek sheep gone astray.

One of all the lot Redeemed of the Lord
Dept of the sea yet unknown
And dreary the night wadeth
through by Christ
The sheep alas recov’reth
Afar in the deep, her voice He hark
Weary, fainting, naught and sapped of life.

Whenceforth is the flow the drooping blood
Our path, led to sacred mount
Shed blood of the Lamb for lost wand’ring souls
Of Christ Jesus recov‘reth
Jesus! what piercing mark found on thy palms?
By multitude of thorns, my palms pirereed.

But over the hills and mountain tops'
Great roarings from heaven above
Sounding! Earth rejoice with heavenly hosts
“Sheep gone astray now is found of God
Sounds Angelic trumps above
Rejoice! sheep gone astray, Jesus
hath found.

283.englishTitle: LORD in this Thy mercy‘s day

stanzas.text:
LORD, in this Thy mercy‘s day
Ere the time shall pass an away
On our Kneels we fall and pray.

Holy Jesus grant us tears
Fill us with heart-searching fears
Ere the hour of doom appears.

Lord, on us Thy Spirit pour
Kneeling lowly at Thy door
Ete it close for evermore.

By Thy night of agony
By Thy supplicating cry
By Thy willingness to die.

By Thy tears bitter woe
For Jerusalem below
Let us not Thy love forego.

Judge and Saviour of our race
When we see Thee face to face
Grant us near Thy wings a place.

On Thy love we test alone
And that love will then be known
By the pardon round Thy throne.

UNCLEAN and full of sin
Am I, O Lord my God
I dare not venture near to Thee
I and my load of sin.

This heavy load of sin
Doth crush my evil heart
And how far more wicked it looks
Before Thy Holy face.

Must I be left to die?
And that despairingly?
There is joy in Thy atonement
For poor sinner like me.

Thy blood which Thou has shed
Which is Thy boundless grace
Can wash the vilest sinner clean
Can melt the heart of stone.

I fall down at Thy feet
Do, pardon and forgive
And here at Thy feet will remain
Until Thou sayest. “Arise”

JESUS my strength, my hope
On Thee I cast my care
With humble confidence look up
And know Thou hear'st my prayer
Give me on Thee to wait
TillI can all things do
On Thee, Almighty to create
Almighty to renew.

I want a godly fear
A quick-discerning eye
That looks to Thee when sin is near
And sees the tempter fly
A spirit still prepared
And armed with jealous care
For ever standing on its guard
And watching unto prayer.

I want a true regard
A single, steady aim
Unmoved by threatening or reward
To Thee and Thy great name
A jealous just concern
For Thine immortal praise
A pure desire that all may learn
And glorify Thy grace.

I rest upon Thy word
The promise is for me
My succour and salvation Lord
Shall surely come from Thee
But let me still abide
Nor from my hope remove
Till Thou my patient spirit guide
Into Thy perfect love.

REVIVE Thy works Oh Lord,
Thy mighty arm make bare
Speak with the voice that wakes
the dead
And make Thy people hear.

Revive Thy work, Oh LORD
Disturb this sleep of death
Quicken the smouldering
embers now
By Thine almighty breath.

Revive Thy work Oh Lord
Create soul-thirst for Thee
An hungering for the bread of life,
Oh may our Spirit be.

Revive Thy work, Oh Lord
Exalt Thy precious name
And by the Holy, Ghost, our love
For Thee and Thine inflame.

Revive Thy works, Oh Lord
And give refreshing showers
The Glory shall be all Thine own
Thy blessings, Lord be ours.

AT thou wary art thou lanquid
A! thou sore distress’d?
"Come to me" saith
The Holy one and “be at rest"

Hath He marks to lead me to Him
If he be my guide?
In His feet and hands are
wound prints
And His side.

Is there diadem, as monarch,
That His brow adorns?
“Yea, a crown in very surety
But of Thorns.

If I find Him, If I follow
What His guerdon here?
Many a sorrow many a labour
Many a tear.

If I still hold closely to Him
What have he at last?
Sorrow vanquish'd labour ended
Jordan pass.

If I ask Him to receive me
Will He say me nay?
Not till earth, and till heaven
Pass away.

Finding following keeping struggling
Is He sure to bless?
Saints, Apostles Prophets
Martyrs answer, Yes.

CHRIST for sinners doth weep
Shall our eyes of drought be
May the tears of thought and remorse
Gosh all out of our eyes.

Son of God weeping on
Oh Angels Him behold
Be troubleth oh thou my soul
His tears He shed for thee.

He wept that we may weep
Our sins demand our tears
Heaven above lone naught of sin
There, no weeping is found.

O LORD, turn not away thy face
From him that lies prostrate
Lamenting sore his sinful life
Before thy mercy-throne.

Which gate thou open’st wide to those
That do lament their sin
Shut not that gate against me,
Lord But let me enter in.

And call me not to mine account
How I have lived here
For then I know right well O Lord
How vile I shall appear.

So come I to thy mercy-gate
Where mercy doth abound
Requiring mercy for my sin
To heal my deadly wound.

Mercy, good Lord, mercy I ask
This is the total sum
For mercy, Lord is all my suit Lord,
let thy mercy come.

APPROACH, my soul, the mercy seat,
Where Jesus answers prayer;
There humbly fall before His feet,
For none can perish there.

Thy promise is my only plea,
With this I venture nigh
Thou callest burden'd souls to Thee,
And such, O Lord, am I.

Bow'd down beneath a load of sin,
By Satan sorely press‘d
By war without and fears within,
I come to Thee for rest.

Be Thou my shield and hiding-place,
That, shelter'd near Thy side,
I may my fierce accuser face,
Add tell him, Thou hast died.

Oh wondrous love, to bleed and die,
To bear the cross and shame
That guilty sinners, such as I
Might plead Thy gracious name.

Goodness l have none to plead,
Sinfulness in all I see,
I can only bring my need:
God be merciful to me.

Broken heart and downcast eyes
Dare not lift themselves to Thee;
Yet Thou canst interpret signs:
God be merciful to me.

From this sinful heart of mine
To Thy bosom I would flee:
I am not my own but Thine:
God be merciful to me.

There is one beside the throne,
And my only hope and plea
Are in Him, and Him alone;
God be merciful to me.

He my cause will undertake,
My Interpreter will be,
He’s my all; and for his sake
God be merciful to me.

FAR from my heavenly home,
Far from my Father's breast,
Fainting I cry blest Spirit, come
And speed me to my test.

Upon the willows long
My harp has silent hung
How should I sing a cheerful song,
Till Thou inspire my tongue?

My spirit homeward turns,
And fain would thither flee:
My heart, O Zion, droops and yearns
When I remember thee.

To thee, to thee I press,
A dark and toilsome road:
When shall I pass the wilderness,
And reach the saints’ abode?

God of my life be near:
On Thee my hopes I cast
Oh guide me through the desert here
And bring me home at last.

293.englishTitle: WHEN in Zion they tarry still

stanzas.text:
WHEN in Zion they tarry still
Oh multitude of host
I contemplate the Saviour saith
Shall thou me too forsake.

l and this sort of feeble heart
Unless me Thou uphold
Oft of my will I may decline
Like them I thus shall be.

Thine is the strength and this I know
Wretched of earth to save
Unto whom else will hence I go
If Thou I Will reject.

I know and re-assuringly
Thou and Thou art the Christ
Thou art the custodian of life
Purchaseth by Thine blood.

Thine Holy voice offers me rest
And thus dismiss my fears
Thine love, joy shall offer my soul
And that’s enough for me.

Oh what a pain this query brought
Wilt thou from me depart
Oh Lord with all my trust in Thee
I replied to Thee "nay.“

JESUS Christ make me hear Thy voice
Speak me all word of peace
And all my strength shall be employed
In praise of Thy goodness.

In Thy mercy, call me Thy child
Forgive me all my sins
And then, Thy voice will sound so sweet
Like heaven’s harmony.

Where ever Thou wants me to go
I'll gladly follow Thee
And gladly will I fellowship
With those who are asleep.

When this burden of sin is gone
No other load remains
The hand that scattered forgiveness
Will give the crown of life.

295.englishTitle: Oh Gladly we behold the grace

stanzas.text:
OH! Gladly we behold the grace
Of Christ our Great High Priest
His heart is filled with compassion
And rejoiceth for love.

Passionately us He bemoans
Our weakness all He knows
Of temptations also He knows
For of same He partook.

He also while sojourning here
Bitterly thus He wept
With everyone He also share
Of all our grief and pain.

Humbly with faith let us all seek
His compassion and strength
Salvation we shall all receive
When trouble shall erupt.

LORD Jesus, think on me
And purge away my sin
From earth born passions set me free
And make me pure within.

Lord Jesus, think on me
With many a care oppressed
Let me Thy loving servant be,
And taste Thy promised rest.

Lord Jesus, think on me
Nor let me go astray
Through darkness and perplexity
Point Thou the heavenly way.

Lord Jesus, think on me
That, when the gloom is past
I may eternal brightness see
And share Thy joy at last.

Lord Jesus, think on me
That I may sing above
To Father, Holy Ghost, and Thee
The song of praise and love.

WHEN at Thy footstool Lord I bend
And plead with Thee for mercy there,
Think of the sinner‘s dying friend,
And for His sake receive my prayer.

Oh think not of my shame and guilt
My thousand stains of deepest dye
Think of the blood, which Jesus spilt
My pardon and my life to buy.

Think, Lord, how I am still thine own
The trembling creature of thy hand,
Think how my heart to sin is prone
And what temptations round me stand.

Oh think upon thy holy word
And every plighted promise there,
How prayer should evermore be heard
And how thy Glory is to spare.

Oh think not of my doubts and fears
My strivings with Thy grace divine;
Think upon Jesus‘ woes and tears
And let His merits stand for mine.

Thine eye, Thine car, they are not dull
Thine arm can never shorten’d be,
Behold me here; my heart is full
Behold, and spare, and succour me.

O Lord my God, hear my complaint
O listen to my secret prayers
To Thee alone, O Lord my King
Will I retire to seek for aid.

In the morning, Thou’ll hear my prayer
Quite early, I’ll rise with the dawn
I will lift up my eyes to Thee
MY supplications I’ll present.

But when Thy grace shall bring me o‘er
To Thy celestial courts above
Unto Thee will I set my face
And worship Thee in humhleness

Let those who have their trust in Thee
With great acclaim declare their joy
Let those whom Thou keepest rejoice
E’en those who love Thy holy name.

Unto the righteous, God didst stretch
His hands to scatter blessings free
Thy favour shall Thy people own
As their great shield and protection.

299.englishTitle: O Lord turn not Thy face

stanzas.text:
O Lord, turn not Thy face from me,
Who lie in woeful state,
Lamenting all my sinful life
Before Thy mercy-gate.

A gate which open wide to those
That do lament their sin;
Shut not that gate against me,
Lord But let me enter in.

I need n o t to confess my life
To Thee, who best can tell
What I have been; and what I am,
I know Thou knows it well.

So come I to Thy mercy-gate,
When mercy doth abound
lmploring pardon for my sin,
Tohealmydeadlywound.

OLord, I need not to repeat
The comfort I would have;
Thou know’st, O Lord, before I ask
The blessing I do crave.

Mercy, good Lord, mercy I ask;
This is the total sum:
For mercy, Lord is all my suit,
Lord, let Thy mercy come.

300.englishTitle: BE Thou with me to where I go

stanzas.text:
BE Thou with me to where I go
Teach Thou me what I ought to do
Listen to my word of complaint
And guide my feet into Thy paths.

Grant me abundance of Thy love,
Be my protection ever more,
Put Thou Thy zeal within my heart
And let Thy spirit be with me.

Do, teach me, dear Lord, how to pray
Help me to believe Thee wholly
That I might hate things Thou hatest
And love those things which
Thou lovest.

O Saviour, like the publican
I lift my heart to Thee
ln Thy mercy and in Thy grace
Be merciful to me.

I smite, O Lord, my eager heart
lt‘s broken and in tears
Lord, deliver my aching heart
And have mercy on me.

In shame, I confess all my sins
Grant me, Thy hope, O Lord
I plead because of Jesus' blood
Be merciful to me.

I am the chiefest of sinners
Plentiful are my sins
Because of the death of Jesus
Come, have mercy on me.

Beneath the cross of Christ I stand
It's shadow, my delight
And God whose mercy is boundless
Has had mercy on me.

JUST as l am-without one plea
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bid‘st me come to Thee
O Lamb of God, I come.

Just as I am-and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark spot,
To Thee, whose blood can cleanse each spot
O Lamb of God, I come.

Just as I am-though toss’d about
With many a conflict, many adoubt,
Fighting's and fears within, without
O Lamb of God, I come.

Just as I am‐poor, wretched blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind
Yea, all I need, in Thee to find
O Lamb of God, I come

Just as I am-Thou wilt receive,
Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve,
Because Thy promise I believe
O Lamb of God, I come.

Just as I am-Thy love unknown
Has broken every barrier down;
Now, to beThine, yea, Thine alone
O Lamb of God, I come.

Just as l am-of that free love
The breath, length, depth and height to prove,
Here for a season, then above
O Lamb of God, I come.

IN the hour of trial
Jesus pray for me
Lest by base denial
I depart from Thee
When Thou see'st me waver,
With a look recall
Nor for fear or favour
Suffer me to fall.

With its Witching pleasures
Would this vain world charm,
Or its sordid treasures
Spread to work me harm
Bring to my remembrance
Sad Gethsemane
Or in darker semblance
Cross-crown'd Calvary.

lf with sore affliction
Thou in love chastise
Pour Thy benediction
On the sacrifice
Then, upon Thine Altar
Freely offer‘d up
Though the flesh may falter,
Faith shall drink the cup.

When in dust and ashes,
To the grave l sink,
While heaven‘s glory flashes,
O’er the shelving brink
On Thy truth relying
Through that mortal strife
Lord, receive me dying
To eternal life.

304.englishTitle: I LAY my sins on Jesus

stanzas.text:
I LAY my sins on Jesus
The spotless Lamb of God
He bears them all and frees us
From the accursed load
I bring my guilt to Jesus
To wash my crimson stains
White in His blood most precious
Till not a spot remains.

I long to be like Jesus,
Meek, loving, lowly, mild;
I long to be like Jesus,
The Father's Holy Child,
I long to be with Jesus,
Amid the heavenly throne
To sing with saints His praises
And learn the Angels‘ song.

COME, ye sinners, poor and wretched,
Come in mercy's gracious hour
Jesus ready stands to save you
Full of pity, love, and pow‘r
He is able, He is willing: doubt no more.

Come, ye needy, come and welcome
God's free bounty glorify
True belief, and true repentance,
Every grace which brings us nigh
Without money come to Jesus
Christ and buy.

Let not conscience make you linger
Nor of fitness fondly dream
All the fitness He requireth
ls to feel your need O Him;
This he gives you; ‘tis the
Spirit rising beam.

Come, ye weary, heavy lader,
Lost and ruin‘d by the fa'l
lf you tarry till you‘re better
You will never come at all
Not the righteous, sinners Jesus
came to call.

Lo! the incarnate God, ascended
Pleads the merit of His blood
Venture on Him, venture wholly;
Let no other trust intrude
None but Jesus can do helpless
sinners good.

Saints and angels, join‘d in concert
Sing the praises of the Lamb
While the blissful Seals of heaven
Sweetly echo with his name
Hallelujah! sinners here may sing
the same.

306.englishTitle: SINNERS turn why will ye die

stanzas.text:
SINNERS, turn why will ye die?
God your maker, ask thee why
God, who did thy being give
Make thee with himself to live
He the fatal cause demands,
Ask the work of His own hands
Why, ye thankless creatures, why
Will thou cross His love, and die?

Sinners turn why will ye die
God thy Saviour, asks thee why
God who did thy Souls retrieve,
Died Himself that ye might live,
Will ye let Him die in vain,
Crucify the Lord Again?
Why ye ransom’d sinners? why
Will you slight His grace, and die?

Sinners turn why will ye die?
God, the Spirit; asks thee why
He who all thy lives hath striven
Urged thee to contend for heaven
Will you not His Grace receive,
Will you still refuse to live
Why’ye long‐ sought sinners why,
Will thou grieve thy God and die?

Can you doubt if God is love
If to all His yearnings move?
Will ye not his word receive
Will ye not His oath believe?
See, your dying Lord appears
Jesus weeps believe his tears
Mingled with His blood they cry,
Why will ye resolve to die?

Jesus, I will trust Thee, Trust Thee with
my soul
Guilty, lost and helpless
Thou canst make me whole
There is none in heaven, or on earth like thee
Thou has died for Sinners, therefore, Lord for me

Jesus, I may trust Thee, name of matchless worth
Spoken by the angel, at Thy wonderous birth
Written and for ever, on Thy cross of shame
Sinners read and worship
Trusting in that name.

Jesus I must trust Thee, pondering on Thy ways
Full of love and mercy, all Thine earthly days
Sinners gather'd round Thee, Lepers sought
Thy face.
None too vile or loathsome, for a Saviour's grace.

Jesus I can trust Thee, trust thy written word,
Though Thy voice of pity, I have never heard,
When Thy Spirit teacheth, to my taste how sweet
Only may I harken, sitting at Thy Feet.

Jesus I do trust Thee, trust without a doubt
Whosoever cometh, thou will not cast out
Faithful is Thy promise, precious is Thy blood
These my soul's salvation
Thou my Saviour God.

MY God, my Father, does Thou call
Thy long-lost wandering child to thee
And canst thou wilt thou pardon all?
I come, I come, Lord save thou me.

O Jesus, art thou passing by
With all thy goodness, grace, and powar
And dost thou hear my broken cry?
I come, I come, in mercies hour.

O Holy Spirit, is it thou,
My tenderest Friend refused too long?
And dost Thou pleading, striving now?
I come, I come, make weakness strong.

Yes, Lord, I come, Thy heart of love
ls moving, kindling, drawing mine
I cast me at thy feet to prove
The bliss, the heaven of being Thine.

Return, O wanderer, to thy home
Thy father calls for thee
No longer now an exile roam
In guilt and misery
Return, return, return.

Return, O wanderer, to thy home
‘Tis Jesus calls for thee
The Spirit and the Bride say, Come
Oh, now for refuge flee
Return, return, return.

Return, O wanderer, to thy home
‘Tis madness to delay
There are no pardons in the tomb
And brief is mercy's day
Return, return, return.

310.englishTitle: DEPTH of mercy Can there be

stanzas.text:
DEPTH of mercy! Can there be
Mercy still reserve for me?
Can my God His wrath forbear?
Me, the chief of sinners, spares
l have long withstood His grace
Long provoked Him to His face
Would not hearken to His calls
Grieved Him by a thousand falls.

His patience, grace l exploit
Me He still delights to spare
Cries- how shall I give thee up
Bids me take salvation‘s cup
There for me the saviour stands
Show His wounds, and spreads His Hands
God is love, I know, I feel
Jesus weeps, and loves me still.

Jesus, answer from above
Is not all thy nature love
Wilt thou not the wrong forget
Suffer me to kiss Thy feet?
If I rightly read thy heart
If thou all compassion art
Bow thine ear, in mercy low
Pardon and accept me now.

Pity from thine eye let fall
By a look my soul recall
Now the stone of flesh convert
Cast a look, and break my heart
Now incline me to repent
Fasting! my sin cast away
Let me foul revolt deplore
Weep, believe, and sin no more.

311.englishTitle: LORD I hear of showers of blessing

stanzas.text:
Pass me not O gracious Father;
Sinful though my heart may be:
Thou might'st leave me but then rather
Let Thy mercy light on me-Even me.

Pass me not, O gracious Saviour;
Let me love and cling to Thee
I am longing for Thy favour
Whilst Thou‘rt calling Oh, call me-Even me.

Pass me not O mighty Spirit
Thou canst make the blind to see
Witnesses of Jesus' merit,
Speak the word of power to me-Even me.

Have I long in sin been sleeping,
Long been slighting, grieving Thee
Has the world my heart been keeping
Oh forgive and rescue me Even me.

Unfailing divine love of God
Princeless, sacred Jesus blood
Grace divine beyond all measures
Extol all Thine grace in me Even me.

Pass me not, forgive me oh Lord
Draw me nearer unto Thee
As Thou shareth blessings to all
Thine blessings on me endow
Even me.

THE Spirit O sinner in mercy doth move
Thy heart so long hardened or sin
to reprove
Resist not the spirit nor longer delay
God's gracious entreaties may end
with today.

O Child of the kingdom, from sin‘s
service cease
Be filled with the spirit, with comfort
and peace
Oh, grief not the spirit, thy teacher is He
That Jesus thy Saviour may glorified be.

Defiled is the temple it is beauty laid low
On God‘s holy altar the embers faint glow
By love yet rekindled, a flame may be
fann'd
Oh, quench not the spirit, the Lord is
at hand.

313.englishTitle: GOD doth see all the work

stanzas.text:
GOD doth see all the work we do
All are not from Him hid
And within us our faulty thoughts
Glaringly known to Him.

Our sins from Him we cannot hide
Them He knows every one,
We lie, our feeble frame deceive
If we think He knows not.

All things unto Him manifest
Before His sacred eyes
Both night and day, darkness and light
Unto His sight are same.

May we in mem’ry be oh God
Thine eyes are e’er on us
And help us, Lord, in awe to be
Not against Thee to sin.

314.englishTitle: WHO dandle in the sin pond

stanzas.text:
WHO dandle in the sin pond
To thee Christ is calling
Thy burden of sin to remove
Salvation thee to give.
stanzas.chorus:
Christ is calling, thee
Him to meet
In this band of Cherubim
Jesus waiting thee to reveive
His call, thee never shark.

stanzas.text:
To this world Blessed Lord
Jesus came
Thee from all thy sins to save
Thee from all thy sickness cure
Oh what Salvation sogreat.

Thy sin, it as crimson is red
White as snow, thee, Christ
will make
Thy salvation, He‘s accomplished
For thee, Him it‘s to accept.

Hark Christ, thee calling for repentance
And redemption for thy soul
Hearken to the salvation call
Come ere now the door is closed.

Tho satan and world against thee
And much trouble on the ways
Come under Christ's Holy Shelter
Give Thy soul a lasting rest.
stanzas.chorus:
Christ is calling, thee
Him to meet
In this band of Cherubim
Jesus waiting thee to reveive
His call, thee never shark.

stanzas.text:
NO, not despairinegly
Come I to Thee:
No; not despairingly
Bend l the knee
Sin hath gone over me,
Yet is this still my plea,
Jesus hath died.

Ah! mine iniquity
Crimson has been
Infinite, infinite
Sin upon sin
Sin of not loving Thee
Sin of not trusting Thee
Sin of not trusting Thee
Infinite sin.

Lord, I confess to Thee
Sadly my sin
All I am tell I Thee,
All I have been,
Purge Thou my sin away
Wash Thou my soul this day
Lord, make me clean.

Faithful and just an Thou,
Forgiving all:
Low at Thy pierced feet,
Saviour, I fall:
Oh let the cleaning blood,
Blood of the Lamb of God,
Pass o’er my soul.

Then all is peace and light
This soul within:
Thus shall I walk with Thee
The loved unseen,
Leaning on Thee, my God
Guided along the road,
Nothing between.

JESUS, Lover of my soul
Let me to thy bosom fly
While the nearer waters roll
While the tempest still is high
Hide me, O my saviour, hide
Till the storm of life is past
Save into the heaven guide
Oh, receive my soul at last.

Other refuge have I none
Hangs my helpless soul on thee
Leave, Oh leave me not alone
Still support and comfort me
All my trust in thee is stayed
All my help from thee I bring
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of thy wing.

Thou, O Christ, an all I want
More than all in thee l find
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint
Heal the sick, and lead the blind
Just and holy is thy name
I am all unrighteousness
Vile, and full of sin, I am
Thou art full of truth and grace.

Plenteous grace with Thee is found
Grace to cover all my sin
Let the healing streams abound
Make, and keep me pure within
Thou of lite the fountain art
Freely let me take of thee
Spring thou up within my heart
Rise to all eternity.

317.englishTitle: ROCK of ages cleft for me

stanzas.text:
ROCK of ages cleft for me;
Let me hide myself in thee
Let the water and the blood
From thy riven side which flowd,
Be of sin the double cure
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

Not the labours of my hand
Can fulfil Thy law‘s demands
Could my zeal no respite know
Could my tears for ever flow
All for sin could not atone
Thou must save, and Thou alone.

Nothing in my hand I bring
Simply to Thy cross I cling
Naked come to Thee for dress
Helpless, look to thee for Grace
Foul, I to the fountain fly
Wash me, Saviour or I die.

While l draw this fleeting breath
When my eyelids close in death
When I soar through tracts unknown
See Thee on Thy judgement throne
Rock of ages, cleft for me
Let me hide myself in Thee.

IMPATIENT heart be still
Thy God is on thy side
He who has made the promises
Will sure bring it to pass.

He led thee by the hand
And brought thee hither-to
He’ll keep thee till danger is past,
Until thy life shall end.

When thou wert yet engulfed
In troubles and despair
ls it not thy cry He has heard
And delivered thee free.

Though all the way seems rough
Yet He will take thee home
Soon, troubles here will over be
Thou'll forget them for e‘er.

AS pants the heart for cooling streams,
When heated in the chase;
So longs my soul O God, for Thee
And Thy refreshing grace.

Why restless, why cast down,
my soul?
Trust God, who will employ
His aid for Thee and change
these sighs
To thankful hymns of joy.

For Thee, my God, the living God,
My thirsty soul doth pine,
Oh when shall I behold Thy face,
Thou Majesty divine?

Why restless, why cast down my soul?
Hope still, and thou shall sing
The praise of Him who is thy God
Thy health’s eternal spring.

320.englishTitle: IF you are tired of the load

stanzas.text:
IF you are tired of the load of your sin
Let Jesus come into your heart
lf you desire a new life to begin
Let Jusus come into your heart.
stanzas.chorus:
Just now, your doubtings give o'er
Just now, reject Him no more
Just now, throw open the door
Let Jesus come into your heart.

stanzas.text:
lf ‘tis for purity now that you sigh
Let Jesus come into your heart
Fountains for cleansing are flowing near by,
Let Jesus come into your heart.

lf there's tempest your voice cannot still,
Let Jesus come into your heart
lf there's a void this world never can fill
Let Jesus come into your heart.

If friends, once trusted, have proven untrue
Let Jesus come into your heart
Find what a friend He will be unto you
Let Jesus come into your heart.

lf you would join the glad songs of the blest
Let Jesus come into your heart;
lf you would enter the mansions of rest
Let Jesus come into your heart.
stanzas.chorus:
Just now, your doubtings give o'er
Just now, reject Him no more
Just now, throw open the door
Let Jesus come into your heart.

stanzas.text:
OUR heavenly Father calls
Christ calls us unto Him
Our friendship shall be sweet with them
Precious, our fellowship.

Thy tender mercy Show
In pardoning my sins
My heart to wisdom He applied
And my footsteps guideth.

His grace how bountiful
A rich store house hath He
This grace the Lord Himself bestows
It is bought with His blood.

Jesus, my fountain head
Thy holy name l bless
lntercessor with the Father
The Bishop of my souls!

My heart and all my will
Wait patiently, below
Until sweet communion is full
High up in heaven above.

JESUS shall reign where‘re the sun
Doth his successive journeys run:
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore.
Till sun shall rise and set no more.

For Him shall endless prayer be made
And praises throng to crown His head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their young hosannas to His name.

Blessings abound where‘re He reigns’
The pris’ner leaps to lose his chains;
The weary find eternal rest
And all the sons of want are blest.

Where He display His healing power
Death and the curse are known no more;
In Him the tribes of Adam boast
More blessings than their father lost.

Let every creature rise, and bring
lts grateful honours in our King;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth prolong the joyful strain.

THY Kingdom come O God
Thy rule O Christ, begin;
Break with thine iron rod
The tyrannies of sin.
