Where is Thy reign of peace
And purity and love?
When shall all hatred cease,
As in the realms above?

When comes the, promised time
That war shall be no more,
And last, oppression, prime
Shall flee Thy face before?

We pray Thee, Lord arise,
And come in Thy great might;
Revive our longing eyes,
Which languish for Thy sight.

Man scorn Thy sacred name,
And wolves devour Thy fold,
By many deeds of shame
We learn that love grow cold.

O‘er heathen lands afar
Thick darkness broodeth yet;
Arise, O morning star,
Arise, and never set!

MY affliction consider Lord
Thine help we plead o! send
My fainting heart yearns to be saved
My works may though not end.

Of benefit to me it be
When I my Father scold
Thine salutes my mother tutored
That I may trust in Thee.

Righteuos Thine judgment this I know
E'en thou it's bile and firm
All tribulations I endure.
From Thee emanate all.

When not I Thine chaste recognize
Often astrey I go
But now as much Thine word I learn
Astray I go no more.

SINNER, prepare now to be wise
Tarry not oft to the morrow
As long as wisdom thought deride
Wisdom the more hidden will be.

Get ready for mercy to ask
Tarry not oft to the morrow
Before thy days on earth are o'er
Before earthly sunset arrives.

Prepare, O sinner to return
Tarry not on to the morrow
So thou be not accursed become
Ere shall tomorrow‘s day arise.

Prepare thy blessing to receive
Tarry not Oh to the morrow
Hence now thy lamp burning and trimmed
Hence now the new dawn shall arise.

Lord, make the sinner to repent
From foolish slumber him arouse
The wisdom may he not declined
And to doom may he not reclined.

FATHER of mercy who loved us
I lift my heart to Thee
Thy mighty power has saved our soul
We raise our song to Thee.

Thine all alone we love to be
We offer, Lord, our hearts
Your creatures who are born again
Submit ourselves to Thee.

O Holy Spirit, come to me
Reveal the Saviour’s love
Grant Lord, to me that I may walk
E’er in my Saviour‘s love.

327.englishTitle: MUCH as the stars my sins

stanzas.text:
MUCH as the stars my sins abound
Much as the ocean sands
But the compassion of the Lord
Is much and more than all.

Mannaseh, Paul and Magdalene
Thou forgivest them all
That have I read and thus believe
Thou hast forgiven me.

329.englishTitle: O THOU from whom all goodness

stanzas.text:
O Thou from whom all goodness flows,
I lift my heart to Thee;
In all my sorrows, conflicts, woes
Dear Lord, remember me.

Than on my aching burden'd heart
My sins heavily lie
Thy pardon grant, Thy peace impart:
In love remember me.

When trials sore obstruct my way
And ills I cannot feel
Oh let my strength be as my day;
For good remember me.

If on my face for Thy dear name
Shame and reproaches be;
l‘ll hail reproach, and welcome shame
If Thou remember me.

And Oh, when in the hour of death,
I own Thy just decree
Be this the prayer of my last breath
Dear Lord, remember me.

JESUS upon Thee revealeth
Multilide of glories
More in quantom than precious stones
Seen upon Aaron's robe.

Of ought sacrifices offered
All for sins committed
Jesus Thou unblemished and pure
And sacred is Thine being.

Jesus King of glory reigneth
In hea-venly Zion
Similitude of the slain Lamb
And of our Greatest priest.

Solicitor before our God
Forever shall endure
Grant Him my soul thy petitions
Fatherly grace receive.

HOSANNA! raise the pearling hymn
To David's Son and Lord
With Cherubim and Seraphim
Exalt the incarnate word.

Hosanna! Lord, our feeble tongue
No lofty strains can raise
But thou will not dispise the young
Who meekly chant thy praise.

Hosanna! Sovereign, Prophet, Priest
How vast Thy gifts, how free
Thy blood, our life; Thy word our feast;
Thy name our only plea.

Hosanna! Master, Lo we bring
Our offerings to thy throne
Not gold nor myrrh, nor mortal thing
But hearts to he Thine own.

Hosanna! once thy gracious ear
Approved a lisping throng
Be gracious Still design to hear
Our poor, but grateful song.

O Saviour if redeem‘d by Thee
Thy temple we be behold,
Hosanna through eternity
We'll sing to harps of gold.

332.englishTitle: RIDE on ride on in majesty

stanzas.text:
RIDE on, ride on in majesty
Hark! all the tribes Hossanas cry
O Saviour meek, pursue Thy road,
With palms and scatter'd garments
strow‘d.

Ride on, ride on in majesty
In lowly pomp ride on to die
O Christ, Thy triumphs now begins
O‘er captive dead and conquer’d sin.

Ride on ride on in majesty
The winged squadrons of the sky
Look down with sad and wondering
eyes
To see the approaching sacrifice.

Ride on, title on in majesty
Thy last and fiercest strife is nigh,
The Father on His sapphire throne
Expects His own anointed Son.

ALL Glory, laud, and honour,
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosanna‘s ring
Thou art The King of Israel
Thou band‘s Royal Son
Who in the Lord's name cometh
The King and Blessed One.
stanzas.chorus:
All Glory, laud, and honour,
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosanna's ring.

stanzas.text:
The company of the angels
Are praising Thee on high
And mortal men, and all things
Created, make reply.

The people of the Hebrews
With palms before Thee went,
Our praise and prayer and anthem
Before Thee we present.

To Thee before Thy passion
They sang their hymns of praise
To Thee, Now high exalted
Our melody we raise.

Thou didst accept their praises
Accept the prayers we bring
Who in all good delighted
Thou good and gracious King.
stanzas.chorus:
All Glory, laud, and honour,
To Thee, Redeemer, King
To whom the lips of children
Made sweet Hosanna's ring.

stanzas.text:
HOSANNA unto David's son
Hosanna, raise the strain
For blessed is He that will come
In the name of the Lord.

Hosanna unto David‘s son
The angel host did sing
All creatures, join the loud refrain
Hosanna to our King.

Hosanna for the Hebrew throng
Spread palm fronds on the road
Hosanna we have brought our gifts
For to prepare His way.

Brethren young, old sing hosanna
Before His suffering comes
Today we all sing hosanna
As Jesus reigns above.

As Thou received the children's praise
Accept the prayers we bring
And join the heavenly host to sing
Hosanna to our King.

THOU who dist on Calvary bleed,
Thou who dost for sinners plead,
Help me in my time of need,
Jesus, hear my cry.

In my darkness and my grief,
With my heart of unbelief,
I, who am of sinners chief,
Lift to Thee mine eye.

Foes without and fears within
with no plea
Thy grace to win,
But that Thou canst save from sin,
To Thy cross I fly.

Brethren, long in fetters bound,
There deliverance sought and found,
Heard the voice of mercy sound,
Surely so may I.

There an Thee I cast my care,
There to Thee l raise my prayer,
Jesus, save me from despair,
Save me, or I die.

When the storms of trial lower,
When I feel temptation‘s power
In the last and darkest hours,
Jesus, be Thou near.

ABUNDANT Joy who can'st recount
In the courtyard of paradise
When the prodigal shall return
To attain heirship of glory.

Heartily, gladly Father gaze
On the fruit of His endless love
Gladly the son gaze on to see
The reward of His painful strife.

Gladly the Holy Spirit gaze
On the renewed and sacred heart
All heav‘nly saints and Angels sing
The salvation hymns of their King.

TO the altar of God
My grief brought I to Thee
Wouldest Thou with mercy receive
This unworthy offering.

Christ Jesus Lamb of God
My faith looks up to Thee
Would Thou unworthy gift reject
My offering receiveth.

When my Christ Jesus died
The law though satisfied
No more am I scared of the law
‘Cos Jesus Christ hast died.

CHRIST Jesus our cross and our song
Deepest mystery revealed
Mockery it seemeth to the Jews
Insanity to Greeks.

But all hearts convened of God
Gladly receive the word
Wisdom, strength, love they receiveth
Revealeth in their God.

The Savour of His living name
All dead souls reviving
Disbelief can our soul defile
Unto condemnation.

Save by chance God His grace
Alike downpour of rain
Apollos may sow all in vain
Paul irrigate in vain.

339.englishTitle: NOT all the blood of beasts

stanzas.text:
NOT all the blood of beasts
On Jewish altars slain
Could give the guilty conscience peace
Or wash away the slain.

But Christ the heavenly Lamb
Takes all our Sins away
A sacrifice of nobler name
And richer blood than they.

My faith would lay her hand
On that dear head of Thine
While like a penitent I stand
And there confess my sin.

My soul looks back to see
The burdens Thou dist bear
When hanging on the accursed tree
l know my guilt He bore.

Believing, we rejoice
To see the curse remove
We bless the Lamb with cheerful voice
And sing His bleeding love!

GREAT high priest, we see
thee stooping
With our names upon Thy breast
In the garden groaning, drooping
To the ground with horrors prest
Wondering angels stood confounded,
To behold their maker thus
And can we remain unwounded
When we know ‘twas all for us?

Nothing but Thy blood. O Jesus
Can our wayward souls convert
Nothing else from guilt release us
Nothing else can melt the heart
Law and terrors do but harden
All the while alone the work
But the sense of blood-bought pardon
Can a heart of stone dissolve.

Jesus, all our consolations
Flow from Thee, the sovereign good
Love, and faith, and hope, and patience
All are purchased by Thy blood
From Thy fullness them we receive
Nothing of our own possessed
Thine delight, freely to offer
To the needy in Thee trust.

Have we no tears to shed for Him
Soldiers scorn and while Jews deride?
Ah! look how patiently He hangs
Jesus our Lord is crucified.

Seven times words of love He spake,
And all three hours His silence cried
Mercy require for souls of men;
Jesus our Lord is crucified.

Oh break or bend, hard heart of mine
Thy weak self-love and guilty pride
Betray'd condemn‘d and scourged
Thy Lord
Jesus our Lord Is crucified.

Come standing by the cross of woe
Drooping blood from Christ Jesus ribs
May overflow and thee o'erwhelm
Jesus our Lord is crucified.

A broken heart, a fount of tears
Request and will not thee decline
Lord Jesus, may we love and weep
Since Thou for us art crucified.

O, love of God O sin of man
In this dread act your strength is tried
And victory with thy love remains
For love Himself was crucified.

HARK, the voice of love and mercy
Sounds aloud from Calvary
See it rends the rocks asunder
Shakes the earth and veils the sky
“It is finish’d", It is finished
Here the dying Saviour cry.

“It is finish’d Oh what pleasure
Do the wondrous words afford,
Heavenly blessings without measure
Flow to us from Christ the Lord
“It is finish’d", It is finished
Saints the dying was record.

Finish‘d all the types and shadows
Of the ceremonial law,
Finish’d all that God had promised
Death and hell no more shall awe
“It is finish'd", It is finished
Saints from hence your comfort draw.

Tune your harps anew, ye Seraphs
Strike them to Emmanuel‘s name
All on earth, and all in heaven
Join the triumph to proclaim
Hallelujah, Hallelujah
Glory to the bleeding Lamb!

BEHOLD the Lamb of God,
who bore
Thy burdens on the tree
He died the captives to restore
His blood was shed for thee.

Look to him, till the sight endears
The Saviour to thy heart
His pierced feet bedew with tears
Nor from His cross depart.

Look to him, till His dying love
Thy every thought control
Its vast constraining influence Prove
O'er body, spirit, soul.

Look to Him, as the race ye run
Thy never-failing friend
He Will complete the work begun
And grace in glory end.

SWEET the moments, rich in blessing
Which before the cross I spend
Life, and health, and peace possessing
From the sinner's dying Friend.

Here l'll sit, for ever viewing
Mercy's stream in streams of blood
Precious drops, my soul bedewing
Plead, and claim my peace with God.

Truly blessed Is this station
Low before His cross to lie
While I see divine compassion
Beaming in His languid eye.

Love and grief my heart dividing
With my tears His feet I'll bathe
Constant still in faith abiding
Life deriving from His death.

Lord, in ceaseless contemplation
Fix my thankful heart on Thee
Till I taste Thy full salvation
And Thine unveil'd glory see.

WHEN I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of Glory die
My richest gain I count but loss
And pour contempt on all my pride.

Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast
Save in the death of Christ, my God
All the vain things that charm me most
I sacrifice them to his blood.

See, from His head, His hand His feet
Sorrow and love flow mingled down
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet
Of thorns compose so rich a crown.

Were the whole realm of nature mine
That were an offering far too small
Love so amazing, so divine
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

THE rugged cross is all my gain
There the great sacrifice was made
There the Saviour was crucified
And there He bled and died for me.

What could have moved His
heart to bear
And to suffer for all my sins?
Not knowing why is the reason
My heart towards Thee is so cold.

Silently, there I grew ashamed
Before my Holy Saviour, Lord
Who His life blood shed for my sake
His love to me, beyond compare.

O perfect life of love!
All, all is finished now,
All that He left His throne above
To do for us below.

No work is left undone
Of all the Father willed
His toils and sorrows, one by one
The Scriptures have fulfilled.

No pain that we can share
But He has felt its smart
All forms of human grief and care
Have pierced that tender heart.

And on His thorn-crowned head
And on His sinless soul
Our sins in all their guilt were laid
That He might make us whole.

In perfect love He dies
For me He dies, for me!
O! all-atoning sacrifice,
l cling by faith to Thee.

ln every time of need
Before the judgement throne
Thy work, O lamb of God, l'll plead
Thy merits, not my own.

Yet work, O Lord, in me
As Thou for me hast wrought
And let my love the answer be
To grace Thy love has brought.

348.englishTitle: ON a hill far away stood

stanzas.text:
ON a hill far away stood an old rugged cross
The emblem of suff'ring and shame
And I love that old cross
Where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners was slain.
stanzas.chorus:
So I’II cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down
I will cling to the old rugged cross
And exchange it some day for a crown.

stanzas.text:
Oh, that old rugged cross, so despised
by the world
Has a wondrous attraction for me
For the clear Lamb of God
Left His glory above
To bear it to dark Calvary.

In the old rugged cross stained with
blood so divine
A wondrous beauty l see
For ‘twas on that old cross
Jesus suffered and died
To pardon and sanctify me.

To the old rugged cross I will
ever be true
Its shame and reproach gladly bear
Then He’ll call me some day to my
home far away
Where His glory forever l'll share.
stanzas.chorus:
So I’II cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay down
I will cling to the old rugged cross
And exchange it some day
for a crown.

349.englishTitle: ALAS and did my Saviour bleed

stanzas.text:
ALAS! and did my Saviour bleed?
And did my Sovereign die?
Wound He devote that sacred head
For such a worm as l!

Was if for crimes that had done
He groaned upon tree?
Amazing pity grace unknown
And love beyond degree.

Well might the sun in darkness hide
And Shut his glories in
When Christ, the migth maker died
For man, the creature‘s sin.

Thus mighty I hide my blushing face
Whilst His dear cross appears
Dissolve my heart in thankfulness
And melt mine eyes to tears.

But drops of grief can ne‘er repay
The debt of love l owe
Here, Lord, I give myself away
Tis all that i can do.

COME let‘s unto Jesus attend
At Garden Getsemane
Where in deeper supplicalions
Mercies of God His plea.

Behold the sacred head He bow‘d
Deeply and sore depress‘d
Our sins with agony He bore
Iniquities of men.

Wretehed sinners' Thy Lord behold
Saviour lmmaculate
Forsaken of Father above
Rejecteth sake of thee.

Will thou un-repent on Him gaze
Embracing yet thy sin
Mercies day here and passing bye
Mercies day shall be gone.

GLORY be to Jesus
Who, in bitter pains
Pour’d for me the Life-Blood
From His sacred veins.

Grace and life eternal
In that Blood I find
Blest be His compassion
Infinitely kind.

Blest through endless ages
Be the precious streams
Which from endless torments
Did the world redeem.

Abel‘s blood for vengeance
Pleaded to the skies
But the Blood of JESUS
For our pardon cries.

Oft as it is sprinkled
On our guilty hearts
Satan in confusion
Terror-struck departs.

Oft as earth exulting
Wafts its praise on high
Angel-hosts rejoicing
Make their glad reply.

Lift ye then your voices
Swell the mighty flood
Louder still and louder
Praise the Lamb of God.

352.englishTitle: THERE is a green hill far away

stanzas.text:
THERE is a green hill far away,
Without a city wall
Where the dear Lord was crucified
Who died to save us all.

We may not know, we cannot tell
What pains he had to hear,
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffer'd here.

He died that we might be forgiven
He died to make us good
That we might go at last to heaven
Save by His precious blood.

There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven, and let us in.

Oh dearly, dearly has He loved,
And we must love Him too
And trust in His redeeming blood
And try his works to do.

JESUS in Thy dying woes
Even while Thy life‐blood flows
Craving pardon for Thy foes:
Hearus, Holy Jesus.

Saviour, for our pardon sue,
When our sins Thy pangs renew
For we know not what we do
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

Oh may we, whom mercy need
Be like thee in heart and deed
When with wrong our spirits bleed
Hear us Holy Jesus.
“Today shalt thou be with me in
paradise” - Luke 23:43

Jesus pitying the sighs
Of the thiefwho near Thee dies
Promising him paradise
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

May we in our guilt and shame
Still thy love and mercy claim
Calling humbly on Thy name
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

Oh remember us who pine
Looking from our cross toThine
Cheer our souls with hope divine
Hear us, Holy Jesus.
“Woman behold thy Son, behold
thy mother” - John 19:26,27

Jesus loving to the end
Her whose heart Thy sorrow rends
And Thy dearest human friend:
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

May we in Thy sorrows share
And for Thee all peril dare
And enjoy Thy tender care
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

May we all Thy love ones be
All one holy family
Loving for the love of Thee
Hear us, Holy Jesus.
“My God, my God why hast thou
forsaken me” ‐ Matt. 27:46

Jesus, whelm’d in fears unknown
With our evil left alone
While no light from heaven is shown
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

When we vainly seem to pray
And our hope seems far away
In the darkness be our stay
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

Though no father seem to hear
Though no light our spirits cheer
Tell our faith that God is near
Hear us, Holy Jesus.
“I thirst" - John 19:26

Jesus in thy thirst and pain,
While, Thy wounds Thy
live-blood drain
Thirsting more our love to gain
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

Thirst for us in mercy still
All Thy holy work fulfil
Satisfy Thy loving will;
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

May we thirst Thy love to know
Lead us in our sin and woe
Where the Healing waters flow
Hear us, Holy Jesus.
"It is finished" - John 19:30

Jesus-All our ransom paid
All Thy Father's will obey'd
By Thy sufferings perfect made
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

Save us in our soul's distress
Be our help to cheer and bless
While we grow in holiness,
Hear us. Holy Jesus.

Brighten all our heaven ward way,
With an ever holier ray
Till we pass to perfect day
Hear us, Holy Jesus.
"Father into thy hands I commend my
spirit" - Luke 23:46

Jesus-All Thy Labour past
All Thy woe and, conflict past
Yielding up Thy soul at last
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

When the death‐shades round us lower
Guard us from the tempter‘s power
Keep us in that trial hour
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

May Thy life and death supply
Grace to live and grace to die
Grace to reach the home on high
Hear us, Holy Jesus.

WEEPING will not save me!
Though my face were bathed
in tears
That could not, allay my fears
Could not wash the sins of years
Weeping will not save me!
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus wept and died for me
Jesus suffered on the tree
Jesus waits to make me free
He alone can save me!

stanzas.text:
Working will not save me!
Purest deeds that I can do
Holiest thoughts and feelings too
Cannot form my soul anew
Working will not save me!

Waiting will not save me
Helpless, guilty, lost, I lie
ln my car is Marcy's cry
lf l wait l can but die
Waiting will not save me!

Faith in Christ will save me!
Let me trust Thy weeping son
Trust the work that He has done
To His arms, Lord, help me run
Faith in Christ will save me!
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus wept and died for me
Jesus suffered on the tree
Jesus waits to make me free
He alone can save me!

stanzas.text:
WERE you there when Judas
pinpointed Him. 2ce
stanzas.chorus:
If you were there you will
surely have pity,
Were you there where Judas
pinpointed Him.

stanzas.text:
Were you there when Peter
denied Jesus. 2ce
stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I will
surely have pity,
were you there when
Peter denied Jesus.

stanzas.text:
Were you there at the time
when the cock crowed. 2ce
stanzas.chorus:

surely have pity
Were you there at the time

stanzas.text:
Were you there when they found
Jesus guilty.
stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I will surely
be quivering
Were you there when they
found Jesus guilty.

stanzas.text:
Were you there when Jesus
was crowned with thorns. 2ce
stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I will surely
be crying
Were you there when Jesus

stanzas.text:
Were you there when they nailed
Him to the cross. 2ce
stanzas.chorus:
If l were there I will surely
be crying
Were you there when they
nailed Him to the cross.

stanzas.text:
Were you there when darkness
descended down.
stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I will surely
be afraid
were you there when darkness

stanzas.text:
Were you there during Cherubim
visit.
stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I’ll surely be
very glad
Were you there during

stanzas.text:
Were you there during Seraphim’s
visit.
stanzas.chorus:

Were you there during

stanzas.text:
Were you there when they pricked

stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I’ll surely be
crying
Were you there when they pricked

stanzas.text:
Were you there when the temple’s
cloth got rent.
stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I’ll surely be
afraid were you there when

stanzas.text:
Were you there when Jesus
rose from the dead.
stanzas.chorus:
If I were there I will surely
be happy
Were you there when

stanzas.text:
CHRIST Jesus Oh Lord here we come
O! day of our resurrection
Our hearts we lift on high to Thee
Unto Thine sacred holy name.

Fellowship with us Father God
Fellowship with us God the Son
Commune with us Holy Spirit
Consecrate us all Lord we plead.

This day Lord we offer Thee thanks
In awfulness we worship Thee
Save us Lord from this world of woe
Let's not be disgraced here on earth.

Hossanah to Thee Gracious King
We thank,Thee for resurrection
To the Holy One who arose
Thanks we offer to trinity.

Glory be to Father above
Glory be also to the Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit
Glory be to the Almighty.

ALAS, and did my Saviour bleed?
And did my Sovereign die?
Would He devote that sacred head
For such a worrh, as I?
stanzas.chorus:
At the cross, at the cross where l first
saw the light
And the burden of my heart rolled
away (rolled away)
It was there by faith I received
my sight.
And now I am happy all the day!

stanzas.text:
Was it for crimes that l have done,
He groaned upon the tree?
Amazing pity! grace un-known!
And love beyond degree!

Well migth the sun in darkness hide
And shut his glories in,
When Christ, the mighty Maker, died
For man the creature‘s sin.

But drops of grief can ne'er repay
The debt of love I owe:
Here, Lord, l give myself away
‘Tis all that I can do!

GOD the Father loved the world
He loved the world so much
That He sent His only Son
Who died for the sinners
For God has already known
That I will offend Him
His law and also His love
Lovest thou Me also?

It is true, that God loves me
This fact is without doubt
Those who repent of their sins
Have received salvation
See how much Jesus suffers
He was nailed to the cross
Behold, His life blood flowing
Look, repent, sin no more.

Jesus underneath Thy cross
I‘ll wash away my sins
Underneath Thy precious cross
l'll wash my sins away
And when I shall behold Thee
Up there upon Thy throne
I shall not cease praising Thee
Thy majesty and might.

THE Garden Wrestling in agony,
wrestling alone Weary for human
love and finding none.

While over Olive! sleeps the
moon‐light Whose is that broken
prayer troubling night?

What are those drops of blood
falling like rain
Wrung from that heart of Thine
Man of pain.

Anguish unspeakable writton Thy
brow Suppliant sufferer. who art Thou?
II  THE WAY OF SORROW

HARK, in thy bosom‘s depths speaks
He to thee
Child of My dying love, follow Me"

Shall I not drink the cup My
Father gave?
Drink it, when drinking it thee will save.

Buffeted, spitted on loaded with scorns
Smitten, scourged, purple-robed
crown’d with thorns.

Onward to Golgotha, there I must die
All for the love of thee it is l.
III  THE SEVEN WORDS UPON THE CROSS

NAILLED to the bitter wood: never a groan
Bearing our guilt and sun not His own.

Sun of my soul, canst Thou suffer eclipse?
What words are those fromThy quivering lips.

‘Father forgive them the Crucified prays
And Him the Father hears, hears always.

Listen, the dying thief for mercy sighs
Calmly He promises Paradise.

Standing beside His cross kins folk
and friend
Mary, and Magdalene wait the end.

Two of them henceforth are mother
and son
Broken hearts by His word bound as one.

Darkness wraps earth and sky night
at mid day
Moments like centuries pass away.

Hark through the gloom is heard one
dreadful cry
‘Thou hast forsaken Me, Father, why?

On that abandonment! Oh death accursed!
What means that plaint of woe. that
"I thirst?"

Hark, “It is finish'd Thy warfare is done
Death and hell grappled with victory won.

Father receive My soul, "His latest breath
Jesus, the Lord of life,
sleeps in death.  Amen
IV.  THE APPEAL

CHILD of My agonies bought with My blood
Ransom‘d from Satan's thrail, saved for God.

‘Come to Me, weary one, come to My breast
Here in My bleeding wounds hide and rest.

'Come to My Father’s feet, come without fear
I am thy Advocate, always near.

Drink of the Spirit’s grace, all things are thine
l am thy heritage, thou art Mine.

360.englishTitle: YEA Lord I give myself wholy

stanzas.text:
YEA, Lord, I give myself wholy to Thee
Only Thy priceless love give Thou me.

All I have, all I am, body and soul
Nothing refuse l Thee, take the whole.

Only abide with me, Lord, to the end
Jesus, Emmanuel, Saviour, Friend.

And when Thy time is come, let me adore
Thee in Thy home of light ever more.

SABBATH of the saints or old
Day of mysteries manifold
By the great creator blest
Typical of rest so sweet
Resting from His work the Lord
Spake to-day the hallow’d word.

Resting in the tomb to-day
Still the Saviours body lay
Wrapt in sleep, from head to feet
Shrouded in the winding sheet
Lying in the rock alone
Hidden and by the sealed stone.

Lord, with Thee still life shall end
We would solemn vigil spend
Close the door from sight and sound
Of the busy world around
And in patient watch remain
Till thou shalt appear again.

Still with thee their sabbath keep
They who 'neath the altar sleep
Resting from their labours past
Waiting for the trumphet‘s blast
When, the new creation done
Endless joys shall be begun.

Jesus, keep us safe from sin
With them let us enter in
Danger past and toil at end
And to those blest joys ascend
There in flesh our God to see
And adore eternally.

362.englishTitle: MY faith has found a resting

stanzas.text:
MY faith has found a resting place
Not in device nor creed
I trust the Ever living One
His wounds for me shall plead.
stanzas.chorus:
I need no other argument
I need no other plea
lt is enough that Jesus died
And that He died for me.

stanzas.text:
Enough for me that Jesus saves
This ends my fear and doubt
A sinful soul come to Him
He‘ll never cast me one

My heart is leaning on the word
The written word of God
Salvation by my Saviour's name
Salvation through His blood.

My great physician heals the sick
The lost He came to save
For me His precious blood He shed
For me His life He gave.
stanzas.chorus:
I need no other argument
I need no other plea
lt is enough that Jesus died
And that He died for me.

stanzas.text:
GO, tell the good tidings to every one,
That God the Son o'er death prevailed,
Gladly and joyfully relay the news
To Holy Spirit enthroned.
stanzas.chorus:
My King has come,
The Conqueror has come,
Glory, Honour and power
and majesty, To the lamb of
God on Throne.

stanzas.text:
Angelic host offer praises to Jesus
Who the universe redeemed Jesus,
Holy One, and God Incarnate
On earth and Heaven above.

We hallow Bless Sacred King,
Majesty Omnipotent Trinity
lncomprehensible Almighty God
Miraculous Creator.

The wicked, be clouded, ashamed
and damned, Who Jesus Lord crucified
Evil machinations of the foes is risen
Christ Jesus Saviour is risen,

As African Nation of the universe
Recognised but all as grass
But we have a Father Omnipotent
God All our frame and being He knows.

The joy of Resurrection of Jesus
We pray thee Lord grant unto us
When we shall our earthly toil
accomplish Crown of glory to receive.

Glory we offer to the Father show
And glory unto the Son
Glory we offer unto the Holy Ghost,
Praises to the Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
My King has come,
The Conqueror has come,
Glory, Honour and power
and majesty, To the lamb of
God on Throne.

stanzas.text:
ON the resurrection morning
Soul and body meet again
No more sorrow, no more
weeping No more pain.

Here awhile they must be parted
And the flesh its Sabbath keep
Waiting in a holy stillness
warped in sleep.

For awhile the tired body
To its resting-place is borne
Till there dawns the last and
Brightest Easter morn.

But the soul in contemplation
Utters earnest prayer and strong
Breaking at the resurrection Into song.

Soul and body re-united
Thenceforth nothing shall divide
Walking up in Christ’s own
likeness Satisfied.

Oh the beauty, oh the gladness
Of that resurrection day
Which shall not through endless
ages Pass away!

Oh that happy Easter morning
All the graves their dead restore
Father, Mother, Child and brethren
Meet once more.

To the brightest of all meeting:
Bring us, Jesus Christ, at last
To thy cross, through death and
Judgment Holding fast.

HALLELUYAH, Halleluyah
HALLELUYAH
The strife is o‘er, the battle done
The victory of the life is won
The song of triumph has begun
Alleluia.

The powers of death have done
their worst
But Christ their legions hath dispersed
Let shouts of holy joy outbursts
Alleluia.

The three sad days have quickly spent
He rises glorious from the dead
All glory to our risen Head
Alleluia.

He break the age-bound chain of hell
The bars from heavens portals fell
Let hymns of praise His triumph tell
Alleluia.

Lord, by the stripes which wounded
Thee From death‘s dread sting
thy servants free
That we may live, and sing
to Thee  Alleluia.  Amin

JESUS lives thy terrors now
Can, O Death, no more appeal us
Jesus lives by this we know
Thou, O; Grave canst not enthral
us Alleluia.

Jesus lives henceforth is death
But the gate of life immortal
This shall calm our trembling
breeath
When we pass its gloomy
portal Alleluia.

Jesus lives, for us he died
Then alone to Jesus living
Pure in heart may we abide
Glory to our Saviour Jesus
Alleluia.

Jesus lives: our heans know well
Nought from us His love shall
sever Life, nor death, not powers of hell
Tear us from His Love and
keeping.
Alleluia.

Jesus lives: to Him the throne
Over all the world is given
May we go where He is gone
Rest and reign with Him in Heaven.
Alleluia.

367.englishTitle: GO tell it to all the world

stanzas.text:
GO tell it to all the world
Spread the gospel all around
Listening hears shall be opened
Receptive hearts shall he saved.

Christ Jesus our Saviour Lord
Whom we worship resurrects
His sacrifice receiveth
For the sins of sinful world.

He arose to die no more
Firstborn amongst all the dead
Whosoever shall believe
Such shall live e'en though is dead.

Heaven angelic beings
Chorus with the earthly beings
Liberator Jesus arose
Peace eternally unend.

THE Lord rose up indeed
The saviour rose again
He rose victorious
Over all the powers of hell
In their great fear, the guards tremblet
Fell down and became dead men.

Behold the angel host
Assembled together
To list to His command
And also to worship
They came with Joy and they did fly.
From heaven in the morn to the tomb.

Back to heaven they did fly
With glad tidings of joy
List to their sweet singing
Back to heaven As they flew
Their song was this, Jesus who died
Is ris'n again, is ris'n today.

All ye that are redeemed
Join In the glad refrain
Let It echo around
To all the earth abroad
Shout and sing for Jesus who died
ls ris‘n again, shall die no more.

All hail, our Saviour, King
Who bought us with His blood
Praise who art ris‘n again
We rise with Thee and reign with Thee
Will Thee ever in heaven above.

WELCOME, happy morning
Age to age shall say;
Hell to-day is Vanquished
Heaven is won to-day
Lo, the Dead is living
God for ever more
Him their true Creator
All His works adore!

Earth with joy confesses
Clothing her for spring
All good gifts return‘d with
Her returning King:
Bloom in every meadow,
Leaves on every bough,
Speak His sorrow ended
Hail His triumph now.

Months in due succession
Days of lengthening lights,
Hours and passing moments
Praise thee in their flight
Brightness of the morning
Sky and fields, and sea
Vanquisher of darkness
Bring their praise to Thee.

Lose the hearts long prison'd
Bound with Saturn‘s chain
All that now is fallen raise to life again
Show Thy face in Brightness
Bid the nations see;
Bring again our daylight;
Day returns with thee.

AWAKE glad soul! awake, awake!
Thy Lord hath risen long
Go to His grave l and with thee take
Both tuneful heart and song
Where life‘s making all around
Where love's sweet voice sing
The first bright blossom may be found
Of an eternal spring.

The shade and gloom of life are fled
This resurrection day
Henceforth in Christ are no more dead
The grave hath no more prey
In Christ we live, in Christ we sleep
ln Christ we wake and rise
And the sad tears death makes us weep
He wipes from all our eyes.

And every bird and every tree
And every opening flower
Proclaim His glorious victory
His resurrection power
The folds are glad, the field rejoice
With vernal vendure spread
The little hills lift up their voice
And the sad tears death makes us weep
He wipes from all our eyes.

Then wake, glad heart! awake, awake
And seek thy risen Lord
Joy in His resurrection take
And comfort in His word
And let life through all its ways
One long thanksgiving be
Its theme of joy, its song of praise
‘Christ died and rose for me”.

371.englishTitle: CHRIST The Lord is risen today

stanzas.text:
CHRIST The Lord is risen today
Halleluyah And Sons of men, angels
say / Halleleuyah! Raise your joys and
triumphs high Halleluyah Sing, yet
heavens; thou earth reply Halleluyah!

Love’s redeeming work is done Halleluyah
Fought the fight, the battle won Halleluyah
Lo! our Son’s eclipse is o er Halleluyah
Lo! He sets in blood no more Halleluyah.

Vain the stone, the watch, the sea!
Halleluyah Christ hath burst the gates
of hell Halleluyah Death in vain forbids
His rise Halleluyah Christ hath open’d
Paradise Halleluyah.

Live again our glorious King Halleluyah
Where, O death, is now thy sting
Halleluyah Once He died our souls to
save Halleluyah Where is thy Victory,
O grave? Halleluyah.

Soar we now where Christ hath led
Hallelujah Following our exalted Head
Halleluyah Made like Him, like Him we
rise Halleluyah Ours the cross, the
grave, the skies Hallaluyah.

Hail the Lord of earth and Heaven
Halleluyah Praise to Thee by both
be given Halleluyah Thee we great
triumphant now Halleluyah Hail the
Resurrection Thou Halleluyah.

THE Lord is risen indeed
Is the glad message true?
Those who saw that the Saviour
died See Him also risen.

The Lord is risen indeed
This is the truth indeed
Mercy and truth in warm embrace
They were past enemies.

The Lord is risen indeed
Thy work is now complete
Our Saviour broke the sting of death
And power of death vanquished.

The Lord is risen indeed
The grave cannot hold Him
The saints who died also arose
And they shall no more die.

HALLELUJAH, Hallelujah!
Hearts to heaven and voices raise
Sing to God a hymn of gladness
Sing to God a hymn of praise!
He who on the cross a victim
For the world's salvation bled,
Jesus Christ, the King of Glory
Now is risen from the dead.

Now the iron bars are broken
Christ from death to life is born
Gloriuos life, and life immortal
On this holy Easter morn:
Christ has triumph'd and we conquer
By His mighty enterprise
We with Him to life eternal
By His resurrection rise.

Christ is risen, Christ the first-fruits
Of the holy harvest-field
Which will all its full abundance
At His second coming yield
Then the golden ears of harvest
Will their heads before Him wave
Ripen'd by His gloriuos sunshine
From the furrows of the grave.

Christ is risen, we are risen
Shed upon us heavenly grace
Rain and dew and gleams of glory
From the brightness of Thy face
That we, Lord, with hearts in heaven
Here on earth may hearts in heaven
And by angel-hands be gather'd
And be ever safe with Thee.

Hallelujah, Hallelujah!
Glory be to God on high
Halleluyah to the Saviour
Who has gain'd the Victory
Hallelujah, to Holy Ghost
Fount of love and sanctity
Hallelujah, Hallelujah
To the Triune Majesty.

JESUS who died the world to save
From the cold tomb rose up again
By His great power divine
From pangs of death He was set free
Captivity He lead captive
He lives, no more to die.

O, ye children of God, behold
The blessed Saviour in glory
He, vanquisher of death
No more sorrows not any fear
He has gone a place to prepare
He‘ll come and take you home.

In mercy and love down He looked
On those He has redeemed on earth
His they are rejoicing
Their joys and afflictions He sees
To have victory for them He prayed
And with Him reign for aye.

IF sinners join their hands
And rise against the Lord
Rebel against the Christ
And despise the great King
The world may mock
Satan may threat
It’s all deceits
It’s all in vain.

Our risen Saviour reigns
On Zion‘s holy hill
It is the Lord’s decree
Upholds and keeps His son
From the cold tomb
He bids Him rise
And to ascend
That He might save.

O serve the Lord in fear
Revere His blest command
With gladness come to Him
In awe stand before Him
Bow down the knee
And prostrate fall
Tell of His might
Kiss thou the Son.

THE promise is fulfill’d
Salvation work is done
Mercy and truth in unison
The Son of God arose.

Oh my soul, praise the Lord
Who all thy sins doth bear
He died for the sins of the world
He came to die no more.

His death purchas’d our rest
And for thee He arose
Believe and be fully pardon‘d
Who was marked with the blood.

JESUS the friend of sinners died
The Children of Salem doth weep
Thick darkness sets and veils the skies
And suddenly, the earth did quake.

Behold the mercy and the love
Of the king of glory for man
Behold what joy doth come our way
Jesus who died doth rise again.

Then, fear ye not, O saints of God
Tell how the Lord our King doth reign
Sing of His victory o‘er the foe
Tell now He met and conquered death.

Proclaim: “Thou art our king for aye"
Thou who art born to save us all
Ask death and say "where is thy sting?
And grave, “where is thy victory".

I am telling, each, everyone
That He arose and iives
And He is in our midst here too
By His quickening Spirit.

Tell it to your neighbour also
That they may rise with us
That light may shine all round about
Through all our days on earth.

This world doth now have a foretaste
Of Father’s home on high
The new life that His grace imparts
Makes it an heavenly place.

The way of the grave that He trod
Leads us on to the skies
Who ever follows His footsteps
Will go to Him in heaven.

He is alive and here with us
To the ends of the world
And when this mortal frame we yield
Back to the dust, in hope.

THE happy Mom is come
Triumphant o‘er the grave
The SAVIOUR leaves the Tomb
Omnipotent to save.
stanzas.chorus:
Captivity is captive led
For JESUS liveth, Who
was Head.

stanzas.text:
Who now accuseth them
For whom their Surety died?
Who shall their souls condemn
Whom GOD hath justified?

CHRIST hath ranson paid
The glorious work is done
On Him our help is laid
By Him our victory won.
stanzas.chorus:
Captivity is captive led
For JESUS liveth, Who
was Head.

stanzas.text:
HALLELUYAH, “He is risen!.”
Jesus is gone up on high!
Burst the bars at death asunder
Angels, shout; and men, reply
He is risen, he is risen,
Living now, no more to die.

Hallelujah, He is risen!
Death for aye has lost if's sting,
Christ Himself the Resurrection
From the grave "His own" will bring
He is risen, Me is risen,
Living Lord and coming King.

CHRIST for sin was crucified
Nailed on to the cross
Groaning in utter grief,
Salvation to earn
His life thus surrendered
Our souls to redeem
Lying still in the sepulcher,
Victory thus to earn.
stanzas.chorus:
He's risen, He's risen
Jesus King of life
He's risen, He's risen
He's risen today.

stanzas.text:
Christ Jesus Lord of life taste of death
He bore Death and hade ever more
shall impotent be Glory give to father
for victory o’er death Neutralizing the
sting of death unto us sinners.

Jesus King, Author of life hath risen to
life Jesus Firstborn amongst all who
departed Alpha and Omega, beginning
and end Thou art the custodian of the
key of life and death.

Lord in resurrection revive now our souls
Quicken us from sinful death to life of truth
May we all bequickened, may
Thine love and peace
Blossom and flourish here in us, just
like High above.

Christ Jesus Lord of life shut the gate of
death Sake of members of the Cherub,
Serahim Eternal life our portion, here and
high above And we shall reign with Lord
Jesus now and evennore.
stanzas.chorus:
He's risen, He's risen
Jesus King of life
He's risen, He's risen
He's risen today.

stanzas.text:
I know that my redeemer lives
Oh the sweet joy this sentence gives!
He lives, He lives, who once was dead
He lives, my everlasting Head.
stanzas.chorus:
He lives, He lives
He lives who once was dead for us
He lives, He lives, He lives, my
everlasting Head.

stanzas.text:
He lives to bless me with His love
And till He pleads for me above
He lives to raise me from the grave
And me eternally to save.

He lives my kind, wise, constant friend
Who still will keep me to the end
He lives. and while He live l'll sing
Jesus, my Prophet, Priest, and King.

He lives my mansion to prepare,
And He Will bring me safely there
He lives, all glory to His name,
Jesus, unchangeable the same.

He lives from all lusts I am free
He lives from dangers I am free
Oh what a great joy ‘tis for me
I know that my Redeemer lives.
stanzas.chorus:
He lives, He lives
He lives who once was dead for us
He lives, He lives, He lives, my
everlasting Head.

stanzas.text:
WHAT are those Sabbath of joy
without end
Angels in light and the glorified spend
Rest for the weary, for victors reward,
There God Himself all and adored?

Who is the Monarch? who circle His throne?
What is the calm restful bliss of His own?
Tell us, ye blessed ones worshipping there,
Tell us, if words can your rapture declare.

Oh true Jerusalem, city most bright
Whose perfect peace is eternal delight:
Longings in thee are fulfill‘d ere express’d
More than was long’d for embraced
and posses'd.

Troubles all past, in the courts of our King
We without fear Zion‘s anthems shall sing,
Off’ring Thee, Lord, in Thy presence above
Love's pure responses for gifts of Thy love.

There never Sabbath to Sabbath gives place;
One is their Sabbath who gaze on Thy face
There never cease heaven‘s jubilee songs
Chanted by saints and by sweet angel tongues.

Meantime in heart and with faith
winged prayers
Seek we our Fatherland yonder and theirs;
While to Jerusalem bounden we roam
Exiles returning from Babylon home.

Now before Him we adoring fall
Of whom and through whom and in
whom are all;
Of whom the Father, and through whom
the Son In whom the Spirit of Both,
ever one.

PLEASANT are Thy courts above
In the land of light and love
Pleasant are Thy courts below
In this land of sin and woe
Oh! my Spirit longs and faints
For the convers of Thy saints
For the brightness of Thy face
ForThy fullness, God of Grace.

Happy birds, that sing and fly
Round Thy altars, O Most High
Happier should that find a rest
In a heavenly Father‘s breast
Like the wandering dove that found
No repose on earth around
They can to their ark repair
And enjoy it ever there.

Happy souls their praise flow
Even in this vale of woe,
Waters in the desert rise
Manna feeds them from the skies
On they go from strength to strength,
Till they reach Thy throne at length,
At thy feet adoring fall
Who hast led them safe through all.

Lord, be mine this prize to win,
Guide me through a world of sins
Keep me by Thy saving grace
Give me at Thy side a place
Sun and shield alike Thou art
Guide and guard my erring heart
Grace and glory flow from Thee
Shower, O shower them, Lord on me.

I hear the Saviour say,
‘Thy strength indeed is small
Child of weakness, watch and pray
Find in Me thine all in all.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe
Sin had left a crimson stain
He washed it white as snow.

stanzas.text:
Lord, now indeed I find
Thy power, and Thine alone
Can change the leper's spots
And melt the heart of stone.

For nothing good have I
Where-by Thy grace to claim
I‘ll wash my garments white
In the blood of Calv’ry's Lamb.

And when, before the throne
I stand in Him complete
"Jesus died my soul to save"
My lips shall still repeat.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe
Sin had left a crimson stain
He washed it white as snow.

386.englishTitle: LOW in the grave He lay

stanzas.text:
LOW in the grave He lay
Jesus my Saviour
Waiting the coming day
Jesus my Lord!
stanzas.chorus:
Up from the grave He arose
With a mighty triumph o’er
His foes He arose a Victor from
the dark domain
And He Iives for ever with His saints
to reign: He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

stanzas.text:
Vainly they watch His bed
Jesus my Saviour
Vainly they seal the dead
Jesus my Lord!

Death cannot keep his prey
Jesus my Saviour!
He tore the bars away
Jesus my Lord!
stanzas.chorus:
Up from the grave He arose
With a mighty triumph o’er
His foes He arose a Victor from
the dark domain
And He Iives for ever with His saints
to reign: He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

387.englishTitle: I AM pressing on the upward

stanzas.text:
I‘m pressing on the upward way
New heights l‘m gaining ev'ry day
Still praying as l onward bound
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.
stanzas.chorus:
Lord, lift me up and let me stand
By faith on heaven's table land
Where love, and joy, and light abound
Lord plant my feet on higher ground.

stanzas.text:
My heart has no desire to stay
Where doubts arise, and fears dismay
Though some may dwell where these abound
My constant aim is higher ground.

Beyond the mist I fain would rise
To rest beneath unclouded skies
Above earth's turmoil peace is found
By those who dwell on higher ground.

I long to scale the utmost height
Tho rough the way, and hard the light
My song while climbing, shall resound
Lord, Iead me on to higher ground.

Lord, lead me up the mountain side
l dare not climb without my Guide
And heaven gained, l'll gaze around
With grateful heart from higher ground.
stanzas.chorus:
Lord, lift me up and let me stand
By faith on heaven's table land
Where love, and joy, and light abound
Lord plant my feet on higher ground.

stanzas.text:
SEE the Conqueror mounts in triumph
See the King in royal state
Riding on the clouds His chariot
To His Heavenly palace gate;
Hark, the choirs of Angel voices
Joyful Alleluias sing
And the portals high are lifled
To receive their heavenly King.

Who is this that comesin glory
With the trump of jubilee?
Lord of battle, GOD of armies
He has gained the victory
He who on the Cross did suffer
He who from the grave arose
He has vanquished sin and Satan
He by death has spoiled His foes.

While He raised His hands in blessing
He was parted from His friends
While their eager eyes behold Him,
He upon the clouds ascends;
He who walked with God, and pleased Him,
Preaching truth and doom to come
He, our Enoch, is translated
To His everlasting Home.

Now our Heavenly Aaron enters
With His Blood, within the veil
Joshua now is come to Canaan,
And the kings before Him quail
Now He plants the tribes of Israel
In their promised resting place
Now our great Elijah offers
Double portion of His grace.

Thou hast raised our human nature
On the clouds to GOD‘S right Hand
There we sit in Heavenly places
There with Thee in glory stand
JESUS reigns, adored by Angels
MAN with GOD is an the Throne
Mighty LORD, in Thine Ascension
We by faith behold our own.

389.englishTitle: HAIL the day that sees Him

stanzas.text:
ALAFIA f’ojo na, Alleluya!

Odagutan elese, Alleluya!
Goke orun giga lo, Alleluya!

lyin nduro de nibe, Alleluya!

Sibe, O feran aiye, Alleluya!
B'o ti pada s'orite, Alleluya!
O np’eda ni t'On sibe, Alleluya!

Wo, O f'apa ife han, Alleluya!
Gbo, bi On ti nsure fun, Alleluya!
Ijo Re laiye nihin, Alleluya!

Sibe, O mbebe fun wa, Alleluya!
lku Re l'o fi mbebe, Alleluya!
O npese aye fun wa, Alleluya!

Oluwa, b'a ti gba O, Alleluya!
Jina kuro lodo wa, Alleluya!

O CHRIST, Thou hast ascended
Triumphantly on high
By cherub guards attended
And armies of the sky
Let earth tell forth the story
Our very flesh and bone
Emmanuel, in glory
Ascends His FATHER‘s Throne.

There, there Thou standest pleading
The virtue of Thy Blood
For sinners interceding
Our Advocate with GOD;
And every changeful fashion
Of our brief joys and cares
Finds though in Thy compassion
And echo in Thy prayers.

Oh, for a priceless merit
Of Thy redeeming Cross
Vouchsafe Thy Sevenfold SPIRIT
And turn to gain our loss
Till we, by strong endeavour
In heart and mind ascend,
And dwell with Thee for ever
In glories without end.

391.englishTitle: GOD is gone up on high

stanzas.text:
GOD is gone up on high
With a triumphant noise
The clarion of the sky
Proclaim the angelic joys!
stanzas.chorus:
Join all on earth, rejoice
and sing
Glory ascribe to glory's King.

stanzas.text:
God in the flesh below,
For us He reigns above
Let all the nations know
Our Jesus’ conquering love!

All power to our great Lord
Is by the Father given
By angel hosts adored
He reigns supreme In heaven.

High on High holy seal
He hears the righteous sway
His foes beneath His feet
Shall sink and die away.

His foes and ours are one
Satan, the world, and sin
But He shall tread them down
And bring His kingdom in.
stanzas.chorus:
Join all on earth, rejoice
and sing
Glory ascribe to
glory's King.

stanzas.text:
LIFT up your heads O ye Gates
of the Lord Let the King of Glory in
Who by His blood the world redeemed
from their sins
His Kingdom He shall bring forth.
stanzas.chorus:
Hosannah, O ye heaven
Hallelujah, We of the World
Bow down before Him Sun
and Moon loud Hosannah
to our King.

stanzas.text:
We Africans are Israel Gen' ration,
Our Lord's Honour highly praise
Our conq'ror to Heaven has
ascended To prepare us place above.

Behold our Saviour in His Majesty
Riding sky up to the Heaven
While bells of Heavens ringing
Songs of Praise
Welcoming the Glorious King.

My soul longest for the court high
above Where Christ reigns in majesty
The bulwarks made of gold refined and
pure Sapphire, pearl, marble of choice.

One score and four elders bending
their knees
Golden crown on them adorn
Four living creatures in one accord,
Flying around the sacred throne.
stanzas.chorus:
Hosannah, O ye heaven
Hallelujah, We of the World
Bow down before Him Sun
and Moon loud Hosannah
to our King.

393.englishTitle: O hear the song of rejoicing

stanzas.text:
O hear the song of rejoicing in heaven
The song of joy of the triumph of Christ
All enemies bowed down their heads
for Him Sin and death and the cold,
dark grave also.

He is prepared to receive the Kingdom
For God the Father, Creator of all
He is prepared to received a great praise
That's meet for Captain of our Salvation.

His departure was a thing of sorrow
For His chosen disciples who loved Him,
Do not depair was the word of comfort
“I will go to prepare a place for you".

The clouds received the Lord
out of their gaze. The firmament hid the
Saviour from view The hosts of heaven
burst out in shouts of joy For the return
of the Lord of glory.

Do not allow your heart to be troubled
Jesus our hope shall surely come again
He shall come to take His own people
where They shall live and reign with
Him forever.

394.englishTitle: THOU art gone up on high

stanzas.text:
THOU art gone up on high
To massions in the skies
And round Thy Throne unceasingly
But we are lingering here
With sin and care oppressed
Lord, send Thy promised Comforter
And lead us to our rest.

Thou art gone upon high
But Thou dist first come down
Through earth‘s most bitter misery
To pass unto Thy Crown
And girt with griefs and fear
Our onward course must be
But only let this path of tears
Lead us at last to Thee.

Thou art gone up on high
But Thou shalt come again
With all the bright ones of the sky
Attendant in Thy train
Lord, by Thy saving power
So make us live and die
That we may stand in that dread
hour At Thy right Hand on high.

395.englishTitle: HE is gone A cloud of light

stanzas.text:
HE is gone, A cloud of light
Has received Him from our sight
High in heaven, where eyes of men
Follow not, nor angel’s ken
Through the veils of time and space
Pass’d into the holiest place
All the toil, the sorrow down
All the battle fought and won.

He is gone, And we remain
In this world of sin and pain
In the void which He has left On this
earth, of Him bereft, We have still
His work to do We can still His path
pursue; Seek Him both in friend and
foe ln ourselves His image show.

He is gone, We heard Him say,
"Good that I should go away.”
Gone is that dear form and face
But not gone His present grace
Though Himself no more we see
Comfortless we cannot be
No, His Spirit still is ours
Quickening, freshning all our powers.

He is gone, Towards the goal
World and church must onward roll
Far behind we leave the past
Forward are our glances east
Still His words before us range
Through the ages, as they change
Wheresoe'er the truth shall lead
He will give whate'er we need.

He is gone, But we once more
Shall behold Him as before
In the heaven of heavens the same
As on earth He went and came
In the many mansions there
Place for us He will prepare
In lhal world unseen, unknown,
He and we may yet be one.

He is gone, But not in vain
Wait until He comes again
He is risen, He is not here
Far above this earthly sphere
Evermore in heart and mind
Where our peace in Him we find
To our own eternal Friend
Thitherward let us ascend.

BLESSED city, Heaven Salem
Vision clear of peace and love,
who of living stones an builded
In the height of Heaven above And,
with Angel-hosts encircled
As a bride to earth dost move.

From celestial realms descending
Bridal glory round thee shed
Meet for Him, whose love espoused
thee. To thy Lord shalt thou be led
All thy streets, and all thy bulwarks
Of pure gold are fashioned.

Bright thy gates of pearl are shinning
They are open evermore
And by virtue of His merits
Thither faithful souls may soar
Who for Christ’s dear Name in this world
Pain and tribulations bore.

Many a blow and biting sculpture
Polished well those stones elect.
In their places now compacted,
By the Heavenly Architect
Who therewith hath willed for ever
That His palace should be decked.

Praise and honour to the Father
Praise and honour to the Son,
Praise and honour to the Spirit
Ever Three and ever One,
One in Might, and One in Glory
While Eternal Ages run.

A mount exist so high and bright
Where-on our God is known
He reigneth in heaven above
The throne of God it is.

Who are those in proximity
To watch over His throne
Multitude abide there above
All infants just like us.

The Saviour blot away their sins
And made them whole and pure
They love His word and love His days
They love and Him they found.

Beneath the green pastures they
lay And there took they their rest
Their salvation and rest assured
On the Saviour’s bossom.

May we all tread as those who trod
The hea‐venly bound path
Seeking the forgiveness of God
Who hath forgavest them.

Jesus hark the la/men/ta/tions
That can our soul renew
A’top the high shinning mountain
Shall we look unto Thee.

THOSE eternal bowers man hath
never trod. Those unfading flowers
round the Throne of God
Who may hope to gain them after
weary fight?
Who at length attain them,
clad in robes of white?

He who wakes from slumber at the
SPlRlT‘s voice
Daring here to number things unseen
his choice
He who casts his burden down at
JESUS' Cross
CHRIST's reproach his guerdon,
all he side but loss.

He who gladly barters all on earthly
ground He who like Martyrs, says
“I will be crowned." He whose one
oblation is a life of love
Knit in GOD’S salvation to the blest above.

Shame upon you, legions of the Heavenly
King. Citizens of regions past imagining!
What, with pipe and tabor dream away
the light. When He calls to labour and
faith’s arduous fight?

JESUS, LORD of Glory, as we breast
the tide, Whisper Thou the story of the
other side; Where the Saints are casting
crowns before Thy Feet,
Safe for everlasting, in Thyself complete.

399.englishTitle: COME let us join our cheerful

stanzas.text:
COME, let us join our cheerful
songs With angels round the throne;
Ten thousand, thousand are their
tongues. But all their joys are one.

Worthy the Lamb that died, they cry
To be exalted thus;
Worthy the Lamb, our hearts reply,
For He was slain for us.

Jesus is worthy to receive
Honour and power divine;
And blessings, more than we can give,
Be, Lord forever Thine.

All ye who dwells in high above
And on land and the seas
In fellowship His glory raise
And His honour to praise.

The whole creation join in one
To bless the sacred name
Of Him that sits upon the throne,
And to adore the Lamb.

CONGREGATION in respite
We all church of the world
All praises we offer Thee
Christ Jesus Blessed Lord
Holy Lord Thou art conquered
That they may also conquer
The light of their glorious crown
Ordained from Thee above.
ST. ANDREW

Thou we praise for Saint Andrew
Who Thine voice first he hark
Whose brethren hath he brought
forth Christ Jesus all to see
Set apart our hearts oh Lord
Let‘s on the watch be for Thee
And all our brethren also
Thine return to witness.
ST. THOMAS

Thou we praise for Saint Thomas
Thine be-ing doth he doubt
Our faith he thus establish
Thine divine love revealed
Oh dear Lord Thine peace we plead
To all who Thee expecting
Knowmg Thee as all faithful
And divine being of God.
ST. STEPHAN

We praise Thee for Saint Stephen
First witness of Thine death
Who through all tribulations
Calling upon the Lord
Oh God when our turn shall be
To suffer for Thine honour
Let’s for Thee on earth witness
The crown to earn above.
ST. JOHN THE GOSPELLER

Thou we praise for Thy Servant
On Island of Patmos
We praise Thee for witnessing
Honestly for Thine sake
We praise Thee for the vision
Revealeth to us from Thee
Patiently we'll be waiting
That we may worthy be.
DAY OF THE CHILDREN SLAINED

Thou we praise for the children
Witnesses of Thine death
All halted from the battle
To the abode of rest
Mother Rachael stop weeping
From pains they are liberated
Grant us hearts un-deceiving
Like them, crown we may earn.
CONVERTED ST PAUL

Thou we praise for divine Light
And voice all from above
And Thou we praise for vision
Of the per-se-cutor
Also for his convertion We give
Thee all the glory Beam unto us
divine Light Bid our darkness away.
ST. MATHIAS

Oh Lord God Thou art with them
Who unto Thee gathered
Thou who Mathias chosen
Judas to substitute
We plead Thee, Thine Church to save
From all prophet of falsehood
Lord Thine promise remember
With Thine church ever dwell.
ST. MARK

Thou we praise for Thy servant
Whom Thou hath empowered
Who Thine gospel proclaimeth
Hymns of victory brought
Thou in our un-wholesomeness
Be Thou our strength we plead
Let us be fruitful in Thee
Oh God our sacred vine.
ST PHILLIP & JAMES (JACOB)

Thou we praise for Thy servant
St Phillip our dear guide
St James his fellow brethren
Let‘s co-Witnesses be
Let us know Thee, Lord we plead
The Way, The Life and Truth
May we temptation conquer
Unto victory we plead.
ST BARNABBAS

Thou we praise for Barnabbas
Who in love forsaken
Worldly pleasures and treasures
The sublime he thus seek
While the mundane earth groweth
Descend on us Thine spirit
We plead Lord, may Thine comfort
The whole world overwhelm.
ST JOHN THE BAPTIST

Thou we praise for the Baptist
Fore-runner of the lord
Elijah for real is he
Making Jesus way plain
Greatest prophet we hail thee
His blessed morning witness
Make us blessed we plead
Thee As for Thine day we hope.
ST PETER

Thou we praise for Saint Peter
Of them all he's so brave
But in trial denied Him
Thrice in remorse he went
ln fellowship with the priests
To nuture the flock of Christ
Words of courage he giveth
And thus growing in zeal.
ST JAMES

Thou we praise for Thy servant
Who's slain of King Herod
The cup of His sufferings drank
His words He fulfilleth
Let us never in haste be
But patiently waiting still
Rejoicing in all sufferings
If Thou beckon on us.
ST BARTHLOMEUS

Thou we praise for Barthlomeu
The sincere disciple
Who Jesus glory beheld
Beneath the tree of fig
Lord make us sincere we plead
Christian bonafide truly
We plead Thee come dwell with us
And feed our fainting soul.
ST MATTHEW

Thou we praise for Saint Matthew
Who of Thine birth fore-told
Worldly treasures forsaken
The path of life he chose
We plead, our soul deliver
From all earthly desires
To Thine call may we harken
Let's rise and follow Thee.
ST LUKE

Thou we praise for physician
For the gospel he brought
Reveal Thee as Physicran
Co-bearer of our pains
Anoint us for Thine healing
Unto us all our souls Minister
Thine priceless balm
Unto us, all our lives.
ST SIMON & JUDAS

Unto Thine saint disciples
We praise Thee oh our Lord
By Love their souls inspired
Sacred path all to trod
May we thus be inspired
The Lord Jesus exalt
May we in love united
Abode of rest to dwell.
GENERAL ENDING

Apostle, Prophet, Martyr
The Holy band divine
Rending their hymns ceaselessly
Decked in robes white as snow
For all the saints departed
We praise Thee oh Lord our God
Their footsteps towing, troding
Worshipping Thee alone.

Praises to Father above
And unto God the son
Also to Holy Spirit
Sacred Trinity God
Redeemed saints and disciples
Shall bow down before Thee
To Thee all honour and strength
And glory, God to thee.

401.englishTitle: WHEN the trumpet of the Lord

stanzas.text:
WHEN the trumpet of the Lord shall
sound, and time shall be no more
And the morning breaks, eternal,
bright and fair
When the saved of earth shall gather
over on the other shore And the roll
is called up yonder I'll be there.
stanzas.chorus:
When the roll...is called up yon..der
When the roll...is called up yon..der
When the roll...is called up yonder
When the roll is called up yonder,
I’ll be there.

stanzas.text:
On that bright and cloudless  morning
when the dead in Christ shall rise
And the glory of His resurrection share
When His chosen ones shall gather
in their home beyond the skies And the
roll is called up yonder I'll be there.

Let us labour for the Master from the
dawn till setting sun
Let us talk of all His wondrous love
and care. Then, when all of life is over,
and our work on earth is done
And the roll is called up yonder,
I’ll be there.
stanzas.chorus:
When the roll...is called up yon..der
When the roll...is called up yon..der
When the roll...is called up yonder
When the roll is called up yonder,
I’ll be there.

stanzas.text:
BLESS'D are they in Christ abide
All are Joint heirs, one in God
By His precious blood redeem'd
Brought forth all from death to life.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh God; may we worthy be
Here on earth and high above.

stanzas.text:
Justified by grace alone
Are all whom by Christ redeemed
Washed and cleans’d from crimson
stains Shall from judgement all be free.

Fruit of Spirit all they bore
In all righteous works and deeds
Sin and evil they abhor
Word of God in them abide.

Through the shed blood of the
Lamb Joint heirship with God
attain‘d By the Saviour's majesty
Robes of glory they adorn.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh God; may we worthy be
Here on earth and high above.

stanzas.text:
FOR ever with the Lord
Amen, so let it be
Life from the dead is in
that word 'Tis immortality
Here in the body spent,
Absent from Him I roam
Yet nightly pitch my moving tent,
A day’s march nearer home.

My Father’s house on high
Home of my soul, how near
At times to faith's foreseeing eye
Thy golden gates appears
Ah, then my spirit faints
To reach the land I love
The bright inheritance of saints
Jerusalem above.

Yet clouds will intervene
And all my prospects fly
Like Noah's dove, I fly between
Rough seas and stormy skies
And all the clouds depart
The winds and waters cease
While sweetly o'er my gladen’d
heart Expands the bow of peace.

I hear at morn and eve
At noon and midnight how
The choral harm‘nies of heaven
Earth‘s babel‐tongues o’er power
That resurrection word
That shout of victory song
Once more, Forever with the Lord
Amen, so let it be.

LORD who made the seven
Planets And the seven earth below
This world make it to be fifteen
Praise and praises be thy name.
stanzas.chorus:
Wonderful are thy works
And incomprehensible
Wonderful are thy works
And incomprehensible.

stanzas.text:
The bright Sun, the moon and the
Stars Brightens up the earth below
Christ Jesus the Rock of ages
Lightens up the world of woe.

Protection and favour of God
Is the succour of our Band
No evil can on us prevail
By the pow'r of Trinity.

Pregnant shall deliver un hurt
Fruitful shall the barren be
Loss of lives nay be recorded
Death shall not on us prevail.

Source of sea is never explored
Neither is the ocean’s source
Creator of heaven and earth
My source of being ne’er reveal.

Sacred Holy Spirit from high
Holy Michael hath inspire
Against Lucifer he conquer’d
In the battle high above.

Father, Son and Holy Spirit
Trinity in Majesty
We plead harken to our prayers
'Amidst Band of Seraphim.
stanzas.chorus:
Wonderful are thy works
And incomprehensible
Wonderful are thy works
And incomprehensible.

stanzas.text:
COME worship our God Jehovah
Lord of hyper love divine
The conqueror and super victor
King of heaven and of earth.
stanzas.chorus:
Deep and deep is "The Wand"
And in-com-pre-hen-si-ble,
Deep and deep is "The Wand"
And in-com-pre-hen-si-ble.

stanzas.text:
Thus all creatures Thou hath formed
At Thine will all Thou hath made
Affirmative utterer Thou art
None can comprehend Thine being.

Where hath hitherto been no way
There right is my seat be found
By my divine strength and status
Amidst my fold there I dwell.

Can anyone counter my will
When my glorious works are
wrought liven powerful Arch‐Angel
My prowess they never dare.

Lucifer of greater valour
Far above the Angels league
My greatness he dare put to test
Thus my wrath and curse he earned,

Multitude of heavenly hosts
Speaks of my power and strength
My glory, honour and powers
They in awe honour my power.

Greatest of them all I declined
Amongst all Angelic hosts
The Arch Angel Holy Michael
Exalted above the hosts.

Power far above all others
Superior Glory and strength
With all awe And lovingkindness
My nomenclature is love.
stanzas.chorus:
Deep and deep is "The Wand"
And in-com-pre-hen-si-ble,
Deep and deep is "The Wand"
And in-com-pre-hen-si-ble.

stanzas.text:
WE adore/Thee O Lord
Thou head of the church/of Thy
people The Churches here on
earth/and in heaven, Halleluyah!

Thou who died/ and rose for us
Who is with the father/pleading
for us Glory and honour/be to
Thee Halle/lujah!

And on great day/of Pentecost
Thou who sent paraclete/to the
World His comfort is a/biding
with us Halle/lujah!

From Thy throne above/in the sky
Where He's looking/ at His servant
He is coming/for His martyrs
Halle/lujah!

Praises, honour and majesty/to
His name For the death/of His
servants Throughout/the world
at large Halle/lujah!

JERUSALEM on high
My song and city is
My home whenever I die
The centre of my bliss.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh happy place
when shall I be My God,
with Thee to see Thy face
Oh Lord.

stanzas.text:
There dwells my Lord, my King
Judge here unfit in live
There Angels to Him sing
And lowly him age give.

The Patriachs of old
There from their travels cease
The prophets there behold
Their long‘d for Prince of peace.

The Lamb's Apostles there
I might with joy behold
The Harper’s I might hear
Harping on harps of gold.

The bleeding Martyrs, they
Within those cours are found
Clothed in pure robe array,
Their scare with glory crown.

Ah, woe is me that I
In Cedar's tents here stay!
No place like that on high:
Lord, thither guide my way.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh happy place
when shall I be My God,
with Thee to see Thy face
Oh Lord.

stanzas.text:
HARK the heav’ly Angelic HosT
Glory to God they give
And doth the Shepherd
Praise giveth to Him.

In fellowship, the heavenly Hosts
And the twelve heav'nly saints
Cherubim and the Seraphim
Praises, giveth to Him.

Hundred and forty four thousand
The Band of Prophet saints
And them who loves our Saviour
Lord Praises, giveth to Him.

Shout heav'nly Hosts, in roaring voice
Hark the voice, ye of earth
Inspire us with Holy Ghost
Praises we give to Him.

Thus ye members of Cherubim
And ye Seraphim Band
Amidst the earthly wilderness
Praises, giveth to God.

Glory be unto Gracious
God And glory to His Son
Glory be to the Holy Ghost
In heaven high above.

409.englishTitle: WHO are ye who art His

stanzas.text:
WHO are ye, who art His temple
The Lord we have expected
The prophet has for long foretold
And God brings His word to pass
Those who have been redeeemed
shall sing
And praise the Lord with one voice.

In the arms of virgin mother
Behold and see how He sleeps
He it was that the elders served
Before they died
In the faith
Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Behold the king of glory.

Jesus by being lified up
Thou hast all our sorrows borne
Thy great salvation may we see
Thy promise to us fulfil
Thy great glory take us to see
Up to a Holy Father.

Thou the prince of our salvation
Thy goodwill may be our song,
Jesus, all glory be to Thee
For thy work of redemption
With the Father and the Spirit
O Lord God our creator.

410.englishTitle: FOR all Thy saints O Lord

stanzas.text:
FOR all Thy saints, O Lord
Who strove in Thee to live
Who followed Thee, obeyed, adored
Our grateful hymn receive.

For all Thy saints, O Lord
Accept our thankful cry
Who counted Thee their great
reward And strove in Thee to die.

They all, in life and death
With Thee their Lord in view
Learnt from Thy Holy Spirit‘s
breath To suffer and to do.

For this Thy name we bless
And humbly pray that we
May follow them in holiness
And live and die in Thee.

411.englishTitle: THERE is a joyful home eternal

stanzas.text:
THERE'S a joyful home eternal
Beautiful shinning and bright
Where sweet joys are supernal
Never are dim‐med by night
White robed Angels are singing
Ever around the bright throne.
stanzas.chorus:
When, O when shall we see thee
Beautiful Beautiful home,
Home beautiful home,
Bright beautiful home
Bright home of our Saviour
Bright glorious beautiful home.

stanzas.text:
Cherubims and Seraphims all
Let us glorify the Lord
For sparing our lives till today
Glory due to Trinity
Remember the Lord’s coming
To lead us to our Home.

Loudly, loudly, the Lord's calling
We tarry still, heed Him not
The harvest is now ready
Let us now repent from sin
So that Christ may wash us all
For that bright Home prepared.

Those who had fought and had
conquered Arc watching as we fight on
They‘re in the company of the Lamb
There He over them reigneth
No more sorrows there around.
In that home high above.

Will thou not ceaselessly strive on
That thou may reign with the Lord
Where Cherubim and Seraphim,
Abide around Saviour's throne
There is the Saviour's abode
Christ ever to adore.

O! At the blast of the last trump
When to Thy throne we'll appear
The sounding voice may we all hark
The joy of thy Lord; Access!
Cherubim and Seraphim
Come, thy crown oh receive.
stanzas.chorus:
When, O when shall we see thee
Beautiful Beautiful home,
Home beautiful home,
Bright beautiful home
Bright home of our Saviour
Bright glorious beautiful home.

stanzas.text:
THERE is a Blessed Home
Beyond this land of woe
Where trials never come
Nor tears of sorrows flow
Where faith is lost in sight
And patient hope is crowned
And everlasting light
Its glory throws around.

There is a land of peace
Good Angels know it well
Glad songs that never cease
Within its portals swell
Around its glorious Throne
Ten thousand Saints adore
CHRIST, with the FATHER, ONE
and SPIRIT, evermore.

Oh! joy all joys beyond,
To see the LAMB who died
And count each sacred Wound
In Hands, and feet, and Side
To give to Him the praise
Of every triumph won
And sing through endless days
The great things He hath done.

Look up, ye saints of GOD
Nor fear to tread below
The path your SAVIOUR trod
Of daily toil and woe
Wait but a little while
In uncomplaining love
His own most gracious smile
Shall welcome you above.

413.englishTitle: COME let us join our friends

stanzas.text:
COME, let us join our friends above
That have obtained the prize
And on the eagle wings of love
To joys celestial rise.

Let all the saints terrestial sing
With those to glory gone
For all the servant of our King
In earth and heaven, are one.

One family we dwell in Him
One Church, above, beneath
Though now divided by the stream
The narrow stream of death.

One army of the living God
To His command we bow
Part of His host have crossed the
flood And part are crossing now.

Our spirits too shall quickly join
Like theirs with glory crowned
And shout to see our Captain’s
sign To hear His trumpet sound.

O Jesus, be our guard and guide
And when the word is given
Come, Lord of hosts, the waves divide,
And land us safe In heaven.

JERUSALEM, my happy home
Name ever dear to me!
When shall my labours have an
end in joy, and peace, in Thee?

When shall these eyes thy
heaven-built walls
And pearly gates behold
Thy bulwarks with salvation strong.
And streets of shinning gold?

There happier bowers than Eden‘s
bloom Nor sin, nor sorrow know
Blest seats, through rude and
stormy scenes.
I onward press to you.

Why should I shrink at pain and woe
Or feel, at death, dismay?
I've Canaan's goodly land in view
And realms of endless day.

Apostles, martyrs, prophets there
Around my Saviour stood
And soon my friends in Christ below
Will join the glorious band.

Jerusalem, my happy home
My soul still pants for thee!
Then shall my labours have an end,
When I thy joy shall see.

LET me be with Thee where Thou
an My SAVIOUR, my Eternal , Rest!
Then, only, will this longing heart
He fully and for ever blest!

Let me be with Thee where Thou art,
Where spotless Saints Thy Name adore
Then, only, will this sinful heart
Be evil and defiled no more.

Let me be with The where Thou an
Where none can die, where none remove
Where life, nor death, my soul can part
From Thy blest Presence and Thy Love!

WHEN ends earth's long and evil day
This world of misery and of woe
There is a place so bright
No change or decay there to find
No night, but all eternal day
Tell me, will you be there?

It’s pearly gates are closed to sin
No unclean thing shall enter in
To spoil the place so bright
That happy, shinning golden shore
No curse will ever there be found
Tell me, will you be there?

Who will be there the lowly heart
Who served the Lord in godly fear
Who count the world but loss
Those led by the Holy Spirit
Those who walk in the narrow way
They are those to be there.

417.englishTitle: THERE IS a great day coming

stanzas.text:
THERE'S a great day coming
A great day coming
There’s a great day coming by
and by When the saints and the
sinners shall be parted right and left.
stanzas.chorus:
Are you ready for that day to come?
Are you ready? Are you ready
Are you ready
Are you ready for the judgement day.

stanzas.text:
There's a bright day coming
A bright day coming
There’s a bright day coming by
and by But its brightness shall only
come to them that love the Lord
Are you ready for that day to come?

There's a sad day coming,
A sad day coming
There’s a sad day coming by and by
When the sinner shall hear his doom
Depart. I know ye not
Are you ready for that ay to come?
stanzas.chorus:
Are you ready for that day to come?
Are you ready? Are you ready
Are you ready
Are you ready for the judgement day.

stanzas.text:
HEAD of the Church triumphant
We joyfully adore Thee,
Till Thou appear, Thy members here
Shall sing like those in glory
We lift our hearts and voices
With blessed anticipation
And cry aloud, and give to God
The praise of our salvation.

While in affliction's furnace
And passing through the fire
Thy love we praise in grateful lays
Which ever brings us higher
We clap our hands, exulting
In Thine almighty favour
The love divine, that made us Thine
Shall keep us Thine for ever.

Thou dost conduct Thy people
Through torrents of tempation
Nor will we fear, while Thou art near
The fire of tribulations
The world, with sin and satan
In vain our march opposes
By Thee we shall break through them all
And sing the song of Moses.

By faith we see the glory
To which Thou shall restore us
The world despise, for that high prize
Which Thou hast set before us
And, if Thou count us worthy
We each, with dying Stephen
Shall see Thee stand at God's right hand
To call us up to heaven.

OH Paradise, Oh Paradise
Who doth not crave for rest?
Who would not seek the happy land
The mansion of the blest.
stanzas.chorus:
Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light All rapture
through and through
In God's most holy sight?

stanzas.text:
O Paradise! 0 Paradise!
The world is growing old
Who would not be at rest and free
Where love is never cold.

O Paradise! O Paradise!
The weary waiting here
I long to be where Jesus is,
To feel, to see Him near.

Oh Paradise, Oh Paradise,
I want to sin no more
I want to be where Jesus is
UponThy spotless shore.

Oh Paradise, Oh Paradise,
I shall not wait for long
E‘en now the loving ear may catch
Faint fragments of thy song.

Lord Jesus, King of Paradise
Oh keep me in Thy love
and guide me to that happy land
Of perfect rest above.
stanzas.chorus:
Where loyal hearts and true
Stand ever in the light All rapture
through and through
In God's most holy sight?

420.englishTitle: TELL me the same old story

stanzas.text:
TELL me the same old, story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love,
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child;
For I am weak, and weary
And helpless, and defiled.
stanzas.chorus:
Tell me the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

stanzas.text:
Tell me the story slowly,
That I may take it in
That wonderful redemption,
God’s remedy for sin,
Tell me the story often,
For I forget so soon;
The early dew of morning
Has passed away at noon.
stanzas.chorus: Tell me the old, old story...

stanzas.text:
Tell me the story softly
With earnest tones and grave;
Remember, I’m the sinner
Whom Jesus came to save
Tell me the story always,
If you would really be
In any time of trouble
A comforter to me.
stanzas.chorus: Tell me the old, old story...

stanzas.text:
Tell me the old, old story
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear
Yes, and, when that world's glory
Shall dawn upon my soul
Tell me the old, old story
Christ Jesus makes thee whole!
stanzas.chorus:
Tell me the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

stanzas.text:
COME, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
