Cherubim, Seraphim do not ere retreat
While striving further on, the Lord will provide.

When death come calling and the soul depart
Thy words of comfort, our breakthrough
shall bring
When Christ Jesus dwells with, us we fear
no more
And we shall thus chorus, the Lord will provide.

Glory to Father, glory to the Son
Glory be to the Blessed Trinity
By the Power of Creator, of Heaven and earth
Our Jehovah Jireh, the Lord will provide.

STANDING on the promises of Christ my King
Thro' eternal ages let his praises ring
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing
Standing on the promises of God.
stanzas.chorus:
Standing, standing, standing on the
promises of God my Saviour
Standing, standing I’m standing
on the promises of God.

stanzas.text:
Standing on the promises that cannot fail
When the howling storms of doubt and
fear assail
By the living word of God I shall prevail
Standing on the promises of God.

Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord
Bound to Him eternally by love’s strong cord
Over coming daily with the spirit‘s Sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

Standing on the promises l can-not fail
Listening every moment to the Spirit‘s call
Resting in my Saviour as my all in all
Standing on the promises of God.
stanzas.chorus:
Standing, standing, standing on the
promises of God my Saviour
Standing, standing I’m standing
on the promises of God.

528.englishTitle: PRAISE be to Jesus His mercy is free

stanzas.text:
PRAISE he to Jesus His mercy is free
Mercy is free Mercy is free
Sinner that mercy is flowing for thee
Mercy is boundless and free
If thou art willing on Him to believe;
Mercy is free, Mercy is free
Life everlasting thou mayest receive;
Mercy is boundless and free.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus, the Saviour, is seeking for thee
Seekign for thee seeking for thee
Lovingly, tenderly calling for thee
Calling and seeking for thee.

stanzas.text:
Why on the mountain of sin will thou roam
Mercy is free mercy is free,
Gently the spirit is calling thee home
Mercy is boundless and free
Art thou in darkness? Oh!
Come to the light Mercy is free mercy is free
Jesus is waiting, He’ll save you tonight
Mercy is boundless and free.

Think of His goodness;
His patience and love;
Mercy is free Mercy is free!
Pleading thy cause with his Fater above
Mercy is boundless and free
Come, and repenting oh,
Give Him thy Heart Mercy is Free mercy
is free
Give him no longer, but come as thee are
Mercy is boundless and free.

Yes there is pardon for all who believe
Mercy is Free Mercy is free!
Come, and this moment a blessing receive,
Mercy is boundless and free
Jesus is waiting, oh, hear Him proclaim:
Mercy is free Mercy is free,
Cling to his promise, believe on his name
Mercy is buundless and free.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus, the Saviour, is seeking for thee
Seekign for thee seeking for thee
Lovingly, tenderly calling for thee
Calling and seeking for thee.  Amin

529.englishTitle: I GO the poor My poor are with you

stanzas.text:
I GO, the poor, My poor are with you still
And ye may help them when and as ye will.

Such was the legacy Incarnate Love
Bequcath‘d His own before He soar‘d above.

Not gold or jewels, but His poor to claim
Our succour for the sake of His dear name.

No weary burden, but a rich bequest
Whereby who blesses is himself
twice bless'd.

ls it not ours today? Are not the pour
The hungry and thc naked, at our door!

And unto night moans of anguish rise
By day and night from suffers to the skies!

The wounded soul, the broken heart’s distress
To us His servants of the balm of heaven.

And He, who gave Himself for all has given
To us His servants of the balm of heaven.

None are so poor but have some love
to show'r,
On poorer than themselves, and this is pow’r.

This is the worship pure and undefiled
The Father claims of every heav’n born child.

530.englishTitle: OH Lord harken to the barren

stanzas.text:
OH Lord harken to the barren
Like Thou hark unto Hannah
Let not our faith be put to shame
WeThine faithful ones below.
stanzas.chorus:
Harken to me (2ce)
That I  may not ever grief.

stanzas.text:
Thou who harkened to Eliz'beth
Amidst haters and mockers
Birth of John to her a succour
Saying weep not child again.
stanzas.chorus:
Give me succor (2ce)
Before all my enemies.

stanzas.text:
Remember Thine promise of old
And Thy blessing to Noah
Be ye fruitful and multiply
On the surface of the earth.
stanzas.chorus:
Harken to me (2ce)
Thou my Benevolent King.

stanzas.text:
Thou who nay the goat be barren,
Nay flying birds of the sky
Be merciful to Thine image
Bless and fertilize my womb.
stanzas.chorus:
Fertilize me (2ce)
Oh God of my destiny.

stanzas.text:
When l deeply contemplated
l admit, Guilty I am
The canal path I have trodden
Tribulations there I earn.
stanzas.chorus:
Forgive me Lord (2ce)
Thou most gracious God divine.

stanzas.text:
LORD will surely provide
All we may need on earth
The barren shall bring forth
Mothers shall multiply.
stanzas.chorus:
Provision is made for all birds on high
Be courageous, Be courageous
He will provide.

stanzas.text:
Lord will surely provide
Good works for idle hands
Good season in all times
Good sales in our markets.

Lord will surely provide
Plenty in all our years
The buyers shall rejoice
The sellers made happy.

Lord will surely provide
Good health in all our days
The sick will be made whole
Thy dying be revived.

Lord will surely provide
Long lease of useful life
Our Guides the Angels be
No danger shall be seen.

Lord will surely provide
No gain saying the word
For all in Him have faith
A sound and steady Faith.

Lord will surely provide
Wonderful are His works
And even over this
Shall reign with Him above.

Lord will surely provide
Vision to see by all
Poverty shall vacate
Happy forever be.
stanzas.chorus:
Provision is made for all birds on high
Be courageous, Be courageous
He will provide.

532.englishTitle: WE give Thee but Thine own

stanzas.text:
WE give Thee but Thine own
Whate‘er the gift may be
All that we have is Thine alone
A trust, O Lord, from Thee.

May we Thy bounties Lord
As steward thus receive
And gladly, as Thou blessest us,
To Thee our first-fruits give.

O hearts are bruised and dead
And homes are bare and cold
And lambs, for whom the Shepherd bled
Are straying from the fold.

To comfort and to bless
To find a balm for woe,
To tend the lone and fatherless
Is angels' work below.

The captive to release
To God the lost to bring
To teach the way of life and peace,
It is a Christ-like thing.

And we believe Thy word
Though dim our faith may be
Whate'er for Thine we do, O Lord
We do it unto Thee.

OUT of my bondage, sorrow and night
Jesus I come, Jesus I Come
Into thy freedom, gladness and light
Jesus I come to Thee
Out of my sickness into Thy health
Out of my want and into Thy wealth
Our of my sin and into Thyself
Jesus I come to Thee.

Out of my shameful failure and loss
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross
Jesus I come to Thee
Out of earlh‘s sorrows into Thy balm
Out of Iife‘s storms and into Thy calm
Out of distress to jubilant psalm
Jesus I come In Thee.

Out of unrest and arrogant pride
Jesus, I come, Jesus I come
Into Thy blessed will me abide
Jesus I come to Thee
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love
Out of despair into raptures above
Upward for aye on wings like a dove
Jesus I come to Thee.

Out of fear and dread of the tomb
Jesus, I come, Jesus I come,
Into the joy and light of my home
Jesus I come to Thee
Out of the depths of ruin untold
Into the peace of thy sheltering fold
Ever Thy glorious face to behold
Jesus I come to Thee.

534.englishTitle: SEE these ones in white apparel

stanzas.text:
SEE these ones in white apparel
Standing by the river‘s brink
Their back turned to the world and sin
And waiting to be baptised
And expecting
To fufil the Lord’s command.

Behold, how they stand there in fear
But they not of hope bereft
They know that their blessed Saviour
Commanded their immersion
Jordan is cold
But their faith is waxing hot.

'Behold and see, other brethren
Their elders in Jesus Christ
Stretch our hands of love to help then
They have been like them before
At this moment
They rejoice in pard'ning grace.

Go, follow your Saviour and Lord
Behold with the eye of faith
The heavens open: God's spirit
Loudly saying from heaven
These disciples
Are my beloved children.

535.englishTitle: OH God of the Old and aged

stanzas.text:
OH God of the Old and aged
Whom the world regarded as barren
By Thine glory made productive
Thus all foes and haters put to shame.
stanzas.chorus:
Hark to me,
Hark to me,
Hark to me,
Lord God. Omnipotent King. 2ce

stanzas.text:
The aged Thou made a spinster
Sarah's test Thou made testimony
She lives on, no death, nor fading
Father he of help to us today.

Sarah entertained unbelief
Doubting further her fertility
Thence out of her heart she doth laughed
God regarded it not as a sin.

Mightiness of my God doth spread
Such a treat, not ever witnesseth
With all living souls rejoicing
For the conception  of Eliz'beth.

Budding of the maize faileth not
And Budding of millet faileth not
May this maiden oh Lord l plead
Never miss her glorious child from Thee.

Father, Son and Holy Spirit
Nothing is impossible with Thee
Let no witch or wizard obstruct
The gift of glorious child to this maid.
stanzas.chorus:
Hark to me,
Hark to me,
Hark to me,
Lord God. Omnipotent King. 2ce.

536.englishTitle: FOUNTAIN of good Thy love to own

stanzas.text:
FOUNTAIN of good Thy love to own
Our thankful hearts incline
What can we render, Lord, to Thee
When all the world are Thine?

But Thou hast needy brethren here
Partakers of Thy grace
Whose humble name Thou wilt confess
Before God’s awful throne.

In the sad accents of distress
Thy pleading voice is heard
In them mayst be clothed and fed
And visited, and cheered.

Thy face with reverence and with love
We in Thy poor would see
For, while we minister in them
We do it, Lord, to the Thee.

For Father, Son and Holy Ghost
Our God whom we profe-ss
Be Glory, Praise in the Highest
Wor-ld ever wi-th-out end.

537.englishTitle: HEALING  Spirit come down in our midst

stanzas.text:
HEALING  Spirit come down in our midst
Come with all Thy mighly power
Come with Thy glory and honour
Come with all Thy mighty power.
stanzas.chorus:
Heal thy child from sickness
Give him peace forevermore
Give him health in all his flesh
Let his soul be spared in thy hands.

stanzas.text:
HEALING  Spirit come down in our midst
Come forgive Thy Sinful son
Oh descend, Thy son sanctifieth
Receive Oh Lord our supplications

Holy Spirit that raises deads up
Holy Spirit worked with Elijah
Holy Spirit worked with Elisha
Come to us this hour and help us

Holy Spirit that raised cripple
Holy Spirit worked with Peter
Holy Spirit that worked with St John
Come down with Thy gracious power.

Holy Spirit that brings life to man
Holy Spirit worked with Moses
Our Father ORIMOLADE
Come down with thy healing power.
stanzas.chorus:
Heal thy child from sickness
Give him peace forevermore
Give him health in all his flesh
Let his soul be spared in thy hands.

stanzas.text:
Holy Spirit that heals the blind man
Holy Spirit heal diverse disease
Holy Spirit that cleanse the leper
Come down with thy healing power.

Holy Spirit that cure the mad man
Holy Spirit cure foes' stings
Holy Spirit conquers witches wizards
Holy Spirit of peace and joy.
stanzas.chorus:
Heal thy child from sickness
Give him peace forevermore
Give him health in all his flesh
Let his soul be spared in thy hands.

538.englishTitle: THOU art my hiding place O Lord

stanzas.text:
THOU art my hiding-place, O Lord
In Thee I put my trust
Encouraged by Thy holy word
A feeble child of dust
l have no argument beside
l urge no other plea
And ‘tis enough my Saviour died
My Saviour died for me.

When storms of fierce temptation beat
And furious foes assial
My refuge is the mercy-seat
My hope within the veil
From strife of tongues and bitter words
My spirit flies to Thee
Joy to my heart though I affords
My Saviour died for me.

'Midst trials heavy to be borne
When mortal strength is vain
A heart with grief and anguish torn
A body rack'd with pain
Ah! what could give the suff'rer rest
l Bid every murmur flee,
But this the witness in my breast
My Saviour died for me.

And when Thy awful voice commands
This body In decay
And life is last lingering sands
is ebbing fast away
Then, though it be an accents weak
And faint and trembling be
Oh give me strength in death to speak
My Saviour died for me.

REST abound in heaven but nay here on earth
Why O! would I murmour when trials are come
Rest oh my gentle soul, what e'er comes
my way
My sojourn cut to brief to quicken me home.

Not due nor fit for me, to rest here below
And my castle to build here on earth below
I thirst for the mansion not manually built
Hoping for sacred life all devoid of sin.

Even though thorns and weeds, me,
all to sorround
Yet will I not repose my trust on the world
No respite do I seek here on planet earth
Till I unto Jesus, may rest is assured.

Tribulation may rage, my soul not to claim
By the love of Jesus, joyful hymns I'll rend
With His smile, our weeping to joy shall all turn
Just as the whirlwind to disipate the rain.

THE great Physician now Is here
The sympathizing Jesus
He speak the drooping heart to clear
Oh, hear the voice of Jesus.
stanzas.chorus:
Sweetest note in Seraph song
Sweetest name on moral tongues
Sweeters carol ever sung
Is Jesus! blessed Jesus!

stanzas.text:
His name dispel my guilt and fear
No other name but Jesus
Oh, how my soul delights to hear
The precious name of Jesus.

The children too, both great and small
Who love the name of Jesus
May now accept the gracious call
To work and live for Jesus.

And when to the bright world above
We rise to see our Jesus
We'll sing around the throne of love
His name, the name of Jesus.
stanzas.chorus:
Sweetest note in Seraph song
Sweetest name on moral tongues
Sweeters carol ever sung
Is Jesus! blessed Jesus!

stanzas.text:
O Lord my God, on Thee I'll call
I am in pain, O hear my cry
When floods of water o’er me roll
Forbide that my heart should retreat.

Thou Lord art friend of the infirm
To whom shall I make my complaint?
If not to Thee, and only Thee
Who calls the miserable to Him.

Who has e‘er wept to Thee in vain
Has Thou e‘er shunned anyone's cry
Art Thou not the One who promis'd
No one shall e‘er suck Thee in vain.

This could have been my hearts sorrow
That Thou Lord does not answer pray‘r
But Thou has been answ‘ring my pray'rs
O Lord, my helper Thou has been.

I know I am needy and poor
But Thou God will not me forget
He, for whom Jesus ever plead
He from his troubles all is free.

542.englishTitle: THE One who made the blind to see

stanzas.text:
THE One who made the blind to see
And made the simple wise
And He who the light created
For all in darkness dwell.

The One who can give strength and health
To the infirm and sick
And He who can bring back to life
The ones who once were dead.

The One who deliverance bestow'd
And mixed him that did fall
And changed the sorrow of today
To songs and Psalms of praise.

Thou great physician of my  soul
To Thee we our song raise
For ever more, world without end
Thine e’er will be the praise.

BAND of Prayerists be ready
The Cherubim all to meet
Thee Jesus hath calleth and and chose
He hath the world created
All of the earth He invite
This salvation ark to join
To glorious throne, Christ, us lead,
As our days pass bye and bye.
stanzas.chorus:
Bye and bye, Bye and bye. 2ce
Much of work lay down for us
As our days pass bye and bye.

stanzas.text:
Gird on thy loins ye Seraphims
The Cherubims all to meet
Nay let loose thy girdles and bands
The Cherubims all to meet
Lift on high the victory sword
God of Daniel, Hossanah
Christ is come, Halleluyah
As our days pass bye and bye
stanzas.chorus: Bye and bye, Bye and bye...

stanzas.text:
God the Trinity we beseech
Come oh harken to our pray‘rs
Christ Jesus our Saviour is come
Our praise offering to accept
Holy Spirit now descend
May Thine grace with us abide
Much of work lay down for us
As our days pass bye and bye.
stanzas.chorus: Bye and bye, Bye and bye...

stanzas.text:
Bind us all in love, in accord
As our days pass bye and bye
One and all win into the fold
As our days pass bye and bye
All our seedling sown shall brood
Sown at dusk or dawn shall bloom
Strengthen all weaklings and faint
As our days pass bye and bye.
stanzas.chorus:
Bye and bye, Bye and bye. 2ce
Much of work lay down for us
As our days pass bye and bye.

544.englishTitle: IN one of my dreams in the night

stanzas.text:
IN one of my dreams in the night
It was Michael who came to me
I saw that he conquered satan
Glory be to Jesus Christ above
stanzas.chorus:
Let's join the Angels to sing glory
And glory to His Holy name
Who with victory went up to the sky
From victory over the devil
From victory over Satan.

stanzas.text:
The Cherubim and the Seraphim
Be ready put your girdle on
We preach the message of the Lord
We shall never be afraid of foes

We greet all leaders and members
Who every day pray for our progress
May God in His mercy sustain you
The Crown of life to be all your gain

We greet our Blessed praying Father
And elders who with him do the work
May God for ever bless your good works
The Crown of glory to be your gain.
stanzas.chorus:
Let's join the Angels to sing glory
And glory to His Holy name
Who with victory went up to the sky
From victory over the devil
From victory over Satan.

stanzas.text:
DEATH may threaten and rage
Unto sons of the victor
stanzas.chorus:
Be not afraid, fight like salvation
army, stifle Satan.

stanzas.text:
The world threat on and rage
Unto sons of the Victor.

Satan threaten and rage
Unto sons of the victor.

Witches threaten and rage
Unto sons of the victor.

Wizards threaten and rage
Unto sons of the victor.

The foes threaten and rage
Unto sons of the victor.
stanzas.chorus:
Be not afraid, fight like salvation
army, stifle Satan.

stanzas.text:
WE are members of Cherub and Seraph
Band which God descend to the world
We here proclaim great Hallelujah
To Almighty unchangeable Lord,
No witches can ever prevail o’er this
Holy Band!
Lord God is our Protector and director:
We Cherub Seraph shall never give way
to Satan.
stanzas.chorus:
People may mock you
And then proclaim hatred
They may abuse you, And proceed
to curse you.
lf even the do more; In the name of Jesus
Ne’er you mind Ne'er you mind )
Ne‘er you mind, Do the will of God.) 2ce

stanzas.text:
Had Jezebel realized her lone fate
Before Jehu the King of lsrael,
She would never have painted her face
Asking whether peace, peace, peace was come;
enemy of God who was professing to be
in peace
What benefit was there in the practice
of witchcraft “Throw her down“
Immediately for dogs to eat
These are part of what Moses did for us.
We Cherub Seraph shall never give way to Satan.

Nebuchadnezzar king of history
Made an image of gold for worship
Shadrach, Meshack and Abednigo
Refused to worship image of gold
Brethren, burning fiery furnace
became cool water
He who mocked God was forced
to glorify Almighty God of
Shadrack, Meshack and Abednigo
We Cherub Seraph shall never give way to Satan.

Whoever quarrels with is Maker
He’s no doubt Kicking against the thorn
The King of Babel then dreamt a dream
And would never forget the reward
A King eating grass like oxen in his dominion
With hairs grown like eagles feather
and nails like bird claws
Unchangeable God, thy word must be fulfilled
We Cherub Seraph shall never give way to Satan.

Balshazzar the yound king of Babel
Son of King Nebuchadnezzar,
Took God's golden vessels to drink wine
With his princes, wives and concubines
The fingers of Man’s hand
Mene, Mene, Tekel Upharsin
You were weighted but sorry you
had weighed nothing
We Cherub Seraph shall never give way to Satan.

Glory to God our Holy Father,
Glory be to God of Seraphim
Praises and honour to our Maker
Who had called us into cherubim
All those who stand should take heed
to avoid any fall;
The chapters of the dead has
completed in the world;
The struggle of this life is yet in our hands
We Cherub Seraph shall never give way to Satan.

People may mock you
And then proclaim hatred
They may abuse you, And proceed
to curse you.

547.englishTitle: O God of Seraph we beg Thee

stanzas.text:
O God of Seraph we beg Thee
Descend and be in our midst
Send down Thy power of Victory
Unto us Thy children here
Give us grace of salvation
To protect us ere we go
That we may be glad in Thee
We may conquer' enemies.
stanzas.chorus:
It's in vain ‐ (4 times)

All the power of witch annulled.

stanzas.text:
Angel of Victory be near us
Descend and be in our midst
Rise up with your deadly weapons
To fight for this Holy Band
Holy Spirit descend now
For Thy Grace us to protect
That we may rejoice in Grace
And be glad in thy Victory.

Cherubim with their Holy Sword
Descend and be in our midst
Holy Michael is our Captain
Descend and be in our midst
We thy children await Thee
For that pow'r of victory now
Which descent upon Israel
And destroy all enemies.

Oh! God of vict‘ry be near us
Who the Egyptians destroyed
That sank them all in the Red sea
And never to rise again
Desccnd and be in our midst
Let the enemies bow down
Let them fall before thy Sun
That we may trample on them.

Be ye glad all ye my people
In my greatest pow’r given
Shout great Alleluia chorus
Like the children of Israel
Holy Michael has conquered
And has gird us with girdles
Onward with the great fight now
Fight and ever victorious.

I am the EL EL SAHULLA
I am the God of victory
I am Jah Jehovah Hullam
I am God of all ages
Be glad in my bounteous grace
And be thankful every day
I am God Asahola
God who conquers all witches.
stanzas.chorus:
It's in vain ‐ (4 times)
Oh God of victory descend
All the power of witch annulled.

stanzas.text:
WILL your anchor hold in the storms of life?
When the clouds unfold their wings of strife
When the strong tides lift and the cables strain
Will your anchor drift, or firm remain.
stanzas.chorus:
We have an achor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll
Fasten’d to the Rock which cannot move
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour’s love.

stanzas.text:
It is safely moored ‘twill the storm with stand
For ‘tis well secured by the Saviour’s hand
And the cables passed from His heart to mine
Can defy the blast, through strength divine.

It will firmly hold in the straits of fear
When the breakers have told the reef is near
Though the tempter rave and the wild winds blow
Not an angry wave shall our bark o‘erflow.

It will surely hold In the Floods of death
When the waters cold, chill out latest breath
On the rising tide can never fail
While our hopes abide within the veil

When our eyes behold, through the gathering night
The city of gold, our harbour bright
We shall anchor fast by the heavenly shore
With the storms all past for evermore.
stanzas.chorus:
We have an achor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll
Fasten’d to the Rock which cannot move
Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour’s love.

549.englishTitle: WHAT a friend we have in Jesus

stanzas.text:
WHAT a friend we have in Jesus
All our sins and griefs to bear,
What a privilege to carry
Ev’rything to God in prayer
Oh, what peace we often forfeit
Oh, what needless pain we bear
All because we do not carry
Ev’rything to God in prayer.

Have we trials and temptations
ls there trouble anywhere
We should never be discouraged,
Take it to the Lord in prayer
Can we find a friend so faithful
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

Are we weak and heavy laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge
Take it to the Lord in prayer
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee
Take it to the Lord in prayer:
In His arms He‘ll take and shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.

550.englishTitle: WE ARE soldier of the King

stanzas.text:
WE'RE soldier of the King?
Redeem’d and saved by blood
And now enlisted for the war
To fight for Christ the Lord,
In peril oft are we, but joyfully we sing
Our hearts made strong by Him.
Who leads the soldiers of the King.
stanzas.chorus:
We‘re soldiers of the King
His praises we will sing,
And we will serve him loyally
Our great and glorious King.

stanzas.text:
We‘re soldiers of the King
His name we gladly bear
The name once nailed upon the cross
When Christ our King was there
We'll count our losses gain
And welcome every sting
To honour our Lord Jesus name
As soldiers of the King.

We‘re soldiers of the King
With Him we shall appear,
If we with Him shall suffer now
And His rejection share
Then lift His banner high,
For time is on the wing
The crowing day is hast’ning on
For soldiers of the King.
stanzas.chorus:
We‘re soldiers of the King
His praises we will sing,
And we will serve him loyally
Our great and glorious King.

551.englishTitle: YE Band of Scruphim and in diaspora

stanzas.text:
YE Band of Scruphim and in diaspora
Worship the Saviour in spirit and in truth
Stop antagonising, love all in
brotherhood
The call of Christ Jesus Saviour is for all.
stanzas.chorus:
Come let's co-march on. 2ce
Come into the Band of Cherub
and Seraph.
Come let's co-march on. 2ce
Come into Seraph Band,
come redeem thy soul.

stanzas.text:
Right from the creation of this earthly Planet
'Tis recorded that Jesus vanquished Satan
We members of Seraphim will conquer Satan
In the name of God the Blessed Trinity.

The witcth and wizards, have not any Impact
Upon the Band of Seraph and Cherubim
Ye Band of prayerist gird on firmly thy loins
That we may conquer Satan and all his hosts.

Ye Band of Choristers, refine all thine voices
To praise and glorify Saviour Jesus Christ
All our predecessors fought and
conquered Satan
Courageously fight and be victorious too.

The world may go mucking and may
seldom despise
But the Seraphim is conscious of his God
Thou art conscious of God, God is
conscious of thee
Gaze on to Christ Jesus and thou shall conquer.

When all our work shall cease upon
earthly planet
We shall be crowned at the end of our sojourn
Christ Jesus our Saviour, will lead us
to Canaan
Blessed land of promise of the Glorious Lord.
stanzas.chorus:
Come let's co-march on. 2ce
Come into the Band of Cherub
and Seraph.
Come let's co-march on. 2ce
Come into Seraph Band,
come redeem thy soul.

stanzas.text:
REJOICE Cherubim, Seraphim rejoice
For this sacred Band, Father offered us
Greater than the wisdom and the
thought of man
Glory, praises, honour unto Trinity.

Man have no impact on this sacred Band
Be of goodliness, victory thou shall earn
Nay, repose not thine trust upon man, but God
The Lord God Creator, thee not to forget.

Witches have no impact on Seraph Band
Wizard have no im‐pact upon our Band
But act on the statutes commanded of God
Victory shall all be thine, now and ever more.

Cherubs clarion call, but ignored of men
Seraphs clarion call, men yet doth keen not
Excuses are untenable on that day
All men and the Angels shall be all involved.

Almighty Father, harken to my prayers
May I follow Thee till the end of time
Lest I be ashamed at the end of my life
May the voice of commen-dation sound to me.

Then we shall all rend, Halleluyah hymns
Before the great throne of Almighty God
Then Jesus Saviour will beam on us His light
May we never forbid everlasting life.

Glory to Father, glory to the Son
Glory to Holy Ghost, and Trinity
Though the depth of Thine mystery is
hid from man
We shall keep praising Thy name for
ever more.

CHERUBIM and Ye Seraphim
All must be well
If Satan against ye risen
All must be well
Our Captain the Holy Michael
Will destroy all dev'lish planning
Satan will how down before Him
All must be well.

Ye our leaders be not afraid
All must he well
Once our Lord Jesus with us
All must he well
Prayerists all ye our leaders
Mountains shall be render'd to naught
World will never on us prevail
All must be well.

Prayerists Band be ye prepared
All must be well
Jesus shall thee firmly uphold
All must be well
Lift up thy sword of vict'ry high
Nothing else shall thine heart frighten‘d
Satan can ne’er on us prevail
All must be well.

Band of the elders Apostles
All must be well
Band of “Glory of God“ reveal’d
All must be well
Ne‘er be cowards, ne'er be frighten’d
Marching bodly amidst the war
Vict'ry shall by Christ earn for us
All must be well.

Members of Mary, Martha Bands
All must be well
Members of Dorcas, Esther Bands
All must be well
Sing glorious chorus unto God
Lofty strains to God of Daniel
Halle, Halle, Halleluyah
All must be well.

Choristers Band be ye prepared
All must be well
lnstrumemalists in the Band
All must be well
Songs of Moses all ye must rend
In the praises of Sacred Lamb
Halleluyah chorus aloud
All must be well.

Cherubim and Ye Seraphim
All must be well
Death may rage by day and by night
All must be well
As Shedrack and Meshack and as
Abednigo in the furnace
Dev’lish fire will not us consume
All must be well.

Glory be to Father above
All must be well
Glory be to His Holy Son
All must be well
Glory be to Holy Spirit
To Trinity be our praises
By the Pow‘r of God Almighty
All must be well.

554.englishTitle: GOD who harkened to King David

stanzas.text:
GOD who harkened to King David
Over all his enemies,
God who harkened unto Queen Esther
Granting victory o’er Haman. .
stanzas.chorus:
Harken to our prayers King of Mercy
As we humbly call unto Thee
Let not we Thy Children go wretched
Now and never all our lives.

stanzas.text:
Hosannah to the King of Glory
Reverence, honour to our King
Grant unto us Thine Gracious gifts
We may ever worship Thee.

God who harkened unto Hannah
Harken unto the barrens
God who harken unto Sarah
Shower Thine mercies on us.

All we members of Seraphim Band
Of this earthly wilderness
Endow us with Thine Holy Spirit
Reward of crown may we earn.

God who harkened unto Elijah
At the river Jordan's bank
God who harkened unto Moses
At the top of Sinai’s mount

However bright the sun may shine
There exists always dark spots
How fulfilling our lives may be
There exist periods of woe

In one accord we kneel before Thee
Cleanse our hearts of sinfulness
Grant us Thy seven sacred spirits
That our love may ever grow.
stanzas.chorus:
Harken to our prayers King of Mercy
As we humbly call unto Thee
Let not we Thy Children go wretched
Now and never all our lives.

stanzas.text:
BAND of Cherub in procession
Witches and wizards be still!
Band of Seraphim congregates
Glory of Jesus extol
stanzas.chorus:

Ho-ly Michael

Witches never on us prevail

Halleluyah, Halleluyah
May we sing halleluyah
Witches are ever invalid

Solidarity songs we rend
Calling witches to challenge
And wicked demon their patron
In the name of Trinity.

Glory, give to Father above
Give all glory to His Son
Glory, give to Holy Spirit
Glory, give to Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
Ho-ly Michael

Ho-ly Michael
Is the captain of our Band.

stanzas.text:
WE are victors o‘er satan
We are victorious o'er death
The Lord consumed all with fire

stanzas.chorus:
We're victors, we're victors
The Great Victor is now here
Witches and wizards be still
Greatest Victor it now here.

stanzas.text:
We conquer the depth of death
Depth of satan we vanquished
The Lord God hath filled the gap
Grateful we are unto God.

We vanquished all darts of death
Satan’s arrow we vanquished
The Lord hath turned them to vain
We are grateful unto God.

Nay can satan e’er prevail
O’er this sacred Holy Band
Witches, wizards and demons
Trampled on under our feet.

Jehovah us to protect
From all demonic spirit
Holy Michael our captain
ls victorious o’er satan.

Ajjahgommon Bussawuh
Ajjahgommom Butarhi
Holy Jesus hath conquered
We are grateful unto God.

Glad tiddings to us today
Lahhollah, burst into joy
Christ Jesus our great Captain

stanzas.chorus:
We're victors, we're victors

Greatest Victor it now here.

557.englishTitle: O what a wonderful wonderful day

stanzas.text:
O what a wonderful wonderful day
Day I will never forget
After l'd wandered in darkness away
Jesus my Saviour l met
O what a tender compassionate friend
He met the need of my heart
Shadows dispelling with joy I am telling
He made all the darkness depart.
stanzas.chorus:
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul
When at the cross the Saviour made me whole
My sins were wash away And my night was
turned to day
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul.

stanzas.text:
Born of the Spirit with life from above
Into God‘s fam'ly divine
Justified fully thru Calvarys love
O what a standing is mine
And the transaction so quickly was made
When as a sinner I came
Took of the offer of grace He did proffer
He saved me, O praise His dear name.

Now I’ve a hope that will surely endure
After the passing of time
I have a future in heaven for sure
There in those mansions sublime
And it‘s because of that wonderful day
When at the cross I believed
Riches eternal and blessings supernal
From His precious hand I received.
stanzas.chorus:
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul
When at the cross the Saviour made me whole
My sins were wash away And my night was
turned to day
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul.

stanzas.text:
BE not afrightened, Seraphim
All must be well
E‘en thought satan on us rages
All must be well
Christ Jesus our Victor, Captain
Shall the host of satan destroy
Satan shall before Him fallen
All must be well.

E’en though we trod valey of death
All must be well
E’en though death attacks here and there
All must be well
Fear not members of Seraphim
March on as brave soldiers of Christ
Christ our captain the arrow-head
All must be well.

Why? oh why art thou afrightened?
Seraphim Band
When jesus with us abiding
All must be well
Pray on, March on ever forward!
The Cliff shall to plain be ravag'd
Evil shall not overwhelm us
All must be well.

Band of Seraphirn march onward
Amidst the fire
Fire of Satan us not to harm
So ever sure
Victorious Shadrach and Meshach
Abednego in fire furnace
Thus shall we in Jesus conquer
All must be well

Rejoice ye Band of Seraphim
All must be well
Christ Jesus hath conquered satan
So ever sure
Glory, honour to Christ our King
Us hath He redeemeth to life
Libration for us hath He gain
His ma-jes-ty.

559.englishTitle: THEE will I love my strength

stanzas.text:
THEE will I love, my strength, my tower
Thee will I love, my joy, my crown
Thee will I love, with all my power
In all Thy works, and Thee alone
Thee will I love till sacred fire
Fills my whole soul with pure desire.

I thank Thee, uncreated Sun
That Thy bright beams on me have shoned
I thank Thee, who hast overthrown
My foes and heal’d my wounded mind
I thank Thee, whose enlivening voice
Bids my freed heart in Thee rejoice.

Uphold me in the doubtful race,
Nor suffer me again to stray
Strengthen my feet with heavenly grace
Still to press forward in Thy way
That all my powers, with all their might
In Thy sole glory may unite.

Thee will I love, my joy, my crown
Thee will I love, my Lord, my God;
Thee will I love, beneath Thy frown
Or smile- Thy sceptre or Thy rod
What though my flesh and heart decay
Thee shall I love in endless day.

560.englishTitle: JESUS the very thought of Thee

stanzas.text:
JESUS, the very thought of Thee
With sweetness fills the breast
But sweeter far Thy face to see
And in Thy presence rest.

Tongue never spake, ear never heard
Never from heart o’erflow'd
A dearer name, a sweeter word
Than Jesus, Son of God.

O hope of every contrite heart
To penitents how kind
To those who seek how good Thine art
But what to those who find?

Ah, this no tongues can utter, this
No mortal page can show
The love of Jesus, what it is
None but His loved one knows.

Jesus, our only joy be Thou
As Thou our prize wilt be;
Jesus, be Thou our glory now,
And through eternity.

561.englishTitle: HOW sweet the name of Jesus sound

stanzas.text:
HOW sweet the name of Jesus sound
In a believer’s ear
It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds
And drives away his fears.

It makes the wounded spirit whole
And calms the troubled breast
‘Tis manna to the hungry soul
And to the weary rest.

Dear name the rock on which I built
My shield and hiding place
My never failing treasury, filled
With boundless stores of grace.

Jesus my shepherd, husband, Friend
My Prophet, Priest and King
My Lord, my life, my way, my end
Accept the praise I bring.

Week is the effort of my heart
And cold my warmest thought
But when I see thee as Thou art
I’ll praise Thee as I ought.

Till then I would Thy love proclaim
With every fleeting breadth:
And may the music of thy name
Refresh my soul in death.

562.englishTitle: MY blessed Saviour is Thy love

stanzas.text:
MY blessed Saviour, is Thy love
So great, so full, so free?
Behold, I give my love, my heart,
My life, my all, to Thee.

I love Thee for the glorious worth
Which in Thyself I see
I love Thee for that shameful cross
Thou hast endured for me.

Though in the very form of God
With heavenly glory crown’d
Thou would’st partake of human flesh
Beset with troubles round.

Thou wouldst like wretched man be made
In every thing but sin
That we as like Thee might become
As we unlike had been.

Like Thee in faith, in meekness, love
In every beauteous grace
From glory thus to glory changed
As we behold Thy face.

LOVE divine, all loves excelling
Joy of heav’n to earth descend
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling
All Thy faithful mercies crown
Jesus, Thou art all compassion
Pure, unbounded love Thou art,
Visit us with Thy salvation
Enter every trembling heart.

Come, almighty to deliver
Let us all Thy grace receive
Suddenly return, and never,
Never more Thy temple leave
There we would be always blessing
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above
Pray, and praise Thee, without ceasing
Glory in Thy perfect love.

Finish then Thy new creation
Pure and spotless let us be
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restor'd in Thee
Chang'd from glory into glory
Till in heav’n we take our place
Till we cast our crowns before Thee
Lost in wonder, love, and praise.

564.englishTitle: THERE is a name I love to hear

stanzas.text:
THERE is a name I love to hear
I love to sing its worth
It sounds like music in mine ear
The sweetest name on earth.

It tells me of the lamb of God
Who died to set me free
It tells me of His precious blood
The sinner’s perfect plea.

It tells me of a Father‘s smile
Beaming upon His child
It cheers me through this little while
Through, desert, waste, and wild.

Jesus, the name I love so well
The name I love to hear
No saint on earth its worth can tell
No heart conceive how dear.

This name shall shed its fragrance still
Along this thorny road
Shall sweetly smooth the rugged hill
That leads me up to God.

And there with all the blood-bought throng
From sin and sorrow free
I'll sing the new eternal song
Of Jesus' love to me.

565.englishTitle: WE love Thee Lord yet not alone

stanzas.text:
WE love Thee, Lord; yet not alone,
Because Thy bounteous hand
Showers down its rich and ceaseless gifts
On ocean and on land
We praise Thee, gracious Lord, for these
yet not for these alone
The incense of Thy children‘s love
Arises to Thy throne.

We love Thee, Love because when we
Had err’d and gone astray
Thou dist recall our wandering souls
Into the heavenward way
When helpless, hopeless, we were lost
In sin and sorrow‘s night
A guiding ray was granted us
From Thy pure fount of light.

Because, O Lord, Thou loved us
With everlasting love
And sentest forth Thy son to die
That we might live above
Because, when we were heirs of wrath
Thou gavest hopes of heaven
We love because we much have sinn'd
And much have been forgiven.

566.englishTitle: WE sing a song of Thy great love

stanzas.text:
WE sing a song of Thy great love
Almighty and our glorious God
There’s nothing Thy power cannot Vide
Thy goodness endureth for aye.

In love the world He created
And man He made to dwell there in
And have domnion over all
To our creator sing a song.

Tenderly for us doth He care
He feeds and all our needs provides
Without asking ought of our hand
Praise our God the giver of all.

He finds us roaming in darkness
Not knowing how to worship Him
In His love He show’d us the way
Praise His name, our benefactor.

In love Christ Jesus to us grant
Christ, His only begotten Son
He came us to redeem from sin
We praise Thy great love, Saviour Lord.

In love His word to us He sent
And oft Thy love open’d our ears
And establish’d us in the faith
Sing His wonderful grace to us.

Creation is full of Thy love
Our God, King of the universe
All join the chorus of His praise
And sing of the love of our God.

567.englishTitle: HARK my soul it is the Lord

stanzas.text:
HARK, my soul! it is the Lord
Tis thy Saviour, hear His word
Jesus speaks, and speaks to thee
Say, poor sinner, lov’st thou Me?

I delivered thee when bound
And, when bleeding, healed thy wound
Saw thee wand' ring set thee right
Turned thy darkness into light.

Can a woman’s tender care
Cease toward the child she bare?
Yes, she may forgetful be
Yet, will I remember thee.

Mine is an unchanging love
Higher than the heights above
Deeper that the depths beneath
Free and faithful, strong as dear.

Thou shalt see My glory soon
When the work of grace is done
Partner of My throne shalt be
Say, poor sinner, lov’st thou Me?

Lord, it is my chief complaint
That my love is weak and faint
Yet I love Thee, and adore
O for grace to love Thee more.

JESUS, my Lord, my God, my AIl,
Hear me, blest Saviour, when I call
Hear me, and from Thy dwelling place
Pour down the riches of Thy grace.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus my Lord, I Thee adore
Oh make me love Thee more and more.

stanzas.text:
Jesus, too late I Thee have sought
How can I love Thee as I ought
And how extol Thy matchless fame
The glorious beauty of Thy name?

Jesus, what didst Thou find in me
That Thou hast dealt so loving?
How great the joy that Thou hast brought
So far exceeding hope or thought!

Jesus, of Thee shall be my song
To Thee my heart and soul belong
All that I have or am is Thine
And Thou, blest Saviour, Thou art mine.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus my Lord, I Thee adore
Oh make me love Thee more and more.

stanzas.text:
MORE love to Thee, O Christ more
love to Thee
Hear thou the prayer I make on
bended knee
This is my camest plea
More love Oh! Christ to Thee
More love to Thee
More love to Thee.

Once earthly joy, l craved, sought
peace and rest
Now thee alone I seek, give what is best
This all my prayer shall he
More love Oh! Christ to Thee
More love to Thee
More love to Thee.

Let sorrow do its work, sent grief and pain
sweet are thy messengers, sweet their refrain
When they can sing with me
More love O Christ to thee
More love to Thee
More love to Thee.

Then shall my latest breath, whisper thy praise
This be the parting cry my heart shall raise
This still its pray’r shall be
More love, O Christ to thee
More love to Thee.

570.englishTitle: HE gave to me a seal

stanzas.text:
HE gave to me a seal
Of the great debt I owe
And as He gave, He smiled and said
Always, remember Me.

He gave to me a seal
All of my debts He paid
And as He gave, He smiled and said
‘Always, remember Me.

I shall treasure the seal
Though, the debts is all paid
The seal told of the love of One
Who paid the debt for me.

I looked at it and smiled
Again, I looked and wept
The earnest of His love for me
I’ll ever treasure it.

It is more than a seal
It is in remembrance
That all the debt of sin was paid
By Lord, Emmanuel.

571.englishTitle: WHEN this passing world is done

stanzas.text:
WHEN this passing world is done
When has sunk you glaring sun
When we stand with Christ on high
Looking o’er life’s history
Then, Lord, shall I fully know
Not till then, how much I owe.

When I stand before the throne
Dress‘d in beauty not my own
When I see Thee as Thou art
Love Thee with unsinning heart;
Then Lord, shall I fully know
Not till then, how much I owe.

When the praise of heav‘n I hear
Loud as thunders to the ear
Loud as many water‘s noise
Sweet as harps melodious voice
Then, Lord, shall I fully know
Not till then, how much I owe.

Ev’n on eath, as though a glass
Darkly, let Thy glory pass
Make forgiveness feel so sweet
Make Thy Spirit’s help so meet
Ev’n on earth, Lord, make me know
Something of how much I owe.

Chosen not for good in me
Waken’d up from wrath to flee
Hidden in the Saviour’s side
By the Spirit sanctified
Teach me, Lord, on earth to show
By my love, how much I owe.

572.englishTitle: JESUS Lord we look to Thee

stanzas.text:
JESUS Lord, we look to Thee
Grant our accord in Thy name
Thou our gracious Prince of Peace
End all strife within our rank.

By Thy making peace, O Lord
Take away all stumbling block
Let us be in one accord
Make us all Thy good soldiers.

Let us be in one accord
Show mercy and love to all
And be meek in heart and though
Like our Saviour, Jesus Christ.

Let us be in one accord
Bearing another's burden
Show example to the flock
How believers ought to live.

Let us put away anger
And rest our hearts on the Lord
Speak of His love, deep and wide
And His high and holy life.

BRETHREN let us walk together
In love and the peace of God
Ought we to begin to question
Whether we should cease all strife
ln communion, sweet communion
Will our love and joy increase.

As we make our journey homeward
Let us help ourselves along
Our foes encircle us around
Sources are laid out on our way
Our duty is duty is
Each others burden to bear.

When we think of what God has done
In forgiving o‘er and o’er
Brethren ought we not tutored be
Striving should be set aside
Let us avoid let us avoid
All the anger and the strife.

Let us seek our brother's honour
More than we would seek our own
Let us leave all spoil and hatred
And our hearts be filled with love
'Twill be sweeter, 'twill be sweeter
lf we‘re in oneness on earth.

574.englishTitle: BLEST be the dear uniting love

stanzas.text:
BLEST be the dear uniting love
That will not let us part
Our bodies may far off depart
We still are one in heart.

Joined in one spirit to our head
Where He appoints we go
And still in Jesus footsteps tread
And show His praise below.

O may we ever walk in Him
And nothing know beside
Nothing desire nothing esteem
But Jesus crucified!

Closer and closer let us cleave
To His beloved embrace
Expect His fullness to receive
And grace to answer grace.

575.englishTitle: HAPPY the heart where graces reign

stanzas.text:
HAPPY the heart where graces reign
Where love inspires the breast
Love is the brightest of the train
And perfect all the rest.

Cherubim in heaven above
And Sacred Scraphim
Around the Holy throne surround
Offering praises to God.

Knowledge alas! tis all in vain
And all in vain our fear
Our stubborn sins will fight and reign
If love be absent there.

Tis love that makes our cheerful feet
In swift obedience move
The devil knew, and tremble too
But Satan cannot love.

This is the grace that lives and sings
When faith and hope shall cease
Tis this shall strike our joyful strings
In the sweet realm of bliss.

Before we quite forsake our clay
Or leave this dark abode
The wings of love bear us away
To see our gracious God.

Jehovah Nissi our Father
Claim us Thine all to be
Holy Spirit the sacred dove
Lead us, pathway of life.

Jehovah Ruphy our Father
Strengthen our feeble frames
May we in accord the Lord praise
As though the Saints above.

576.englishTitle: ONE there is above all others

stanzas.text:
ONE there is above all others
Oh, how he loves!
His love is beyond a brother’
Oh! how He loves!
Earthly friends may fail and leave us
One day soothe, the next day grieve us
But this Friend will ne’er deceive us
Oh! how He loves.

‘Tis eternal life to know Him,
Oh, how He loves!
O Think how much we owe him
Oh how He loves!
With His precious blood He bought us
In the Wilderness He sought us
To his fold He safely brought us,
Oh, how He loves.

We have found a friend in Jesus
Oh, how he loves!
‘tis His great delight to bless us
Oh, how he loves!
How our hearts delight to hear him
Bid us dwell in safety near Him
Why should we distrust or fear him
Oh, how He loves.

Through His name we are forgiven
Oh, how He loves!
Backward shall our foes be driven
Oh, how He loves!
Best of blessings He'll provide us
Nought but good shall e’er betide us
Safe to glory He will guide us
Oh, how He loves.

577.englishTitle: DEEPER deeper in the love of Jesus

stanzas.text:
DEEPER, deeper, in the love of Jesus
Daily let me go
Higher, higher in the school of wisdom
More of grace to know.
stanzas.chorus:
O deep...er yet l pray...
And high..er every day...
And wis...er, blessed Lord
In Thy precious, holy word.

stanzas.text:
Deeper, deeper! blessed Holy Spirit
Take me deeper still
Till my life is wholly lost in Jesus
And His perfect will.

Deeper, deeper! though it cost hard trials
Deeper let me go!
Rooted in the holy love of Jesus
Let me fruitful grow.

Deeper, higher every day in Jesus
Till all conflict past
Finds me conqu'ror, and in His own image
Perfected at last.
stanzas.chorus:
O deep...er yet l pray...
And high..er every day...
And wis...er, blessed Lord
In Thy precious, holy word.

stanzas.text:
LOVE him who‘s thy neighbour
The Lord’s command it is
Perfect example, Himself made
By the way us He lov‘d.

Love him who‘s thy neighbour
Be it in war or peace
All our foes us He taught to love
Evil with good repay.

Love him who's thy neighbour
The Lord's voice trumpets still
Ought all of us, so to prepare
Our neighbours all to love.

Love him who‘s thy neighbour
All in next portal dwells
Thine mockers, haters, friends and foes
And all with thee relate.

Love him who's thy neighbour
As Christ Jesus, us lov'd
Sore accussers and foes He Iov'd
All He cherish'd and bless'd.

IN tenderness He sought me
Weary and sick with sin,
And on his shoulders brought me
Back to his fold again
While angels in his presence sang
Until the courts of heaven sang.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh, the love that sought me!
Oh the blood that bought me!
Oh the grace that brought me to
the fold Wandrous grace that
brought me to the fold.

stanzas.text:
He found me bruised and dying,
And pour’d in oil and wine
He whisper’d to assure me
I’ve found thee thou are mine!
I never heard a sweeter voice!
It made my aching heart.

I’m sitting in his presence
The sunshine of his face,
While with adoring wonder
His blessings l retrace;
It seems as if eternal days
Are fare too short to sound His praise.

So while the hours are passing
All now is perfect rest,
I'm waiting for the morning
The brightest and the Best,
When he will call us to his side
To be with Him, His spotless bride.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh, the love that sought me!
Oh the blood that bought me!
Oh the grace that brought me to
the fold Wandrous grace that
brought me to the fold.

stanzas.text:
CHERUBIM and ye Seraphim
Abide in love within
As doth the saints in high above
Who in love abideth.
stanzas.chorus:
Let us repose our trust in Christ
Holy and sacred King
Hence I in Jesus' love abide
Ne'er will I be destroyed.

stanzas.text:
Num‐ber-less foes around us here
No worthy confidant
Jesus wonderful Counsellor
He‘s our worthy Saviour

Satan our greatest enemy
Hath us to lead astray
Feeble, frail and weak all we are
Christ Jesus is our strength.

Christ Jesus hath conquered satan
On the calvary mount
Oh Lord! our strength and victory be
Our foes we may conquer.

O! God of Ori-mo-lade
Thine mercy all we plead
Over our foes, vic-tory grant
All our ways, all our lives.

When death shall come, and o‘er us roll
Our heart make whole and clean
Thou Jesus Christ, Thou we may see
At the bossom of God.

We hail thee, Father Spiritual
Prompted by God above
May Christ Jesus, his help to be
Exalted may he be.

Jehovah Ruphy, our Father
Harken to us we plead
Holy Jehovah Jireh God
Our feet do establish.

Ye members of Prayen'st
Band Work harder, ne’er weary
Love one and all and everyone
Father shall hark thy plea.

Glory be to Father above
Glory be to His Son
Glory be to the Holy Ghost
Eternal Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
Let us repose our trust in Christ
Holy and sacred King
Hence I in Jesus' love abide
Ne'er will I be destroyed.

581.englishTitle: THERE is not a friend like the lowly Jesus

stanzas.text:
THERE'S not a friend like the
lowly Jesus
No not one! No not one!
None else could heal all our
souls' diseass
No not one! No not one!
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus knows all about our struggles
He will guide till the day is done;
There ’s not a friend like the lowly Jesus
No not one! No not one!

stanzas.text:
No friend like Him is so high and holy
No, not one! No not one!
And yet no friend is so meek and lowly
No, not one! No not one!

There's not an hour that He is not
near us,
No, not one! No not one!
No night so dark but his
love can cheer us
No, not one! No not one!

Did every Saint find this Friend,
for sake him?
No not one! No not one!
Or sinners find that he would not
take him?
No not one, no not one.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus knows all about our struggles
He will guide till the day is done;
There ’s not a friend like the lowly Jesus
No not one! No not one!

stanzas.text:
BEHOLD how pleasant for brethren
In unity to dwell
Kits, Kins whose hearts in one accord
In fellowship with Thee.

When stream of love from Christ doth flow
In every heart it glows
The blissful peace of God that blows
Protects comfort and cares.

Like precious balm and ointment sweet
On Aaron's beard that drop
Floe'd on his skirt as for the scoop
Perfume’ry like the rose.

Pleasant and cool like morning dew
That on Zion descends
There God, His glory great reveal‘d
His loving grace bestow‘d.

MORE holiness give me,
more strivings within
More patience in suffering,
more sorrow for sin,
More faith in my Saviour,
more sense of His care
More joy in His Service,
more purpose in prayer.

More gratitude give me,
more trust in the Lord
More zeal for His glory,
more hope in His word,
More tears for His sorrows,
more pain for His grief
More meekness in trial,
more praise for relief.

More purity give me,
more strength to o’er come
More freedom from earth stains,
More longing for home
More meet for Thy Kingdom,
O Lord would I be More fruitfitl more
holy more Saviour, like Thee.

AND dost Thou say, Ask what thou wilt?
Lord, I would seize the golden hour
I pray to be released from guilt
And freed from sin and Satan’s pow’r.

More of Thy presence, Lord, impart
More of Thine image let me bear
Erect Thy throne within my heart
And reign without a rival there.

Give me to read my pardon seal’d
And from Thy joy to draw my strength,
To have Thy boundless love reveal’d
Its height, and depth, its breath and length.

Grant these requests, I ask no more
But to Thy care the rest resign
Living or dying, rich or poor
All shall be well if Thou art mine.

AMAZING grace! how sweet thesound
That saved a wretch like me
I once was lot, but now am found
Was blind, but now I see.

‘Twas grace that taught my heart to fear
And grace my fears relieved,
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed!

Through many danger, toil, and snares
l have already come,
‘Tis grace that brought me safe thus far
And grace will lead me home.

Yes, when this heart and flesh shall fail,
And mortal life shall cease
I shall possess within the veil
A life of joy and peace.

586.englishTitle: THE roseate hues of early dawn

stanzas.text:
THE roseate hues of early dawn
The brightness of the day
The crimson of the sunset sky
How fast they fade away!
O for the pearly gates of heav'n
O for the golden floor!
O for the Sun of Righteousness
That setteth nevermore!

The highest hopes we cherish here
How fast they tire and faint!
How many spot defiles the robe
That wraps an earthly saint
O for a heart that never sins!
O for a soul wash’d white!
O for a voice to praise our King
Nor weary day or night.

Here faith is ours, and heav’nly hope
And grace to lead us high
But there are perfections and peace
Beyond our best desire
O by Thy love and anguish, Lord
And by Thy life laid down
Grant that we fall not fromThy grace
Nor cast away our crown!

587.englishTitle: JESUS I my cross have taken

stanzas.text:
JESUS I my cross have taken
All to leave, and follow Thee
Destitute, despis'd, forsaken
Thou from hence my All shall be
Perish every fond ambition
All I've sought, or hop’d, or known,
Yet how rich is my condition!
God and Heav'n are still my own!

Man may trouble and distress me,
‘Twill but drive me to Thy breast
Life with trials, hard may press me,
Heav‘n will bring me sweeter rest
Oh! ‘tis not in grief to harm me
While Thy love is left to me!
Oh! 'twere not in joy to charm me,
Were that joy unmixed with Thee!

Take, my soul, thy full Salvation
Rise o’er sin and fear and care
Joy to find in every station
Something still to do or bear
Think what Spirit dwells within thee!
What a Father's smile is thine!
What a Saviour died to win thee!
Child of Heav'n, shouldst thou repine.

Haste then on from grace to glory
Arm'd by faith, and wing'd by pray'r
Heav’n's Eternal Day‘s before thee
God’s Own Hand shall guide thou there!
Soon shall close thy earthly mission
Swift shall pass thy pilgrim days
Hope will soon change to glad fruition
Faith to sight, and pray’r to praise.

NEARER, my God to Thee
Nearer to thee,
Even though it be a cross
That raiseth me
Still all my song shall be
Nearer my God to Thee
Nearer to thee.

Though night steal over me
My rest a stone
As o’er the Patriarch
Weary and lone
Yet in my dreams I’d be
Nearer my God to thee
Nearer to thee.

There let the way appear
Steps unto heaven
All that thou sendest me
In mercy given
Angels to beacon me
Nearer my God to thee
Nearer to thee.

Then, all my waking thoughts
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of the stony rock
Bethel I’ll raise
So by my woe to be
Dearer, my God to thee
Nearer to thee.

Till in my Father’s House
Perfectly blest
After my journeying
Safe and at rest
All my delights shall be
Ever, my God, with Thee
Ever with Thee.

THOU art the Way: to Thee alone
From sin and death we flee
And he who would the Father seek
Must seek Him, Lord by Thee.

Thou an the Truth, Thy word alone
True wisdom can impart
Thou only canst inform the mind
And purify the heart.

Thou art the Life: the rending tomb
Proclaims Thy conqu'ring arm
And those who put their trust in Thee
Nor death nor hell shall harm.

Thou art the Way, the Truth, the Life
Grant us that Way to know
That Truth to keep, that Life to win
Whose joys eternal flow.

590.englishTitle: JESUS calls us! o‘er the tumult

stanzas.text:
JESUS calls us! o‘er the tumult
Of our life's wild restless sea
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth,
Saying: Christian. follow Me.

As, of old, apostles heard it
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home and toil and kindred,
Leaving all for His dear sake.

Jesus calls us from the worship
Of the vain world’s golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying: Christian, love Me more!

In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still he calls, in cares and pleasures,
That we love Him more than these.

Jesus calls us! By Thy mercies,
Saviour, make us hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thine obedience,
Serve and love The best of all.

591.englishTitle: HEAVENLY Father l want to be

stanzas.text:
HEAV'NLY Father l want to be
In holiness and In truth
But the love of flesh attacks me
Deceiving me everyday.

I am but a feeble creature
In my spirit and body
All my frequent sins committed
Now a burden press’d me down.

There is one command in my heart
Which Thou inserted in me
For this reason I will follow
Thy love and Thy holy laws.

Even if I want to be good
I will stray immediately
Thy word is always good to me
But evil, I do always.

Many times I permit my soul
To satan for temptation
Even though Thy word has warn'd me
To depart from all my sins.

Father above, Thou and Just Thou
My salvation, Thy arm art
Blessed Saviour hath Thou sendeth
To Him alone l' eleaveth.

Lead Thou me with Holy Spirit
To the new and wholesome path
Teach me, watch me and lead me on
Thou Spirit of Most High God.

ACCORDING to thy gracious word,
In meek humility
This will I do, my dying Lord,
I will remember thee.

Thy body, broken for my sake
O! bread from heaven shall be
Thy testamental cup l take
And thus remember thee.

Gethsemane can I forget?
O! there thy conflict see
Thine agony and bloody sweat
And not remember thee?

Remember Thee, and all thy pains
And all thy love to me
Yea, while a breath, a pulse remains
Will I remember thee.

And when these failing lips grow dumb
And mind and mem’ry flee,
When thou shall in thy Kingdom come,
Jesus, remember me.

593.englishTitle: JESUS Thou Joy of loving heart

stanzas.text:
JESUS, Thou Joy of loving heart,
Thou Fount of life, Thou Light of men
From the best bliss that earth imparts
We turn unfilled to Thee again.

Thy truth unchanged hath ever stood
Thou savest those that on Thee call
To them that seek Thee Thou an good
To them that find Thee, all in all.

We taste Thee, O Thou Living Bread,
And long to feast uponThee still
We drink of Thee, the Fountain-head,
And thirst our soul from Thee to fill.

Our restless spirit yearn for Thee
Where'er our changeful lot is cast
Glad when Thy gracious smile we see
Blest when our faith can hold Thee fast.

O Jesus, ever with us stay
Make all our moments calm and bright
Chase the dark night of sin away;
Shed O'er the world Thy holy light.

594.englishTitle: ALL the night at the dusk of woe

stanzas.text:
ALL the night, at the dusk of woe
When hade erupteth in its strength
Unto Wonderful, Son of God
Gift of victory against His foe.

Ere commence His passton and strife
The bread He offereth, art though blessed
Thou who Thine work in all art love
Hark His word spoken art of grace.

His sacred flesh offered for sin
Partake, oh, bread of life it be
The sacred wine He gavest thee
This art my covenant, my blood.

This He commandeth do till aye
In mem’ry of thy sacred friend
Whence thou shall meet, recall to thee
Thy departed God is but love.

Christ Jesus Thy commands our Joy
Thine redemptive death, hymns reveal
Ere Thou cometh hither below
Supper we shall with Thee partake.

595.englishTitle: OH blessed lamb divine of God

stanzas.text:
OH blessed lamb divine of God
Cleanse me with Thine blood Lord I plead
Let me alone Thine will to know
Pain is sweet and death hath reward.

Lift up my soul from earth away
Let it be Thine for ever Lord
Fill into my heart Lord Thine seal
The seal of life for ever more.

Ah! How great is their joy Oh Lord
Whose refuge is Thine riven side
In thee hath they, their power and strength
In Thee Oh Lord they dine and wine.

It is of great surprise oh God
That by grace Thine glory we earn
By Thine adoption we are crowned
To wallow in eternal bliss.

Father we plead, may we rethink
Thine wonderous works to appreciate
At liberty, our tongues to set
May we speak often of Thine love.

Christ Jesus Lord Thou art our head
To Thee shall we reverendly bow
To Thee shall we render our soul
In death, in life let us be Thine.

596.englishTitle: O ye friends and all our neighbours

stanzas.text:
O ye friends and all our neighbours
Come in before the house of joy is full
All mankind Christ hail thee to quickly come
Come join this Band of Salvation before its full.
stanzas.chorus:
Came quickly, come enter)
Christ loudly hail on thee). 3ce
Come in before the Noah’s Ark
to brim is fill’d.

stanzas.text:
All ye the band of Church of God on earth
Heathens, Muslims and Idol worshippers
All mankind Christ Hail to quickly come
Come join this band of salvation before its full.

African church and all (the) foreign churches
All worshippers of God in Christian Way
Jesus our Lord is loudly calling you
Come join this band of salvation before it's full.

The God of Shedrack loudly calling you
The God of Meshack loudly calling you
The God of Abednigo calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it‘s full.

The God of Abraham loudly calling you
The God of Isaac loudly calling you
The God of Jacob loudly calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it’s full.

The God of David loudly calling you
The God of Daniel loudly calling you
God of, Bathimeaus loudly calling you
Come join this band of salvation before it‘s full.

The God of Mary loudly calling you
The God of Martha loudly calling you
The God of Esther loudly calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it's full.

Cherub Seraphim loudly calling you
The God of Israel loudly calling you
Angels of Heaven loudly calling you
Come join this Band of salvation before it‘s full.
stanzas.chorus:
Came quickly, come enter)
Christ loudly hail on thee). 3ce
Come in before the Noah’s Ark
to brim is fill’d.

stanzas.text:
COME holy ghost descend from high
Baptizer of our soul art Thou
The sacramental seal apply
And witness with the water now.

Pour faith thy energy divine
And sprinkle the atoning blood
May Father, Son and Spirit join
To seal this child a Son of God.

ALMIGHTY Father, hear our cry
As o‘er the traekless deep we roam
Be Thou our haven always nigh
On homeless waters Thou our home.

O Jesus, Saviour, at Whose Voice
The tempest sank to perfect rest
Bid Thou the mourner’s heart rejoice
And cleanse and calm the troubl’d breast.

O Holy Ghost, beneath, Whose pow-'r
The ocean woke to life and light
Command Thy blessing in this hour
Thy fost‘ring warmth, Thy quick’ning night.

Great God, Truine Jehovah, Thee
We love, we worship, we adore
Our Refuge on time’s changeful sea
Our Joy on Heav‘n Eternal shore.

599.englishTitle: BAND of Seraph look to the flag

stanzas.text:
BAND of Seraph look to the flag,
Triumphantly fly
Jesus Army will soon be here
We shall soon conquer.
stanzas.chorus:
Rise The Praying Father Rise up
Jesus select thee
We thy children ever ready
We shall never fear.

stanzas.text:
Lo! satan with host approaching
Michael, them dislodged
The vailent ones are all fallen
Seraph stifle them.

Jesus Saviour speaketh to us
Lo! behold I come
Gladly we flash a response down
Rise up and conquer.

When the fight is fierce and dangerous
He says do not fear
Holy Michael valiant Captain
His sword straightly drawn.

See the flag of Jesus flying
Trumpet loudly sounds
All our foes will Moses conquer
By The Name of Christ.
stanzas.chorus:
Rise The Praying Father Rise up
Jesus select thee
We thy children ever ready
We shall never fear.

stanzas.text:
JESUS, still lead on
Till our rest be won
And, although the way be cheerless
We will follow calm and fearless,
Guide us by the hand
To our Fatherland.

If the way be drear
If the foes be near
Let not faithless fears o’ertake us
Let not faith and hope forsake us
For through many a foe
To our home we go.

When we seek relief
From a long-felt grief
When oppress’d by new temptations
Lord, increase and perfect patience
Show us that bright shore
Where we weep no more.

Jesus, still lead on
Till our rest be won
Heavenly Leader, still direct us
Still support, console, protect us,
Till we safely stand
In our Fatherland.

601.englishTitle: JESUS is Head of Seraph Band

stanzas.text:
JESUS is Head of Seraph Band
We need not be affrightened
He captains the boat of our lives
We need not be affrightened.
stanzas.chorus:
We need not fear
But filled with joy
For Jesus shall captain our boat
How serious condition may be
We shall safely land unhurt.

stanzas.text:
All we in boat of Christ Jesus
Look unto Saviour only,
Respose implicit faith in Him
He shall land us in safety.

Lord Jesus Saviour whose command
Quietened the waves of sea
Thou who traversed over the sea,
And slept as if unconcerned.

What is the cause of all your fears?
Ye, Army of Christ Jesus
Jesus who dwellest in our boat
Shall make us laugh at all waves.

When waves of troubled world shall come
All over sea and on land
There is an assuring shelter
That cometh from Christ Jesus.

From the world's lions and leopards,
From claws of wild enemies
Christ Jesus shall keep his elects,
Jesus shall protect his own.

God, the Three in one, one in Three
Trinity, shelter us all;
On all troubles and temptations
Make us shout Hallelujah.

Glory to Our Holy Father
Glory to His Holy Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit
All praises to Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
We need not fear
But filled with joy
For Jesus shall captain our boat
How serious condition may be
We shall safely land unhurt.

602.englishTitle: GUIDE me O Thou Great Jehovah

stanzas.text:
GUIDE me, O Thou Great Jehovah
Pilgrim through this barren land:
I am weak, but Thou art mighty
Hold me with Thy powerful hand;
Bread of heaven, (2ce)
Feed me till I want no more.

Open now the crystal fountain
Whence the healing stream doth flow
Let Thy fire and cloudy pillar
Lead me all my journey through
Strong deliverer, (2ce)
BeThou still my strength and shield.

When I tread the verge of Jordan
Bid my anxious fear subside
Death of deaths and hell’s destruction
Land me safe on Zion side
Songs of praises (2ce)
I will ever give to Thee.

603.englishTitle: WE are the light of the world

stanzas.text:
WE are the light of the world
Cherubim Seraphim
The city set on the rock
How can it for ever be hidden.
stanzas.chorus:
Let's do God's work
Let's do God's work
Let's do God's work
To receive salvation at the end.

stanzas.text:
Listen attentively now
Jesus love words to you
Asking you in aloud voice
Oh my son tell me if thou lovedst me.

Cherubim and Seraphim
Go ye to all the world
Preach ye the Holy Gospel
All who ever hear will be redeemed.

Oh friends and all our neighbors
Join ye this Holy Band
Sent down to us by our God
Come ye quickly before its too late.

Remember ye Noah’s day
When man was deep in pleasures
That only beast join the Ark
Leaving the Son of mankind in regret.

Wordly pleasure will vanish
Lot's wife a lesson be
Seek Salvation of your soul
And shall ye regret at the end.

Father, of help be to us
Thine will may be observe
At the end, the voice may sound
Cherubim Seraphim dorn the crown.
stanzas.chorus:
Let's do God's work
Let's do God's work
Let's do God's work
To receive salvation at the end.

604.englishTitle: THANKS we offer unto the Lord

stanzas.text:
THANKS we offer unto the Lord
Fe‐li‐cita-te with me
For journey mercies I received
Thanks be to Thee oh Lord.

Cherubim and the Seraphim
Glory give to His name
To Him who this Band established
King of glory He is.

Rejoice and chorus glorious hymns
To Jesus glorious King
His name is spread all o’er the earth
He took me to and fro.

Thanks is due unto Thee oh Lord
Thine protection on me
Through and around the universe
To Thine name glory be.

Proclaim Him all around the world
Come-on come-on my Lord
Our Holy and Eternal King
The sacred Trinity.

Rend to Him glorious holy songs
Thanks be unto the Lord
In peace we journeyed to and fro
I give thanks Lord to Thee.

Shout unto Him Halleluyah
To God of Cherubim
Shout unto Him Halleluyah
To God of Seraphim.

CHRISTIAN seek not yet repose
Hear Thy guardian angels say
Thou an in the midst of foes
“Watch and pray".

Principalities and power
Mustering their unseen array
Wait for thy unguarded hours
“Watch and pray”.

Gird thy heavenly armour on,
Wear it every night and day
Ambush'd lies the evil one
“Watch and pray”.

Hear the victors who o‘ercame
Still they mark each warrior’s way
All with one sweet voice exclaim
“Watch and pray".

Hear above all, hear thy Lord
Him thou lovest to obey,
Hide within thy heart His word
“Watch and pray”.

Watch as if on that alone
Hung the issue of the day
Pray that help be descend down
“Watch and pray".

I am a stranger here
Heav’n is my Home
Earth is a desert drear
Heav’n is my Home
Danger and sorrow stand
Round me on every hand
Heav’n is my Fatherland
Heav'n is my Home.

What though the tempest rage
Heav’n is my Home
Short is my pilgrimage
Heav’n is my Home
And time’s wild wintry blast
Soon will be over passed
I shall reach Home at last
Heav‘n is my Home.

There at my Saviour’s side
Heav’n is my Home
I shall be glorified
Heav’n is my Home
There are the good and blest
Those I love most and best
And there I too shall rest
Heav’n is my Home.

Therefore I murmur not
Heav’n is my Home
Whate’er my earthly lot
Heav’n is my Home
And I shall surely stand
There at my Lord's right Hand
Heav’n is my Fatherland
Heav’n is my Home.

607.englishTitle: LEAD us heav’nly Father lead us

stanzas.text:
LEAD us, heav’nly Father, lead us
O’er the world’s tempestuous sea
Guard us, guide us, keep us, feed us
For we have no help but Thee
Yet possessing every blessing
If our God our Father be.

Saviour, breathe forgiveness o'er us
All our weakness Thou dost know
Thou didst tread this earth before us
Thou didst feel its keenest woe
Lone and dreary, faint and weary
Through the desert Thou didst go.

Spirit of our God, descending
Fill our hearts with heavenly joy
Love with every passion blending
Pleasure that can never cloy
This provided, pardon’d guided,
Nothing can our peace destroy.

608.englishTitle: OFT in danger oft in woe

stanzas.text:
OFT in danger, oft in woe
Onward, Christians, onward go
Fight the fight, maintain the strife
Strengthened with the bread of Life.

Shrink not, Christian: will ye yield?
Will ye quit the painful field?
Will ye flee in danger's hour?
Know ye not your Captain's pow'r?

Let your dropping hearts be glad;
March in heavenly armour clad
Fight, nor think the battle long
Soon shall vict’ry tune your song.

Let not sorrow dim your eye
Soon shall every tear be dry
Let not fear your course impede
Great your strength if great your need.

Onward then to glory move
More than conquerors ye shall prove,
Though oppos’d by many a foe
Christian soldiers, onward go.

609.englishTitle: WHY should I fear the darkest

stanzas.text:
WHY should I fear the darkest hour
Or tremble at the tempter's power?
Jesus vouch safes to be my tower.

Though hot the fight, why quit the field
Why must I either fly or yield Since
Jesus is my mighty shield?

I know not what may soon betide
Or how my wants shall be supplied
But Jesus knows, and will provide.

Though sin would fill me with distress
The throne of grace l dare address
For Jesus is my righteousness.

Though faint my prayers, and cold my way
My steadfast hope shall not remove
While Jesus intereedes above.

Against me earth and hell combine
But on my side is power divine
Jesus is all, and He is mine.

SHEPHERD Christ Jesus will provide
Witht green pastures He shall feed me
His blessed hands shall profer help
His eyes shall watch all over me
At dawn shall follow me about
And shall protect me through the dusk.

Whilst l was wandering all about
In all my wilderness journey
To the peaceful plain, I He brought
My feet He led to the pathway
Beside the peaceful flowing stream
In the midst of greener pastures.

E’en though I trod through the path way
In the dreadful valley of death
I will never fear nor be fraught
For Thou an ever with me be
Thine rod and staff shall aid me to
Trod the valley of death unhurt.

Aftermath weariness of strife
Thou set a table before me
Thine goodness and mercy I found
Mine cup filleth, over runeth
Heavenly hope offer me Thou
My eternal mansion above.

ONWARD, Christian Soldiers,
Marching as to war
With the cross of Jesus going on before
Christ the royal meter leads against the foe,
Forward into battle see, His barriers go onward.
stanzas.chorus:
Onward Christian Soldiers, marching as to war
With the cross of Jesus going on before.

stanzas.text:
At the name of Jesus, Satan’s host doth flee,
On then Christian, soldier on the victory march
Hell’s foundation, quiver at the shout of praise
Brothers lift your voices high and loud
your anthems raise.

Like a mighty army, moves the Church of God
Brothers we are treading where the saint
have trod
We are not divided all one body we,
One in hope and one in doctrine one in charity.

Crowns and throne may perish
Kingdoms rise and wane:
But the Church of Jesus constant will remain
Gates of hell can never ‘gainst the church prevail
We have Christ's own promise and this
cannot ever fail.

Onward, then ye people join our happy throng
Blend with ours your voices in the triumph song
Glory, praise and honour unto Christ the King
This through countless ages men and Angels
ever sing.
stanzas.chorus:
Onward Christian Soldiers, marching as to war
With the cross of Jesus going on before.

612.englishTitle: LEADER of faithful souls and guide

stanzas.text:
LEADER of faithful souls and guide
Of all that travel to the sky
Come, and with us, e’en us abide
Who would on Thee alone rely
On Thee alone our spirits stay
While held in life’s uneven way.

Stangers and pilgrims here below
This earth, we know, is not our place
But hasten through the vale of woe
And, restless to behold Thy face
Swift to our heavenly country move
Our everlasting home above.

Through Thee, who all our sins hast borne
Freely and graciously forgiven
With songs to Zion we return
Contending for our native heaven
That palace of our glorious King
We find it nearer while we sing.

Raised by the breath of love divine
We urge our way with strength renew’d
The church of the first-born to join
We travel to the mount of God
With joy upon our heads arise
And meet our Captain in the skies.

613.englishTitle: WHY those fears Behold tis Jesus

stanzas.text:
WHY those fears? Behold, tis Jesus
Holds the helm and guides the ship
Spread the sails and catch the breezes
Sent to wraft us through the deep
To the regions - 2ce
Where the mouners cease to weep.

Though the shore we hope to land on
Only by report is known
Yet we freely all abandon
Led by that report alone
And with Jesus - 2ce
Through the treckless deep move on.

Led by that, we brave the ocean
Led by that, the storms defy
Calm amidst tumultuous motion
Knowing that our Lord is nigh
Waves obey Him - 2ce
And the storm before Him fly.

Oh what pleasures there await us
There the tempests cease to roar
There it is that those who hate us
Can molest our peace no more
Trouble ceases - 2ce
On that tranquil happy shore.

614.englishTitle: OH for a closer walk with God

stanzas.text:
OH! for a closer walk with God
A calm and heavenly frame
A light to shine upon the road
That leads me to the Lamb!

Where is the wholesomeness I know
When first I saw the Lord?
Where is the soul-refreshing view
Of Jesus and his word?

What peaceful hour I once enjoyed
How sweet their memory still
But they have left an aching void
The world can never fill.

Return O holy dove, return
Sweet messenger of rest
I hate the sins that made thee mourn
And drove Thee from my breast.

The dearest I do I have kown
Whate'er that idol be
Help me to tear it from Thy throne
And worship only Thee.

So shall my walk be close with God
Calm and Serene my frame;
So purer light shall mark the road
That leads me to the Lamb.

O Holy Spirit, Friend unseen
The faint, the weak on Thee may lean
Help me, throughout life‘s varying scene
By faith to cling to Thee.

Blest with communion so divine
Take what Thou wilt, shall I repine
When, as the branches to the vine
My soul may cling to Thee.

Far from her home, fatigued, opprest,
Here she has found a place of rest
An exile still, yet not unblessed
While she can cling to Thee.

What though the world deceitful prove,
And earthly friends and joy's remove
With patient uncomplaining love
Still would I cling to Thee.

Oft when I seem to trend alone
Some barren waste with throne o'er grown
A Voice of love in gentlest tone
Whispers, “Still cling to Me".

Though faith and hope awhile be tried
I ask not, need not, aught besides
How safe, how clam, how satisfied
The souls that cling to Thee!

They fear not life's rough storms to brave
Since Thou art near and strong to save,
Nor shudder e'en at death's dark wave
Because they cling to Thee.

Blest is my lot, whate’er befall
What can disturb me, who appeal
While, as my strength, my rock, my all,
Saviour, I cling to Thee?

616.englishTitle: REST of the weary joy of the sad

stanzas.text:
REST of the weary, joy of the sad
Hope of the dreary, light of the glad
Home of the stranger, strength to the end
Refuge from danger, Saviour and friend.

Pillow, where lying, love rests its head
Peace of the dying, life of the dead
Path of the lowly, prize at the end
Breath of the holy, Saviour and friend.

When my feet stumble to Thee I‘ll cry
Crown of the humble, cross of the high
