He’s the Lilly of the Valley
The Bright and Morning star
He's father of ten thousand to my soul.

stanzas.text:
He all my grief has taken
And all my sorrow home
In temptation He’s my strong and
mighty tower
I’ve all for Him forsaken
I’ve all my idols torn
From my heart and now He keeps me,
by His power
Though all the world forsake me,
and Satan tempt me sore
Through my Jesus I shall safetly
reach the goal.
stanzas.chorus: He's the Lilly of the Valley...

stanzas.text:
He’ll never, never leave me
nor yet forsake me here
While I live by faith, and do His blessed will
A wall of fire about me,
I’ve nothing to fear
With His manna He my hungry soul shall fill
When crowned at last in glory
I’ll see His blessed face
Where the river of delight shall ever roll.
stanzas.chorus:
He's the Lilly of the Valley the
bright and Morning Star
He‘s the faires of ten thousand to my soul
In sorrow He's my comfort in trouble
He's my stay
He tells me every care on him to roll
He’s the Lilly of the Valley
The Bright and Morning star
He's father of ten thousand to my soul.

691.englishTitle: THERE is a gate that stands ajar

stanzas.text:
THERE is a gate that stands ajar,
And thro’ its portals gleaming
A radiance from the cross afar
The Saviours love re-vealing.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh, depth of mercy! can it be
That gate was left ajar for me
For me-for me‐
Was Left ajar for me?

stanzas.text:
That gate ajar stands free for all
Who seek thro’it Salvation,
The rich and poor the great and small
Of every tribe and nation.

Press onward then, though foes may frown
While mercy’s gate is open;
Accept the cross, and win the crown
Love‘s everlasting token.

Beyond the river’s brink we’ll lay
The cross that here is given
And bear the crown of life away
And love Him more in heaven.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh, depth of mercy! can it be
That gate was left ajar for me
For me-for me‐
Was Left ajar for me?

692.englishTitle: COME oh sinners to feast of love

stanzas.text:
COME oh sinners to feast of love
May we partake and dine, with Christ
Get thee ahead and not behind
Clarion call, God sound unto all.

I, to thee all, was sent to call
Unto thee all is blast the trump
Come, ye of earth and sinners come
In Christ Jesus, all things art done.

Come wretched soul, troubled by sin
Seeking about for rest divine
Lame and the blind and wretched ones
Welcome is all, Christ bid to thee.

Come, partake of the feast of love
Flee away from sin, rest on Christ
Taste of the goodness of thine God
Feed on His flesh and drink His blood.

Wanderers in spirit, thee I call
Oh my voice all thou need to hark
Thy deliverance is laid in me
Thou shall live for the sake of Christ.

Hark unto me, like unto God
Come unto Christ and ever live
Thy heart saturate with His love
Let not the death of Christ be vain.

Oh! come on now and tarry not
Now an the day of acceptance
Enter in, nay reject His call
Yield thee to Him who died for thee.

693.englishTitle: O our Saviour we come today

stanzas.text:
O! our Saviour we come today
To perform the vows we made,
Send thy spirit of Redemption
To cleanse and renew our souls.
stanzas.chorus:
Holy Spirit please descend now
Come and Show thy great power
Oh! our Saviour Oh! our Saviour
Come Oh! Saviour be with us.

stanzas.text:
Come and change our mourning to joy
Show thyself to us today
Come (and) deliver us from Satan
Oh come Holy Spirit come.

Oh come now the great Jehovah
Come in thy Love bless us all
That we may rest in our Lord’s hope
That we may never doubt him.

Allow not our Love to grow cold
In the midst of this Holy Band
So that we may bring more members
To this Band of Seraphim.

Oh our father hear us today
Descend in thy Mighty Power
Come and satisfy all of us
Bless us with Spiritual Power.

Praises be to Holy Father
Praises be to Holy Son'
Glory be to Holy Spirit
Glory be to Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
Holy Spirit please descend now
Come and Show thy great power
Oh! our Saviour Oh! our Saviour
Come Oh! Saviour be with us.

694.englishTitle: DRAW nigh and take the Body

stanzas.text:
DRAW nigh and take the Body of the Lord
And drink the holy Blood for you out-poured.

Saved by His Body, hallowed by His Blood
With souls refreshed we render thanks
to God.

Salvation Giver, Christ the only Son
By His dear Cross and Blood the vict’ry won.

Offer‘d was He for greatest and for least
Himself the Victim and Himself the Priest.

Victim were offered by the law of old
Which in a type celestial mysteries told.

He, Ransomer from death, and Light
from shade
Now gives His Holy grace His saints to aid.

Approach ye then with faithful hearts sincere
And take the pledges of Salvation here.

He, that in this world rules His saints,
and shields
To all believers life eternal yields.

With Heav’nly Bread makes them that
hunger whole
Gives Living Waters to the thirsty soul.

O Judge of all, our only Saviour Thou,
In this Thy feast of love be with us now.

HO! every one that thirst, draw nigh!
Tis God invites the fallen race
Mercy and free salvation buy
Buy wine, and milk, and gospel grace.

Come to the living waters, come
Sinners, obey your Maker’s call
Return ye weary wandering, home
And find My grace is free for all!

See from the Rock a fountain rise!
For you in healing streams it rolls
Money ye need not bring nor price
Ye labo‘ring, burden‘d, sin‐sick souls.

Nothing ye in exchange shall give
Leave all you have and are behind
Frankly the gift of God receive
Pardon and peace in Jesus find.

696.englishTitle: WHAT can wash away my stain

stanzas.text:
WHAT! can wash away my stain?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
stanzas.chorus:
Oh precious is the flow
that makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

stanzas.text:
For my cleansing this I see
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
For my pardon this my plea
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

Nothing can for sin atone
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Naught of good that l have done
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

This is all my hope and peace
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
This is all my righteousness
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
stanzas.chorus:
Oh precious is the flow
that makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

697.englishTitle: THE hour is come the feast is nigh

stanzas.text:
THE hour is come, the feast is nigh
I give Myself to thee
Behold I give my blood to thee
For thy redemption shed.

Fill my Father's kingdom above
Before I drink again
By then, no more shall tears be shed
It shall be joy for aye.

This supper shall e’er continue
Until His Kingdom come
All o’er the world shall many souls
This supper eat and drink.

God's blessings shall from heav‘n
be pour'd
Upon all them who eat
And from my Father's throne on high
I’ll prepare them a place.

But now, for the present I’ll drink
The bitter cup for you
And for your sakes, the cup I'll drink
Of sore anguish of death.

My sorrow deep Ye cannot know
Nor yet, my glory seen
But this, continue ye to do
And thus, remember me.

SWEET feast of love divine
Tis grace that makes us free
To feed upon this bread and wine
In mem‘ry, Lord of Thee.

Here every welcome guest
Waits, Lord, from Thee to learn
The secrets of Thy Father’s breast
And all Thy grace discern.

Here conscience ends its strife
And faith delights to prove
The sweetness of the bread of life
The fullness of Thy love.

The blood that flow‘d for sin
In symbol here we see
And feel the blessed pledge within
That we are loved of Thee.

Oh, if this glimpse of love
Is so divinely sweet
What will it be, O Lord, above
Thy gladdening smile to meet.

To see Thee face to face
Thy perfect likeness wear
And all Thy ways of wondrous grace
Through endless years declare.

699.englishTitle: OUR lamps are trimm‘d and bunting

stanzas.text:
OUR lamps are trimm‘d and burning,
Our robes are white and clean
We’ve tarried for the Bridegroom
Oh may we enter in
We know we've nothing worthy
That we can call our own
The light, the oil the robes we wear,
All come from Him alone.
stanzas.chorus:
Behold the Bridegroom cometh
And all may enter in;
Whose lamps are trimm‘d and burning
Whose robes are white and clean.

stanzas.text:
Go forth go forth to meet Him
The way is open now,
All lighted with the glory
Thats streaming from his brow,
Accept the invitation
Beyond de-ser-ving kind make no
delay but take your lamps
And joy eternal find.

We see the marriage splendour Within
the open door;
We know that those who enter
Are blessed for ever more
We see He is more lovely
Than all the Sons of men
But still we know the door once shut
Will never open again.
stanzas.chorus:
Behold the Bridegroom cometh
And all may enter in;
Whose lamps are trimm‘d and burning
Whose robes are white and clean.

700.englishTitle: AT the wedding feast ages gone

stanzas.text:
At the wedding feast ages gone
Cana of Galilee
There, miracle hath Jesus wrought
Water, to wine He turned.

Jesus Thine presence please reveal
At this wedding we plead
Offer Thine divine blessing Lord
Unto these hence today.

Grant them true love and affection
The world can not destroy
And make them offer unto Thee
Their hearts to worship Thee.

May they be help mate to each one
In unity to live
May Thine glory in them reveal
In their habitat, Lord.

We plead Thee, watch over them Lord
God, Protector divine
Almighty, Omnipotent God
Protect them, Lord we plead.

Glory be to Father and Son
And to the Holy Ghost
Glory be to the trinity
ln heaven and on earth.

O! Father, God Almighty
Thine mercies all we plead
Bestow upon this brother
Upon this spinster too.

This new couple, unite Lord
Thine fear in their hearts lnstill
That they may love share Within
Ever as life endure.

Thy response flash unto us
May we, Thee ack-no-ledge
That Thou an sanctioned this day
And Thy blessings we gain.

Descend today, Lord we plead
Jehovah Jireh, our God
Thy blessings Lord all we plead
Upon us all endow.

May joy of sweetest savour
On them oh Lord descend
Favour them now and ever
Nay them asunder be.

Our Benevolent Father
Thine divine gift Lord endow
Against foes grant them victory
Their God, Lord ever be.

O perfect Love, all human thought
transcending
Lowly we kneel in pray’r before
Thy throne
That theirs may be the love which
knows no ending
Whom Thou for evermore dost
join in one.

O perfect Life, be Thou their full assurance
Of tender charity and steadfast faith,
Of patient hope, and quier brave endurance
With child like trust that fears nor pain
nor death.

Grant them the joy which brightens
ear-thly sorrow
Grant them the peace which calms all
earthly strife
And to life’s day the glorious unknown
marrow
That dawns upon eternal love and life.

THE voice that breathed o‘er Eden
That earliest wedding day
The primal marriage blessing
It hath not pass‘d away.

Still in the pure espousal
Of Christian man and maid
The Holy Three are with us
The Three-fold grace is said.

For dower of blessed children
For love and faith’s sweet sake
For high mysterious Union
Which Nought on earth may break.

Be present heavenly Father
To give away this bride
As Eve Thou gav’st to Adam
Out of His own pierced side.

Be present here Emmanuel
To join their loving hands
As Thou didst bind two natures
In Thine Eternal Bands.

Be present Holy Spirit
To bless them as they kneel
As Thou, for Christ the Bridegroom
The heavenly spouse dost seal.

Oh spread Thy pure wring o'er them
Thy Overshadowing love
While one in Thee forever
They seek Thy rest above.

Till to the Home of gladness
With Christ own bride they rise
And cast their crowns before Thee
In perfect sacrifice.

CHRIST Jesus truly attended
A Holy marriage feast
Our Lord we humbly beseech Thee
To bless us here this day.

Thy Holy blessing from above
Send on this match this day
Unite them in Thy Holy Love
A love that never fade.

Thy bunting love fill their hearts Lord
With peace and joy with Thee
Their daily bread for ever given
And make them ever Thine.

Protect them ever from above
With love forever more
To love each other more and more
As Christ doth love His Church.

Make them to help one another
In all their daily call
And bless them with glorious children
And peace forever more.

705.englishTitle: REST in the Lord from harps above

stanzas.text:
REST in the Lord from harps above
The music seems to Thrill
Rest in His everlasting love,
Rest and be still.

Rest Thou who claimest for Thine own
Thy chosen bride to-day
Affianceth in His faith alone
Thy bride for aye.

And Thou whose, trustful hand is given
A vouching here Thy spouse
Rest, for a Father's seal, in heaven
His children’s vows.

Rest ye who cluster round them both
To mingle praise and pray
Your God affirms the plighted truth,
Your God and theirs.

Rest for the heavenly Bridegroom here
Is standing by his side,
And in this union draws more near
His mystic bride.

Rest in The Lord The Holy dove
In us Thy word fulfil
Rest in His everlasting love
Rest and be still.

THE noble wedding of Isaac
With Rebecca his darling wife
Divine blessing on them bestow’d
As in Eden unto Adam.
stanzas.chorus:
Rejoice, I echo to thee rejoice - 2ce
Rejoice, Rejoice
Rejoice ye in the Lord, rejoice.

stanzas.text:
So be it unto thee today
Brethren and sisters in the Lord
Joy Divine in thine heart descend
And Blessing Divine from above.

Amidst earthly troubles and care
Thy chosen ones on earth protect
Beneath Thy sacred wings encamp‘d
From snares and dangers shall be free.

Well wishers, friends, all kit and kins
May God, thy hearty pray’rs accept
Blessings ever shall thee receive
Now and ever more from the Lord.

Ye members of Seraphim Band
And ye of the Cherubim Band
This day of joy the Lord hath made
May God bless us with happiness.

Glory to God, Father above
Glory to God the Son we give
Glory we give to Holy Ghost
Glory to Holy Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
Rejoice, I echo to thee rejoice - 2ce
Rejoice, Rejoice
Rejoice ye in the Lord, rejoice.

707.englishTitle: I will extol Thee oh God Almighty

stanzas.text:
I will extol Thee oh! God Almighty,
For Thou hast lifted me on high
And hast not made my foes rejoice over me
Glory, honour to Thy Name.
stanzas.chorus:
Praises, glory honour to Thy Name
Power and might be unto The Lord,
Thousand? of tongues Praise and hallow thee
We fall, bow and worship thee.

stanzas.text:
O’ Lord, my God, I did cry unto thee,
And Thou hast healed me from sickness
As Thou hast brought up my soul from the grave
And not to goto the pit.

Sing unto The Lord O! ye Seraphim
And give thanks to His Holiness
His anger endureth but for a moment,
In His favour life exusts.

Weeping may endure for only a night,
But joy will come in the morning
Peace, strength and vigour return in the day
I am to my steadfast call.

When Thou didst hide thy countenance
from me
I was troubled and cried to thee;
Ah! what profit shall there be in my blood
When I go down to the pit?

This way my Lord hearkened to my prayers
And turned my mourning to dancing
Thou hast put off sacloth from my body
And with gladness guarded me.

To this end my glory shall sing, and praise,
Sing joyful songs unto the Lord,
I will sing hymns of praises to The Lord
Forever Him will I praise.
stanzas.chorus:
Praises, glory honour to Thy Name
Power and might be unto The Lord,
Thousand? of tongues Praise and hallow thee
We fall, bow and worship thee.

708.englishTitle: LORD I care not for riches

stanzas.text:
LORD, I care not for riches
Neither silver not gold
I would make sure of heaven
I would enter the fold
In the book of Thy kingdom
With its pages so fair
Tell me, Jesus my Saviour
Is my name written there?
stanzas.chorus:
Is my name written there
On the page white and fair
In the book of Thy Kingdom
Is my name written there?

stanzas.text:
Lord, my sins they are many
Like the sands of the sea
But Thy blood, O my Saviour!
ls sufficient for me
For Thy promise is written
In bright letter that glow
Tho' your sins be as scarlet
I will make them like snow.

O! that beautiful city
With its mansions of light
With its glorified being
In pure garments of white
Where no evil thing cometh
To bespoil what is fair
Where the angels are watching
Yes, my name’s written there.
stanzas.chorus:
Is my name written there
On the page white and fair
In the book of Thy Kingdom
Is my name written there?

709.englishTitle: Be Present at Our Table, Lord (Before Meals)

stanzas.text:
BE present at our table, Lord
Be here and everywhere adore
Bless these Thy gifts and grant that we
May feast in Paradise with Thee.

710.englishTitle: We Thank Thee, Lord, for This Our Food (After Meals)

stanzas.text:
WE thank Thee, Lord, for this our food
For life, and health, and every good
May manna to our souls be given
The bread of life sent down from heaven.

711.englishTitle: BLESSED be the kid and the child

stanzas.text:
BLESSED be the kid and the child
Todling at infancy,
Way of perdition nay to tread
God, worshipeth with awe.

Our mortal frame to God we yield
From infancy, so sweet
Exortic flowery gift it be
When budding at the bloom.

At infancy, God, serve with awe
How sweet and this at ease
As sinners groweth forth to age
Hardeneth forth in heart.

Arise to the worship of God
O! Now at infancy
How greatly askid we rejoice
Thus greatly grow in strength.

Almighty, Omniscient God
Our frames we yield to Thee
May we as kids ever be Thine
Now till eternity.

May works of prayers and of praise
My vocation to be
When death come calling, I’ll be firm
Heaven with joy to see.

ANGELIC hosts in heav’n above
Praiseth and worshipeth our God
The burden of Thy rod of wrath
Troubleth satan, hades below.

All ye mis-creants and ye wanderers
Cursers and ye falsehood swearers
Remember ye the Lord’s command
Reverence ye the name of our God.

How shalt they firmly stand oh Lord
Before Thy greatest might and power
Men of contempt before our God
Shall to destruction burn in hell.

No water shall to them be found
Thirsty though, their thirst nay to quech
Forever I shall praise Thy name
As Thee I will in heaven praise.

Woe of great magnitude it be
Evil utterances me to hark
Uttereth of the vaga‐bonds
Unto the greatest Father, God.

Companying with them all, I’ll sever
Contemptuous without awe to God
Swearing in vain to sacred name
In falsehood curseth and doth swear.

713.englishTitle: ALL ye who curses and falsely swears

stanzas.text:
ALL ye who curses and falsely swears
Ye fighters and brawlers
The day of reckoning shall come
The seed sown, thou shall reap.

All the evil hymns all they rend
I abhore and decline
Vain and void words so they speaketh
Nay, not from me proceed.

Ye kid thoughtless and short sighted
Ye wanderers. vagabonds,
Never my companions shall be
But children wise and brave.

Thou corruptible, shameless kid
Others thou art defirm
Rabid and sickly dying beast
Healthy fold to infect.

Corrupt companions, nay I keep
Oh Lord my God I plead
Never may I with them partake
Of destruction in hell.

714.englishTitle: BEHOLD who are these little ones

stanzas.text:
BEHOLD, who are these little ones
Who’ve finished soon their pilgrimage
And have arrived in glory land
The place they have been longing for?

“I am from Green land's snowy hills”
I am from the land of India
Am from the land of Africa
And I am from those far off isles.

Our pilgrimage are over now
Weeping and suffering are all past
We all meet together at last
At the bright pearly gates of heav'n.

We hope to hear the Lord say, come
Ye victor over sin and death
Lift up your heads, then, O ye gates
And let the children pilgrims in."

715.englishTitle: HOW great the tumult fight and brawl

stanzas.text:
HOW great the tumult, fight and brawl
Screaming pervade the earth
Harmonious co-habitation
Oft within kits and kins.

All flying birds within their nests
In harmony abides
O! what a great splendor it be
All to abide at peace.

Bragging and threatening all in vain
Value‐less and vain pride
The club and staff of pain to bear
And death the end shall be.

Grief is the fruit of temptations
Amidst the kits and kins
In grief borne of hot jealously
Cain, his brother doth slain.

The grief of the ‘Wise’ for a while
Never till the sun set
But of the foolish it shall be
Until the dusk at dawn.

Forgive us our misdeeds oh Lord
And our short coming, Lord
Grieve borne from infancy relieve
May we age forth in love.  Amin

716.englishTitle: HOW sweet be it from infancy

stanzas.text:
HOW sweet be it from infancy
The path of wisdom all to tread
May of honesty, truth we be
May we be trusted all of men.

Liars, nay not we all to trust
E‘en though repenteth, truth to speak
When fallible man, evil wrath
Lying, a pair and chains it be.

How abominable art lies
Revealeth in the word of God
Un-timely, Ananiah’s death
Death payeth he; the cost of lies.

Saphirah; spouse and confidant
Witnesseth for Ananiah
Slumpeth and fallen down to death
Lying couples the price they paid.

The ‘honest’ is the Lords delight
The ‘honest‘ the Lord shall repay
The liars shall all be condemned
And be consum‘d and rot in hell.

All the falsehood uttereth forth
Recordeth of God in the ’Book'
In bridle my loose tongue shall be
Nay shall I be destroyed in hell.

BY cool Siloam’s shady rill
How sweet the lily grows!
How sweet the breath, beneath the hill
Of Sharon‘s dewy rose.

Lot such the child whose early feet
The paths of peace have trod
Whose secret heart with influence sweet
ls upward drawn to God.

By cool Siloam's shady rill
The lily must decay
The rose that blooms beneath the hill
Must shortly fade away.

O Thou whose infant feet were found
Within Thy Father's shrine
Whose years, with changeless virtue
crowned
Were all alike divine.

Dependent on Thy bounteous breath
We seek Thy grace alone
In childhood, manhood, age, and death
To keep us still Thine own.

718.englishTitle: NOT of dim mem'ry shall I be

stanzas.text:
NOT of dim mem'ry shall I be
The day that mum saith unto me
When independence attaineth
Nay, forget not the day of mum.
stanzas.chorus:
When all revealed vividly clear
Great love borne unto me by mum
Words of love unto me recap
Nay forget not the day of mum.

stanzas.text:
I shall in mem’ry ever be
All the toils of mum over me
Me, watcheth over dusk and dawn
In surplusity and of drought.

Honest counsellor art the mum
Father, the helper, limited
Supposed mother, replica
None be so worthy as the mum.

Supposed father, nay of worth
The replica, nay of the real
None can console, none can forebear
None worthy as father and Mum.

Lo! Mothers thy harvest shall come
Lo! Father thy harvest shall broth
None shall thy glory to deny
By the pow’r of Almighty God.
stanzas.chorus:
When all revealed vividly clear
Great love borne unto me by mum
Words of love unto me recap
Nay forget not the day of mum.

719.englishTitle: ALL for Thy praise Almighty God

stanzas.text:
ALL for Thy praise Almighty God
Created Thou our tongues
E’en though we be despised of men
Our pray’rs for them shall be.

Despising and defirmation
Welcome not in our midst
Regarding others as insane
To perdition it leads.

Whatever per-sona‐lity
Treac’rous words speaketh forth
To holy saints, sacred objects
Shall be destroyed of God.

When thence the kids and infidels
Elisha doth despise
Vociferously choruseth
To the mount go hence from.

By the beast consumed were the kids
By the bears doth devoured
For their shortcomings were repay
Unto death all they groan.

How aweful is Thy wrath oh Lord
Unto the infidels
Grant unto usThy grace we plead
And our tongues bridle, Lord.  Amin

720.englishTitle: WHEN he cometh when He cometh

stanzas.text:
WHEN he cometh, when He cometh
To make up His jewels
All His jewels, precious jewels
His loved and His own.
stanzas.chorus:
Like the stars of the morning
His bright Crown adorning
They shall shine in their beauty
Bright gems for His Crown.

stanzas.text:
He will gather, He will gather
The gems for His Kingdom
All the pure ones, all the bright ones
His loved and His own.

Little children, little children
Who love their Redeemer
Are the jewels, precious jewels
His loved and His own.
stanzas.chorus:
Like the stars of the morning
His bright Crown adorning
They shall shine in their beauty
Bright gems for His Crown.

721.englishTitle: O Sunday School on the Lord‘s day

stanzas.text:
O Sunday School, on the Lord‘s day
O how I love Thee well
I am happy, it makes me glad
To rejoice at Thy birth.

O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
Thy friendship suits me well
Both young and old will sing thy song
We long for Sunday-School.

O Sunday School, on the Lord’s day
Christ was Thy first teacher
The Holy Spirit, great teacher
Does manifest in thee.

O Sunday School, on the Lord’s day
This testimony’s sure
That God, the Father Almigthy
Poured His blessing on thee.

O Sunday School, on the Lord’s day
Though the sun be so bright
Or if the clouds be black with rain
I’ll be in Sunday School.

O Sunday School, on the Lord’s day
I rejoice to see thee,
Will Thou pass over me today
Without my being blest?

722.englishTitle: THE little children pluck the little

stanzas.text:
THE little children pluck the little
branches of palm leaves on the path
And they shout Hosannah
This is victorious song that they sang
to enter Jerusalem
Hosannah! Hosannah
stanzas.chorus:
O this it the Son of David and King
of Israel
Riding upon the donkey for the
Salvation of mankind
Hosannah! Hosannah
Hosannah to the David's Son.

stanzas.text:
All the adults endeavour'd to keep
them in silence
But they shout, Hosannah
If all these people are silenc‘d
Behold all the stones shall praise
Hosannah, Hosannah!

O tell the daughters of Zion that
their King is coming
Hosannah! Hosannah
He is cool temper‘d and sat upon
the back of the donkey
Hosannah! Hosannah!

Blessed be unto Him that cometh in
the name of the Lord
Hosannah! Hosannah
O spread thy heart on the road path
for Christ the King of glory
Hosannah! Hosannah!
stanzas.chorus:
O this it the Son of David and King
of Israel
Riding upon the donkey for the
Salvation of mankind
Hosannah! Hosannah
Hosannah to the David's Son.

stanzas.text:
BE-NE-FI-CIENT Mother
On earth, careth for me
Me, beareth in her porch
Careth for me all day.
stanzas.chorus:
Hail thee Mother
Oh! when shall be
I shall repay and appreciate
Thine care for me.

stanzas.text:
None else like thee Mother
‘Mongst all my kit, and kin
Preserve me Lord I plead
May I as Mother be.

Father, my reflector
Mother, my choice of gold
Careth for me at dusk
Me, beareth in her porch.

Though I am wise and brave
Tribute all to the Mum
E‘en though yet retarded
To Mum, all attribute.
stanzas.chorus:
Hail thee Mother
Oh! when shall be
I shall repay and appreciate
Thine care for me.

724.englishTitle: THERE is a friend for little children

stanzas.text:
THERE'S a friend for little children
Above the bright blue sky
A friend who changeth never
Whose love can never die
Unlike our friends by nature
Who changeth with changing years
This friend is always worthy
The precious name He bears.

There’s a rest for little children
Above the bright blue sky
For those who love the saviour
And Abba Father cry
A rest from every trouble
From sin and danger free
Where every little pilgrim
Shall rest eternally.

There‘s a home for little children
Above the bright blue sky
Where Jesus reigns in glory
A home of peace and joy
No home on earth is like it
None can with it compare
Where every one is happy
All can be happier there.

There‘s crown for little children
Above the bright blue sky
And all who look to Jesus
Shall wear it by and by
A crown of brightest glory
Which He will then bestow
On those who found his favour
And loved him here below.

There's a song for little children
Above the bright blue sky
A song that will not weary
Though sung continually
A song which even angels
Can never, never sing
They know not Christ as Saviour
But worship Him as King.

There’s robe for little children
Above the bright blue sky
A harp of sweetest music
A palm of victory
All, all above is treasured
And found in Christ alone
Oh, come, dear little children
That all, may all be thine.

MOTHER who conceiveth me for
nine months
Me, never she abort
Me. delivereth, borne in her porch about
For three whole solid years.
stanzas.chorus:
Mother, mother, mother, I thank thee
For thy toiling dusk and dawn
In the time of surplusity and want
Mother, all sake of me.

stanzas.text:
In sickness and ill health who stood by me
Me, bore in warm embrace
When in dis-com-fort, who me doth console?
Mother! none else but thee.

At infancy when not a word can speak
Who all my wants discern?
At adolescent who my care art borne
Mother! none else but thee.

The savour of the milk on mother's breast
Ever in me endure
So great and much that money can’t purchase
Thy toiling all on me.

Thou whose mother, from earth hath departed
l commiserate with thee
Ye all whose mothers art on earth to live
Give praises unto God.

Let us all cultivate good characters
As wise and brave children
Like Christ Jesus, meekly and cheerfully
Let’s be virtuous children.
stanzas.chorus:
Mother, mother, mother, I thank thee
For thy toiling dusk and dawn
In the time of surplusity and want
Mother, all sake of me.

726.englishTitle: ERE Mother Eve falleth to sin

stanzas.text:
ERE Mother Eve falleth to sin
None hath the idea of the knit
Her nudeness never to expose
Abomination! and a snare!

When raiment of fig leaves she wore
The sacred adorning fadeth
Lo! as we thy Kindred on earth
The raiment of shame we adorn.

Lo! we mortal, how great our pride
When the raiment anew adorn
As though not adorneth of ants
As though not adorneth of sheep.

Lo! the beautiful butterfly
And the flow'ry plants and the shrubs
My raiments how much and in worths
Worthless than butterfly and shrubs.

With all of me, my heart I'll seek
Worthy adomments in value
Acceptable manners and truth
Greatest and worthy adomments.

Then shall I of great value be
Than the butterfly, ants and shrubs
Adornment of Angelic pearls
And of the sacred Son of God.

Never failing and fadeth not
Neither of the moth be consumed
In rain, in shine it’s all the same
It’s beauty, value, ne'er corrupt.

This I shall adorn here below
That I may adorn there above
Pearly adornment made of God
His glory and His joy it be.

DO no sinful action
Speak no angry word
Ye belong to Jesus
Children of the Lord.

Christ is kind and gentle
Christ is pure and true
And His little children
Just be holy too.

There‘s a wicked spirit
Watching round you still
And he tries to tempt you
To all harms and ill.

But ye must not hear him
Though ‘tis hard for you
To resist the evil
And the good to do.

For ye promised truly,
In your infant days
To renounce him wholly
And forsake his ways.

Ye are Christian soldiers
Ye must learn to fight
With the bad within you
And to do the right.

Christ is your own Master
He is good and true
And His little children
Must be holy too.

728.englishTitle: OH what a name so pleasant

stanzas.text:
Oh! what a name so pleasant as of Mum
Hark the ear, offering gentle soul a rest
Oh what a sweet savour not meet for
tongues
In such a name so great as of the Mum.

Oh! mother who for the child suffereth shame
Oh! mother who for the child doth weepeth
Great mother thou who for the child
doth starve
Thou shall I ever love, O! precious mum.

Almighty God, Thine help an my desire
For parents, Oh Lord make me to afford
Abundant joy, I cherish, Lord I plead
May I ne’er premature-ly hence depart.

No affectionate counsellor like Christ
Wonderful Father, my needs doth provide
Incarnate Son of the creator God
Thine protection and grace, Oh Lord I plead.

TOADY is past
Our Lord Jesus
Behold me now
Thy little child.

Thou art the Light
Look upon me
Let Thy light shine
upon me Lord.

My dear Saviour
I’ll never fear
Becasue Thou art
now by my side.

And everytime
I watch Thy face
When there is none
to be with me.

And everytime
Inclined Thine ears
Unto the pray'rs of little ones.

And now therefore
Without terror
I slept and I rest upon Thee.

Thou, Father, Son
And Holy Ghost
Worthy of praise in earth
and heav’n.

730.englishTitle: GOD of all wisdom and goodness

stanzas.text:
GOD of all wisdom and goodness
Give us Thy light and truth
The straight and narrow way to show
And our footsteps to guide.

When In danger our guide to be
And on the rocky steep
Our ship to pilot safely through
Until we reach the shore.

And as we grow more in Thy grace
To teach them as Thy word
Help us all our children to teach
Thy precepts to obey.

In time, destroy their vain desire
The lust and pride of life
Help to teach them the holy way
To their Saviour and Lord.

We want to look up and follow
Thy good example, Lord
Channel their hope and tear to Thee
Their thoughts our plea renew.

We want to woo them faith to have
And their zeal show for Thee
Grant that we teach not peevishly
Rather, teach them with love.

In faith we ask for this from Thee
E‘en wisdom from above
Grant them a childish fear in Thee
And with a perfect love.

Help guide their bent from evil lusts
From all dangers away
That we may gently their hearts bend
And draw them close to Thee.

731.englishTitle: ALMIGHTY God theme of the song

stanzas.text:
ALMIGHTY God, theme of the song
Angels in heaven sing
Look down in mercy from Thy throne
And do, teach us Thy fear.

We want to learnThy holy word
From this our childhood days
Teach us to know the Lord, who is
The way, the truth, the Life.

We talk of all Thy glory, Lord
And Thy goodness to us
Enthrone Thyself within our hearts
And make us Thee to fear.

732.englishTitle: YE little ones keep close to God

stanzas.text:
YE little ones keep close to God
In trembling and humility
Let all knees bow down before Him
Our Lord and Saviour and our friend.

O Saviour, let Thy great mercy
Fill us with gratitude to Thee
And in our earthly pilgrimage
May we receive more of Thy grace.

O Saviour, may all evil thought
Be far away flung from our hearts
And each day, Thy wisdom bestow
To choose to walk the narrow way.

In times of sickness and good health
In times of plenty or in need
And when the hour of death shall come
Deliver us with Thy great pow'r.

LITTLE drops of water
Little grains of sand
Make the Might occen
And the beauteous land.

And the little moments
Humble though they be
Make the mighty ages
of eternity.

Little deeds of kindness
Little words of love
Make our earth an Eden
Like the heav'n above.

So our little errors
Lead the soul astray
From the paths of virtue
Into sin to stray.

Little seeds of mercy
Sown by youthful hands
Grow to bless the nations
Far in heathen lands.

Little ones in glory
Swell the angels‘ song
Make us meet, dear Saviour
For their holy throng.

734.englishTitle: BEHOLD the bee so wise and brave

stanzas.text:
BEHOLD the bee so wise and brave
Atop all flow’ry shrubs
Busy ever, honey gathereth
From all shrubs deriveth.

Behold how sweet, honey gathereth
into the comb he hath
All grief and pains thus endureth
Behold its jelly bright.

Thus ought l to be brave and wise
In all I thus engage
Idle hands doth satan engage
in worthless toils and care.

I shall endeavour to study
At so tender my age
And shall attend harder my toils
May l not be ashamed.

BEHOLD all worthy in-stan-ces
In the Bible so true
To them who love to serve the Lord
From birth and unto death.

Christ Jesus, Lord in high above
The earth His glory fill
He was like I am an infant
Law of God keepeth He.

At tender age, all but at twelve
Jews leadeth He aright
Behold Him so gentle and meek
Harkneth He to the mum.

E’en though despiseth of the Jews
Alas! though He was mocked
To Him the kids glory they give
Loud hosannah they rend.

Like manner Samuel, Timothy
All from the in-fan-cy
ln zeal they worshippeth the Lord
Thus, I ought, God to serve.

Must I forsake the Lord, my God?
His service to ignore?
My pledge is all but God to serve
In goodwill and in love.

SOLID foundation established of Christ
The Praying Father trail
Not by thought of men
Shall it ever quake
Firmly standing on Christ the Rock.
stanzas.chorus:
Cherubim rejoice, Seraphim rejoice
The foundation firmly on Jesus lay -2ce

stanzas.text:
Though thunder may strike,
roaring to quake
But Christians shall firmly stand
The salvation ark, though despised
of men, In safety shall berth at shore.

Stephen and Peter accuseth of men
Christ Jesus per-se-cuteth
Orimolade accuseth of men
Arise! Oh Christains beware!

O! Praying Father be thou yet on guard
Cherub, Seraphims to receive
Thy works here below, rewarded above
And eternal crown shall be thine.

Moses, men doth hated
Angels embrace
God of Abraham embrace
The Heavenly Host hearkeneth unto him
God the Blessed Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
Cherubim rejoice, Seraphim rejoice
The foundation firmly on Jesus lay
The foundation firmly on Jesus lay.

737.englishTitle: HARKEN unte he word of the Lord

stanzas.text:
HARKEN unto the word of the
Lord our God Hark the blessings
of God to Zerubabel
The foundation laideth of Zerubabel
He shall truely and sure accomplish
stanzas.chorus:
A!’ Rejoice, rejoice, Jesus hath
promised us to bless - 2ce
Ah! rejoice, Jesus hath promised
usto bless.

stanzas.text:
Harken unto the word of the Lord our God
Hath I purposeth thee all to prove and bless
Thus my glory upon thee I shall reveal
The world shall behold, Me glorified.

Oh! Great Zion stop thou weeping
and groaning
Thine youthful days, over thou an
come of age
Thou shall be exalted at the city gate
My Glory, on thy kindred I‘ll pour

Gold and Silver thou shall never
ever lack
And My glory shall forever dwell with thee
In thee shall all earthly nations all be blest
Just believe, and ever trust on God.

I am the only Alpha and Omega
The heaven and earth by me alone are made
Thou I shall never forsake never ignore
I am God, Omnipotent and true.
stanzas.chorus:
A!’ Rejoice, rejoice, Jesus hath
promised us to bless - 2ce
Ah! rejoice, Jesus hath promised
usto bless.

stanzas.text:
CHRIST is our cornerstone,
On Him alone we build
With His true saints alone
The courts of heaven are filled;
On His great love our hopes we place
Of present grace and joy above.

O then with hymns of praise
These hallowed courts shall ring
Our voices we will raise
The three in One to sing,
And thus proclaim in joyful song,
Both loud and long, that glorious name.

Here gracious God, do Thou
For evermore draw nigh
Accept each faithful vow,
And mark each suppliant sigh;
In copious shower on all who pray
Each holy day Thy blessings pour.

Here may we gain from heaven
The grace which we implore
And may that grace, once given,
Be with us evermore,
Until that day when all the blest
To endless rest are called away.

739.englishTitle: l have been in the wilderness

stanzas.text:
l have been in the wilderness of
the world
Upon the mount and upon the plain
There is nothing that I cherish in
this world
But desire Jerusalem on high.
stanzas.chorus:
There's a day we shall bid farewell
To the world we shall bid farewell
Dear brethren, the day is coming
When we shall go to our home on high.

stanzas.text:
I stood and look'd the way to Jerusalem
My soul‘s thirsty to get to the place
Whatever can hinder me in narrow way
O Trinity, cast them out for me.

Every day my soul of sin do set me back
Far away from Jesus Christ my Lord
Lord Jesus, redeem me with Thy
precious blood
With Thy Holy Spirit put me through

The world push’s me hither thither
to suit them
Still, I will not depart from my Lord
I have promis’d to reign with Jesus
my Lord And this promise ever will not fail.

The good land of Canaan had been
shown to me
Her beauty is uncomparable
Brethren how would ye migrate into
the Lamb?
For the soul that fall there will perish.

All ye people, come and praise the
Lord with me
Who had shown us Apostolic way
I know Jesus, my Sayiour and King today
With His Holy Spirit, He fil‘d me.

Jesus Christ uplift me to the end of life
To be with Thee to the end's so sweet
Hallelujah! praise the Lord Jesus once more
Halleluyah! shall be our last song.
stanzas.chorus:
There's a day we shall bid farewell
To the world we shall bid farewell
Dear brethren, the day is coming
When we shall go to our home on high.

740.englishTitle: WE lay down this foundation Lord

stanzas.text:
WE lay down this foundation, Lord
In Thy name, Our Lord Jesus Christ
We beseech Thee our Saviour, dear
Keep this holy place in Thy care.

And when Thy face Thy people seek
And sinners seek Thee in this house
Hear, Almighty from heav’n above
O Lord our God, in Thy great name.

When Thy ministers preach the Word
The gospel of Jesus Thy Son
Almighty God, in Thy great name
Wrought our wonderful miracles.

And when the little children sing
Their hymns of praise unto their king
Let angels join them in His praise
And earth and heav‘n their chorus rend.

Jehovah will Thou with us dwell
In this our wicked, sinful world
Christ Jesus will Thou be our King
Will I here rest find Holy Ghost.

May Thy glory never depart
From this house, beautifully laid
Make Thy kingdom within our hearts
And establish thy throne within.

SOLEMNLY without a romp
Solemnly the sun doth rise
When at sunrise doth emerge
Men the sky, the sun may gaze
Gently its gleams brighter raise
Gently, brighter grows in strength
Brighter, growing forth to peak
To the glory ne'er to gaze.

Darkness with o’erwhelming might
Nay with sound worthy of note
Gentle moon and shinning stars
Beaming light upon the earth
Nay with roaring sound doth come
Mighty drips of heav'nly dew
All around the earth descend
Nay with sound worthy of note.

Mys-te-rious the deeds of God
Amidst the Seraphim fold
Though feeble and frail we be
And we descreseth in strength
But the providence of God
On us all day doth descend
By the power and might of God
This abode doth accomplish.

This day God our thanks we give
Members of Seraphim fold
All the young and all the old
Male folks and the female folks
Host and visitors alike
Our thanks we offer to Thee
In this sanctuary divine
All our thanks Father receive.

Father God, the Trinity
Who art this fold established
This house consecrate we plead
By Thine power and sacred might
Descend Lord today we plead
With Holy Spirit inspire
Adopt us all, Thine to be
Here on earth and there above.

742.englishTitle: LIFT up your heads eternal gates

stanzas.text:
LIFT up your heads, eternal gates
Ye everlasting doors give way
The King, the King of glory comes
Ascending the His throne to-day
Who is the King of glory?
Who is the King of glory?
It is the Lord of might,
The Victor in us fight
Triumphant o’er the powers of night.

Lift up your heads, eternal gates
Ye gates of pearl, and streeets of gold
The King, te King of glory comes
Before His chariot-wheels unfold!
Who is the King of glory?
Who is the King of glory?
The Lord of hosts is He,
The God of majesty
He is the King eternally.

Now with the Father, God most High
And with the Spirit, ever one
The angels own the Christ, the King,
And bow before His shinning throne
He is the King of glory!
He is the King of glory!
Him let all earth adore
To Him our praises pour
For ever and for evermore.

743.englishTitle: HEAVENLY hosts come with us rejoice

stanzas.text:
HEAVENLY hosts come with us rejoice
This house now to dedicate
Christ Jesus, Lord all our plea to Thee
Thine blessings on us bestow.
stanzas.chorus:
Who-so-ever shall call on Thee
We plead Thee Father
Hark unto us in this fold.

stanzas.text:
Our thanks offering we yield Lord to Thee
For Thine promise ful-fileth
Thine promise maketh to Cherubim
Fulfileth to Seraphim.

Thine promise maketh to Ab-ra-ham
Unto Isaac fulfileth
Thine promises maketh to David
To Solomon fulfileth.

Glory and honour to Father be
Glory be unto the Son
Glory and honour to Holy Ghost
And to Blessed Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
Who-so-ever shall call on Thee
We plead Thee Father
Hark unto us in this fold.

744.englishTitle: IN Thy great name God Almighty

stanzas.text:
lN Thy great name, God Almighty
We build this house of praise for Thee
Choose it for Thy special abode
And keep if from all terror safe.

When Thy people shall seek Thee here
And sinners seek and plead for life
Hear us from Thy dwelling on high
And when Thou shall, hear, do forgive.

When Thy servant shall preach the word
The gospel of Jesus Christ here
By the power in Thy great name
May sign and wonders be perform'd.

When infant voices sing their song
Hossanah to their king on high
May earth and heav‘n join the refrain
And all angels sing Hossanah.

May Thy glory never depart
Yet, keep Thy presence in this house
Thy kingdom come to every heart
Until Thou be entrhoned on earth.

Jah Jehovah our Holy King
Unto our weary hearts descend
Within our home with us abide
Never from us depart our plea.

745.englishTitle: FOR all the saints who from

stanzas.text:
FOR all the saints who from their labours rest
Who Thee by faith before the world confessed
Thy name, O Jesus, be for ever bless'd
Alleluia, Alleluia.

Thou wast their rock, their fortress and
their might
Thou, Lord, their Captain in the well
fought fight
Thou, in the darkness Thou their own
true light Alleluia.

Oh may Their soldier, faithful true and bold
Fight as the saints who nobly fought of old
And win with them, the victor crown
of gold Alleluia.

Oh blest Communion fellowship divine
We fecbly struggle, they in glory Shine
Yet all are one in Thee for all are Thine
Alleluia.

And when the strife is fierce, the warfare long
Steals on the ear the distant triumph song
And hearts are brave again and arms are
strong Alleluia.

The golden evening brightens in the west:
Soon soon to faithful warriors come the rest
Sweet is the calm of Paradise the bless’d
Alleluia.

But Lo, there breaks a yet more glorious day:
The Saints triumphant rise in bright array
The King of Glory passes on His way
Alleluia.

From earth’s wide bounds from ocean's
farthest coast
Through gates of pearl streams in the
countless host
Singing to Father Son and Holy Ghost
Alleluia.

746.englishTitle: THERE is a land that is fairer than day

stanzas.text:
THERE'S a land that is fairer than day
And by faith we can see it afar,
For the Father waits over the way
To prepare us a dwelling place there.
stanzas.chorus:
In the sweet-by and by
We shall meet on that
beautiful shore - 2ce

stanzas.text:
We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blessed
And our spirits shall sorrow no more
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.

To our beautiful fathers above
We will offer the tribute of praisa
For the glorious gift of His love,
And the blessings that hallow our day.

Let light perpetual shine on our paths
Since the fold of Cherubim is here
That all mankind may change from their past
To give Christ the Lord respect sincere.

When in this earthbound flesh made of dust
When our foes are set to do us harm
When ones heart are all of impure thoughts
May Johovah listen to our cries.

And when the last day shall come to pass
When a son his father will not know
Please don‘t let us be ashamed that day
May we access eternal abode.
stanzas.chorus:
In the sweet-by and by
We shall meet on that
beautiful shore - 2ce

747.englishTitle: HARK hark my soul angelic songs

stanzas.text:
HARK, hark, my soul, angelic songs
are swelling
O‘er earth green field and ocean’s
wave-beat shore
How sweet the truth those blessed
strains are telling
Of that new life when sin shall be no more!
stanzas.chorus:
Angels of Jesus, angels of light
Singing to welcome the pilgrims
of the night!

stanzas.text:
Onward we go, for still we hear them singing
Come, weary souls, for Jesus bids you come!
And through the dark its echoes
sweetly ringing
The music of the gospel leads us home.

Far, far away, like bells at evening pearling
The voice of Jesus sounds o’er land and sea
And laden souls, by thousand meekly stealing
Kind Shepherd, turn their weary steps to Thee.

Rest comes at length, though life be long and
dreary
The day must dawn and darksome
night be past
Faith‘s journey claim in welcome to
the weary
And heav’n, the heart's true home
will come at last.

Angels, sing on, your faithful watches
keeping
Sing us sweet fragments of the songs
above,
Till morning’s joy shall end the night
of weeping
And life‘s long shadows break in
cloudless love.
stanzas.chorus:
Angels of Jesus, angels of light
Singing to welcome the pilgrims
of the night!

748.englishTitle: TO Thee O Lord our hearts we raise

stanzas.text:
TO Thee, O Lord, our hearts we raise
In hymns of adoration
To Thee bring sacrifice of praise
With shouts of exultations
Bright robes of gold the field adorn
The hills with joy are ringing
The valleys stand are ringing
The valleys stand so thick with corn
That even they are singing.

And now, on this our festal day
Thy bounteous hand confessing
Before Thee thankfully we lay
The first-fruits of Thy blessing
By Thee the souls of men are fed
With gifts of grace supernals
Thou who dost give us earthly bread
Give us the bread eternal.

We bear the burden of the day
And often toil seems dreary
But labour ends with sunset ray
And rest comes for the weary
May we, the angel-reaping o’er
Stand at the last accepted
Christ's golden sheaves for evermore
To garmers bright elected.

O blessed is that land of God
Where saints abide for ever
Where golden fields spread far and broad
Where flows the crystal river
The strains of all its holy throng
With ours to-day are blending
Thrice blessed is that harvest song
Which never hath and ending.

HAPPY ani-ver-sary
Members of Seraphim
Happy ani-ver-sary
Mem‐bers of Cherubim.
stanzas.chorus:
We hail thee Kits and kins, brethren
Happy ani‐ver-sary we hail
Happy ani‐versary, many a returns.

stanzas.text:
The earthly Cherubims
Shall grow unto greatness
The earthly Seraphim
Shall spread all o'er the world.

God for our needs provides
To members of our fold
None shall lack, nor in want
Of oil, bread, nor of meat.

Us satan nay behold
Nor wicked, nor heathens
Witches, wizards shall rage
But in vain o‘er Seraph.

Holy Ghost o'er us watch
May we nay be ensnared
Forever be on guard
Ceaselessly ever pray.

Ne’er shall adversity
Ever befall us all
The universal Band
Be honest to the end.

Let us radiate love
And be in unity
May we ever be blessed
And ever be the blest.
stanzas.chorus:
We hail thee Kits and kins, brethren
Happy ani‐ver-sary we hail
Happy ani‐versary, many a returns.

750.englishTitle: ARE you trusting Jesus all along the way

stanzas.text:
Are you trusting Jesus all along the way
Does he grow more precious to your
heart each day
Are you His disciple? Test His word and see
He will give the Spirit more abundantly.
stanzas.chorus:
More abundantly, More abundantly
That they might have life
And more abundantly.

stanzas.text:
For His matehless favour magnify the name
Of our gracious Saviour who from glory came
Let the saints adore Him for this wondrous word
Sealing our redemption
Through the crimson blood.

Come to Him believing, harken to His call
All from His receiving yield to Him your all
Jesus will accept you when to Him you flee
He will grant His blessing more abunndantly.

PEACE be to Celebrating Band
Sweet anniversary today
Cherubim above descend now
Sharing of the joy divine.
stanzas.chorus:
We're dancing, rejoicing Heavenly
Host now descend - 2ce

stanzas.text:
Ye members of Sacred Movement
Come with us, rejoice today
Let none ever be excluded
Calls Christ Jesus unto all.

Cherubim and Seraphim fold
And all the prayerists Band
And you the morning worshippers
Lets Sing very loud our songs.

Ye of Mary and Martha Band
And members of Esther Band
Band of Dorcas in loud accents
Sing and let us all rejoice.

Songs of Halle-Halleluyah
With heav’nly Saints we shall rend

He is holy
Blessed, only Potentate!

He is holy
To the dust thier hearts were bore.

Tenderly did He restore
He is holy

Waits His promise to fulfil
Come, exalt Him all the living

He is holy
Worship at His holy hill.
