Charmists shall try In vain
Seraphim Will destroy them.

Masquerades rage in vain
Cherubim will destroy them.

We beseech our Leaders
Try to endure for a crown.

Our spiritual Father
Try to lead us to Canaan.

God of the Trinity
He‘s the God of Seraphim.

There in heaven above
We shall sing Halleluyah.

Join us sing Hallelu
Hallelu, Halleluyah.
stanzas.chorus:
The King of kings
The God of eternity,
King of glory.

stanzas.text:
STAND up army of Salvation
Praise the name of Christ Jesus
For the Great day witnessed today
Is for Michael our Captain.
stanzas.chorus:
Holy Michael our Captain
Holy Michael our Captain
Guide us to the end of our life
Conquer Lucifer for us.

stanzas.text:
We are grateful Michael is ours
In the Band of Seraphim
No war with Salvation army
Michael will o‘er come them all.

War in heaven with the Angels
The heavens and earth tremble
There is great fear‘ midst all the world
Michael struck Satan with sword.

Sounding voice from heaven above
Woe betide the world below
Satan is cast unto the earth
All the elect shall be saved.

Band of Cherub be not afraid
Holy Michael's our captain
Wizard Witches have no effect
On Holy Band Seraphim.

Jesus Holy Son of Father
Glory to Thy Sacred name
Michael has conquered the Satan
All satanic host vanquish'd.

When the home call trumpet is sound
We plead Thee Jehovah God
May we not by Satan destroy’d
Glorious crown may we receive.
stanzas.chorus:
Holy Michael our Captain
Holy Michael our Captain
Guide us to the end of our life
Conquer Lucifer for us.

stanzas.text:
THOU Conqueror St. Michael
m : r : d : t : l - s
Hasten descend below
r : r : m : f : s : m :
On this Victorious Day
d : l : d : r : r : d :
Delay no longer, come.

Thy Victories Our Father
Is greater than of man
Our Worshipful Father
Hasten Deliver us.

Conquer witches for us
Conquer wizard for us
Asahola-Huijuh
Conquer our enemies.

Appejuba - Hujjah
Yahwottah - Saharah
Thou with the flaming sword
Conquer witches for us.

lyamma - Iyamma
Our ever pow’rful King
Ajagorah - Hullah
Come destroy witches power.

Ye heavenly Cherubim
And Seraphim above
Rise up to render help
To us the Band below.

Emmanuel Father
Thou Conqueror of death
Thou Art Everlasting
Hasten deliver us.

Ojira-Saro Fa
El-Eli Yaworah
Whose promise never fail
Come and prosper my ways.

Glory to Father be
Glory be to the Son
And to the Holy Ghost
Praises to Trinity.

778.englishTitle: HEAVENLY Father Thou hast brought us

stanzas.text:
HEAVENLY Father, Thou hast brought us
Safely to the present day
Gently leading on our footsteps
Watching o’er us all the way
Friend and Guide through life’s long journey
Grateful hearts to Thee we bright
But for love so true and changeless
How shall we fit praises sing?

Mercies new and never failing
Brightly shine through all the past
Watchful care and lovingkindness
Always near from first to last
Tender, love, divine protection
Ever with us day and night
Blessings more than we can number
Strow the path with golden light.

Shadows deep have cross’d our pathway
We have trembled in the storm
Clouds have gather’d round so darkly
That we could not see Thy form
Yet Thy love hath never left us
In our griefs alone to be
And the help each gave the other
Was the strength that came from Thee.

Many that we lov’d have left us
Reaching first their joumey’s end
Now they wait to give us welcome
Brother, sister, child, and friend
When at last our jouney’s over
And we pass away from sigh
Father, take us through the darkness
Into everlasting light.

779.englishTitle: PRAYING Father draw nigh to us

stanzas.text:
PRAYING Father draw nigh to us
We the Cherub of the world
Jesus Christ Our Lord Has made you
Be the founder of the Band
All the world with its dwellers
Have you called to join the fold
Heaven may thy reward be
As the days are passing bye.
stanzas.chorus:
Passing bye - 4x
Many works awaits us here
As the days are passing bye.

stanzas.text:
Praying Band be in readiness
To meet Cherub of the world
Never let your girdle be slack
When you meet the Cherubim
Raise the Victory Sword up high
Glory be to Daniel’s God
Hallelujah Jesus come
As the days are passing by.

Holy Trinity is near us
All our prayers to receive
Jesus Christ is ever ready
To receive our thanks this day
Holy Spirit come to us (all)
With Thy grace protect us all
Many works awaits us here
As the days are passing bye.

String of love bind us together
As the days are passing bye
Haste and haste we draw them to us
As the days are passing bye
But the sowing that we made
By the night and day shall grow
Raise the fallen wake the dead
As the day is passing bye.
stanzas.chorus:
Passing bye - 4x
Many works awaits us here
As the days are passing bye.

stanzas.text:
BAND of Cherub, Seraphim
Band of the heav‘nly hosts
Band of the Saint Apostles
Band of the Holy Church
Hosts of the heaven above
Praise Thee all day and night
Thou God of the trinity
Most High God, Majesty.

We members of Seraphim
To Thee Father we praise
That we may do but Thine will
As in heaven its done
Be with us as we gather
ln spirit let us worship
Descend, congregate with us
Reveal Thine glory now.

Amidst numberless evil
Encamped all about us
Amidst dangers and hardship
Raging in our cities
Thanks I will to Thee offer
For Thou art my protection
Oh gracious King of goodwill
Glory be to Thy name.

When Noah offer Thee thank
Thou revealed the rainbow
Assuringly that flood will
Never submerge the earth
Father reveal the rainbow
In this our worship we plead
Evil will forever cease
Here and the universe.

Thou who this Band established
Bless us with Thine glory
Be Thou our guide and fortress
‘Midst temptations on earth
O! Father God Almighty
Thou who declare all fortunes
Bless this Band with Thine fortunes
Sake of Jesus Thy Son.

ARISE ye Band of Seraphim
All ye gird firmly your loins
God Himself establish’d this Band
Fear not but be courageous
Go evangelise His good news
He with us shall be to the end
Looking ahead to Christ Jesus
Now and unto victory.

Arise ye Band of Seraphim
Word of God spreading abroad
Through the entire universe
More unto all the wanderers
That all men on earth be redeemed
And to save all destroyed souls
Bid all to the fold of Jesus
Come! unto eternal life.

YE members of Seraphim Band
Vengeance is not of thee
Ye members of Cherubim Band)
Vengeance is not of thee) - 2ce

Members of this salvation host
Mockery is not thine lot
Resist not when the haters rage)
Antagonisers too) - 2ce

Hark ye the voice of our Saviour
Gently to us He speaks
Keep mem‘ry of my death on cross
The nail prints too on me) - 2ce

Whence we endure tribulation
All the shame too forebear
The starry crown of morning star)
We shall at last adorn) - 2ce

ln fellowship with heav'ly hosts
The Lord we shall adore
The hymns of Moses we shall rend
And that of Divine Lamb) - 2ce

Songs of Halle, Halleluyah
Songs of praise to our King
Eternal Blessed Trinity)
Father, Son and Spirit) - 2ce

REJOICE, the Lord is King
Your Lord and King adore
Mortals, give thanks and sing
And triumph ever more,
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice
Rejoice, again I say rejoice.

Jesus the Saviour reigns
The God of, truth and love
When he had purged our stains
He took, He seal above
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice
Rejoice, again I say rejoice.

He sits at God’s right hand
Till all His foes submit
And bow to his command
And fall beneath His feet
Lift up your heart, lift up voice
Rejoice again, I say rejoice.

Rejoice in glorious hope
Jesus the Judge shall come,
And take His servants up
To their eternal home
We soon shall hear archangel’s voice
The trump of God shall sound Rejoice.

784.englishTitle: ALL the world here is Seraphim

stanzas.text:
ALL the world here is Seraphim
Words of our God to proclaim
That Almighty has established
By Grace Orimolade.
stanzas.chorus:
Through the Holy Praying Father
Who has established this Order
Where Cherubim and Seraphim
Praising Him for e-ver more.

stanzas.text:
Masqueraders and occultists
Repent now before it’s late
Water of life is awaiting
Midst Cherubim Seraphim.

All friends and all our relatives
Neighbours and all admirers
Water of life is awaiting
Freely drink and thirst no more.

Michael, Gabriel, Uriel, Raphael
Ye arch angels and captains
Ye guardians of Cherub, Seraph
Ever be near us to help.

Holy Dove of heaven descend
Our Praying Father to help
For ever Holy Trinity
Eternal Glory give us.

God of our father Abraham
Father lsaac and Jacob
Father Son and Holy Spirit
Trinity Eternity.

Glory to Father we offer
To Son and Holy Spirit
To Trinity Eternity
‘Midst Cherubim, Seraphim.

Cheruhim and ye Seraphim
Spread over the universe
Gird on thy loins ever firmly
Holy gospel to proclaim.

God who harkened to Elijah
To His bossom He hath brought
Come offer help unto Moses
May we reign above with Thee.

We worship Thee Holy Father
Christ Jesus and Holy Ghost
Holy Trinity eternal
Amidst Cherub, Seraphim.

God who harkened to Elijah
His rest to take with the Lord
Come of help unto Moses be
And lead us to heav’nly rest.

God who harken’d to Abraham
Blessed Isaac and Jacob
Father, Son and Holy Spirit
The Eternal Trinity.

Heavenly, Sacred dove, descend
Come of help to Father be
Crown of glory may he adorn
That none can ever reclaim.

Arch-angels Michael and Gabriel
Twelve elders, Apostles, Saints
Christ Jesus, Emmanuel our King
Trinity, our worship‘s due.

Glory we give unto Father
Holy Son, and Holy Ghost
Trinity, the Acient of Days
Amidst the Seraphim Band.
stanzas.chorus:
Through the Holy Praying Father
Who has established this Order
Where Cherubim and Seraphim
Praising Him for e-ver more.

785.englishTitle: REJOICE all ye of the world

stanzas.text:
REJOICE all ye of the world - 2ce
Here we find a man of God - 2ce
Moses Orimolade Tunolase - 2ce
stanzas.chorus:
We are thankful we are grateful
For God who sent Moses to us. - 2ce

stanzas.text:
Mary dances Martha jumps
All in praises of Our God
These are part of what Moses did

John Jacob, Phillip
Thomas Peter and Andrew
They delivered their message to the world.
stanzas.chorus:
We are thankful we are grateful
For God who sent Moses to us
For God who sent Moses to us.

stanzas.text:
HA! Cherubim be in readiness
Ready for the fight
Satan chasing by day by night
All will be in vain.
stanzas.chorus:
Cherubim and ye Seraphim
Fasten girdles on
To attack Satanic Power
And to conquer it.

stanzas.text:
Ha! Seraphim ever stand by
Weary be ye not
Ever face all plans of devil
You will conquer all.

All ye Praying Band of Seraph
Weary be ye not
God of Seraph, God of Cherub
Ever be with you.

All ye Choristers of our Band
Get your voice prepared
To sing Halle-Hallelujah
With the Saints above.

All ye members of Seraphim
Onward ever march
We shall conquer all enemies
In the name of God.

Glory be to God the Father
Glory to His Son
Glory to the Holy Spirit
Ever ever more.
stanzas.chorus:
Cherubim and ye Seraphim
Fasten girdles on
To attack Satanic Power
And to conquer it.

stanzas.text:
BEHOLD, what star is this
How beautiful and bright!
A guide it is to the gentiles
To the King of glory.

Behold, the wisemen all
Came up from the Orient,
They came and made their obeisance
To Jesus Christ the Blest.

May Thou light of the soul
llluminate our land
Show the way, make us follow Thee
Our Lord Emmauel.

May ancestral Spirit
The images and groves
Worshipeth in the heathen lands
Give way to Christ Jesus.

May high priest of the groves
All over Africa
True Redeemed, wise men to be
Jesus‘ offering receive.

Father and creator
Jesus revealeth to
The heathens of the early days
Jesus to us reveal.

THOU, whose almighty word
Chaos and darkness heard
And took their flight
Hear us; we humbly pray
And where the Gospel‘s day
Sheds not its glorious ray
Let there be light.

Thou, who didst come to bring
On Thy Redeeming wing
Healing and might
Health to the sick in mind
Sight to the in‘ly blind
Oh now to all mankind
Let there be light.

Spirit of truth and love
Life-giving holy Dove
Speed forth Thy flight
Move on the water’s face
Bearing the lamp of grace
And in earth’s darkest place
Let there be light.

Holy and Blessed Three
The Glorious Trinity,
Wisdom, Love, might
Boundless as ocean's tide
Rolling in fullest pride
Through the world, far and wide
Let there be light.

CHERUBIM and Ye Seraphim
Offer praise to Father above
Holy Father and glorious God
Watch over us - 3ce

Christ Jesus the head of our Band
Resurrected now evermore
Cherubim and ye Seraphim
Be filled with joy - 3ce

Jehovah Jireh our great King
Jehovah Nissi oh Father
Jehovah Ruphi be our guard
Now and ever - 3ce

Ye members of Cherubim Band
Existing on the planet earth
Christ Jesus the Head of our Band
He’s risen now - 3ce

All Bands whose turbulence endures
Who also thus fervently pray
Shall sing aj oyful song on the
Resurrection - 3ce

All holy Bands in heaven above
Give praises and glory to God
Let all who dwell on earth below
Be well prepared - 3ce

Witches, wizards are invalid
Over the Band of Cherubim
Christ Jesus the Head of our Band
ls victorious.

CHERUBIM and the Seraphim
Around the throne of God
All the day and night before Him
Songs of glory they rend.
stanzas.chorus:
Singing glory, glory, glory
Singing glory, glory, glory.

stanzas.text:
Ye members of Cherubim Band
Be all of good repute
All the existing earthly Band
In fellowship divine.

Ye members of Seraphim Band
Be all of good repute
May we be merged with saints above
To praise and Him adore.

The Holy Band in the highest
Watching as we fight on
And in one accord they chorus
Progress and march onward!

Through tribulations and the thorns
Through all earthly turmoil
Through the storm of life and tempest
Our paths He gently clear.

Covenant of His sacred blood
Is all our trust and hope
Though promise fulfilment tarry
Surely shall be fulfilled.

When all our works on earth get stall’d
In this planet of woe
Crown of glory we shall adorn
Such that none else can snatch.

Glory and honour and the pow’r
Unto the Trinity
Eternal Almighty our God
Amen so shall be it.
stanzas.chorus:
Singing glory, glory, glory
Singing glory, glory, glory.

791.englishTitle: GO and tell of the glad tiding

stanzas.text:
GO and tell of the glad tiding
Make all the world to hear the news
Who hears and believes shall be saved
Those who refuse shall be condemned.

To thee I reveal great mysteries
Ye shall show forth my word of truth
In all the works that I have done
And the miracles ye shall do.

Go heal the sick and raise the dead
In my great name cast out demons
Let not my prophet ever fear
Though Jews and Gentiles should deride.

Teach all the world my commandments
And lo, l am with you always
To me belong all pow‘r and might
I can kill and can cause to live.

A light enriched Him all around
He ascended in glory great
The news was proclaim’d far and near
The ascension of our Saviour.

Cherubim, Seraphim on earth
To heaven in glory ascend
Unto a land remote, afar
News of the ascension of Christ.

IN this Holy Seraph Band
Establisheth of Moses
Peculiar people chosen of God
Though hated and mocked of men
But Cherub and Seraphim
Are conscious of serving Holy God.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh! The Band of Seraphim
Establisheth of Moses
Built on love at foundation
For all the earthly dwellers
Everlasting blessing shall we gain.

stanzas.text:
Praying Father he choseth
As a worthy lieutenant
And an able replacement at death
Worthy Apostles choseth
In the misdst of Seraph Band
The gospel to proclaim o’er the world.

As anointed men of God
Worthy examples of Christ
Humbly worship and serve in the fold
Like Apostles of the old
That thou mayest accomplish
With thine prayers burning as the fire.

Anointed female members
Mary, Martha, Esther Band
And ye worthy members of our fold
Work on and be not weary
Like virtuous women of old
Departing not from the Apostles.

May the grace of Christ Jesus
Ever be upon us all
With us abide till eternity
Ye members of Sacred Band
And the twelve Apostles, saints
Glory of God reveal o’er the earth.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh! The Band of Seraphim
Establisheth of Moses
Built on love at foundation
For all the earthly dwellers
Everlasting blessing shall we gain.

793.englishTitle: GREAT is the day the Lord hath made

stanzas.text:
GREAT is the day, the Lord hath made
When He established Seraphim
Let us exceedingly be glad
Agape love to us descend.
stanzas.chorus:
Happy day, happy day
When God established Seraphim
He taught us how to watch and pray
With one and all, our love to share
Happy day, happy day
When God established Seraphim.

stanzas.text:
All ye of earth, with us rejoice
Love divine beamed on us of God
Ye members of the Holy Band
Gladly chorus the lofty strains.

Ye Cherubim and Seraphim
Exchange agape love within
We shall ever in joyful mood
Praise the Lord for His love to us.
stanzas.chorus:
Happy day, happy day
When God established Seraphim
He taught us how to watch and pray
With one and all, our love to share
Happy day, happy day
When God established Seraphim.

794.englishTitle: SERVANTS of the Lord go proclaiming

stanzas.text:
SERVANTS of the Lord, go proclaiming Him
Go proclaiming His wonderous
and great name
Exalt the name of Christ Jesus the conqueror
His Kingdom is ever glorious above all.

Almighty reigneth in heaven above
He’s nigh unto us and always with us
This great congregation, His victory shall sing
Confessing, salvation is of Christ Jesus.

Salvation belong to our reigning God
All the earth chorus give grace to the Son
Hosts of angels sing praises to Christ Jesus
Reverendly bow in worship to Christ Jesus.

Oh come let’s worship and offer Him praise
Glory, power, wisdom and also the strength
Honour and blessing with the angelic hosts
Everlasting thanks and love for ever more.

795.englishTitle: TELL it out among the heathen that

stanzas.text:
TELL it out among the heathen
that the Lord is King
Tell is out Tell it out
Tell it among the nations, let
them shout and sing
Tell it out, tell it out
Tell it out with adoration that He
shall increase
That the mighty King of Glory is
the King of Peace
Tell it out with jubilation, though
the waves may roar,
That He stitteth on the water-floods
our King for ever-more.

Tell it out among the heathen
that the Saviour reigns
Tell it out Tell it out
Tell it out among the nations, bid
them burst their chains
Tell it out Tell it out
Tell it out among the weeping ones
that Jesus lives
Tell it out amongst the weary ones
that rest He gives
Tell it out among the sinful that He
came rest He gives
Tell it out among the dying that
He triumphed o‘er the grave.

Tell it out amongst the heathens
Jesus reigns above
Tell it out Tell it out
Tell it out among the nations that
His reign is love
Tell it out Tell it out
Tell it out among the highways and
the lanes at home
Let it ring across the mountains and
the oceans foam!
Like the sound of many waters, let
our glad shout be,
Till it echo and re-echo from the
Islands of the sea!

"SERVANT of God, well done
From all your labour rest
Thou has fought and Thou has triumphed
Enter Thy Master’s joy”
The call came in the night
He rais‘d himself to hear
The arrow of death enter'd in
He fell, but did not fear.

The midnight cry went forth
Arise to meet thy God
He woke, and saw his commander
Through prayer and in faith
His soul rose up at once
Left this body of clay
When morn broke, this body of clay
Was found lying down dead.

The pangs of death is past
Cares and distress are o'er
The days of fighting are all gone
His heart has found real peace
Soldier of Christ, ‘well done'
Keep singing songs of joy
Take thy rest in Thy Saviour's breast
And rest eternally.

HE's asleep Jesus saith
Of Lazarus His friend
Was dead, buried beneath the earth
In the sepulchre laid.

Four whole days he was dead
He's asleep Jesus saith
Jesus, resurrection and life
Unto all that believes.

Christ friends ever shall live
To celestial being form
Away from earthly worms and dust
With Angelic hosts fly.

Sleep on! sleep on! belov'd
Thy companion is Christ
Be courageous, soundeth His voice
Thou shall with me “arise”.

Soon His voice thou shall hark
From thy rest home below
The sounding voice of Christ Jesus
To thee saying arise!.

Thine sorrow bid away
But be alive in hope
Dear belov'd farewell, thee we bid
Sleep on and take thy rest.

We shall to rest be laid
When to us sound the call
That we at dawn may meet again
At the feet of Lord.

798.englishTitle: SHALL we gather at the river

stanzas.text:
SHALL we gather at the river
There bright Angel feet have trod;
With its crystal tide for ever
Flowing by the throne of God?
stanzas.chorus:
Yes, we’ll gather at the river
The beautiful the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river,
That flows by the throne of God.

stanzas.text:
On the margin of the river,
Washing up its silver spray,
We will walk and worship ever,
All the happy, golden day.

Ere we reach the shinning river
Lay we every burden down;
Grace our Spirits will deliver,
And provide a robe and crown.

At the shinning of the river,
Mirror of the Saviour‘s face,
Saints whom death will never never,
Raise their songs of saving grace.

Soon we‘ll reach the silver river
Soon our pilgrimage will cease;
Soon our happy hearts will quiver
With the melody of peace.
stanzas.chorus:
Yes, we’ll gather at the river
The beautiful the beautiful river;
Gather with the saints at the river,
That flows by the throne of God.

799.englishTitle: OUR life span is all but seventy years

stanzas.text:
OUR life span is all but seventy years
Like the hirelings day
Just like flowery weeds, we shall be
hewned down
And we shall thus pass on.
stanzas.chorus:
Goodbye, goodbye, dear beloved
Goodbye, goodbye, dear beloved
Goodbye, till the resurrection day.

stanzas.text:
Though the grass is dead, it lives no more
Thou art dead yet to live
And thou shall adorn unfading crown
At the bossom of the Saviour.

ln fellowship we are, previous months
Lo! You are no more now
Our dear beloved not in a sojourn
But transiting by death.

May we be tutored by this instance
To amend our characters
Sapped tree may erect, while
flourishing one
May yet be hewned down soon.

Our testimonies, is our deeds on earth
Revealing how we end
Beloved thy good works transit with thee
Thine best thou hath done on earth.

We condole with thee, family and Band
Of our departed one,
We shall fellowship in heaven above
On the resurrection day.
stanzas.chorus:
Goodbye, goodbye, dear beloved
Goodbye, goodbye, dear beloved
Goodbye, till the resurrection day.

stanzas.text:
ALL dearly cherished brethren
Amidst Band of Seraphim
ln eternal transition
Their memory doth we not have.

All dearly cherished brethren
Amidst Band of Cherubim
Congregating with the Saints
In heavenly stock their reward.

All dearly cherished brethren
Amidst the Prayerist Band
To the dead all works had ceased
Before the Lord Jesus Christ.

They are all through victorious
In honour of their Saviour
The’ve heard Jesus commending
Access the joy of thine Lord.

Oh Lord hearken to our prayers
Worthy we may be with Thee
Shinning in starry array
Eternally with the Lord.

Glory to our Father give
Glory also to His Son
Glory to Holy Spirit
Glory to the Trinity.

801.englishTitle: BLESSED are the dead in the Lord

stanzas.text:
BLESSED are the dead in the Lord
In Him alone they slept
Record it thus the spirit spake
Their toils trails on with them.

From all hard toil they take a rest
From this wilderness here
Rejoicing amidst Host of Saints
ln heaven there above.

Much and recountless is their joy
Almidst the Glorious Hosts
Christ Jesus in whom all they trust
Comfort to them He grant.

Numberless are the Cherubim
Around the throne of God,
Countless number of Seraphims
Singing Helleluyah.

Twenty and four celestial beings
And four Angelic beings
Around the throne of the Saviour
Singing Holy, Holy.

How great the beauty and glory?
Much and recountless be
Glitt’ring are the Saints in glory
Singing the Moses hymns.

Glory be to Father on high
Glory be to the Son
Glory to the Holy Spirit
Eternal Triune God.

802.englishTitle: HARK the divine voice from on high

stanzas.text:
HARK the divine voice from on high
To the dead, to the saints
Sweet is the memory of their name
Their state with comfort filled.

Sound they slept in Blessed Jesus
How sweet and sound they slept
Though in deep agony and sin
From travails they are free.

Further away from sinful world
With the Lord they abide
Their toil on deadly earth below
Crowned with a great reward.

803.englishTitle: WHEN our heads are bowed with woe

stanzas.text:
WHEN our heads are bowed with woe
When our bitter tears o’er flow
When we morn the lost, the dear
Jesus, Man of Sorows, hear!

Thou our throbbing flesh hast worn
Thou our mortal griefs hast borne
Thou hast shed the human tear
Jesus, man of Sorrow hear!

When the heart is sad within
With the thought of all its sin
When the spirit shrinks with fear
Jesus, Man of Sorrow, hear!

Thou the shame, the grief, hast known
Though the sins were not Thine own
Thou hast deign’d our load to bear
Jesus, Man of Sorrow, hear!

When the solemn death-bell tools
For our own departing souls
When our final doom is near
Jesus, Man of Sorrow, hear!

Thou hast bow’d the dying Head
Thou the Blood of Life hast shed
Thou hast fill’d a mortal bier
Jesus, Man of Sorrow, hear!.

804.englishTitle: HARK they are now at the shore

stanzas.text:
HARK! they are now at the shore
In heaven, In heaven
No more food, no more hunger
No more pain and no more care
In heaven, In heaven.

There they need no light to see
In heaven, In heaven
There is light in all their days
Jesus Christ their light their all
In heaven, ln heaven.

Ha! the streets are all but gold
In heaven, In heaven,
And as great is their glory
Holy Band of Christ they are
In heaven, In heaven.

Ha! they suffer no more cold
In heaven, In heaven
Their cold season ever passed
All their days are bright and fair
In heaven, In heaven.

Ha! no one will quarrel there
In heaven, In heaven
Jesus Christ has saved them there
And He ever walk with them
In heaven, In heaven.

Ha! no weeping with the Lord
In heaven, In heaven
Jesus being always with them
Will for ever joy with them
In heaven, In heaven.

Ha! one day we shall join them
In heaven, In heaven
When our time shall come in peace
And our Lord will call us home
In heaven, In heaven.

805.englishTitle: HOW sweet the hour of closing day

stanzas.text:
HOW sweet the hour of closing day
When all is peaceful and serene
And the broad sun’s retiring ray
Seeds a mild lustre o’er the scene!

Such is the Christian’s parting hour
So peacefully he sinks to rest
And faith, rekindling all its pow’r
Lights up the deepest of his breast.

There is a radiance in his eye
A smile upon his wasted cheek,
That seems to tell of glory nigh
In language that no tongues can speak.

A beam from heav’n is sent to cheer
The pilgrim on his gloomy road
And angels are attending near
To hear him to their bright abode.

O Lord, that we may thus depart
Thy joys to share, Thy face to see
Impress Thine image on our heart
And teach us now to walk with Thee. Amin

806.englishTitle: NOW the Laborer’s task is o’er

stanzas.text:
NOW the Laborer’s task is o’er
Now the battle day is past
Now upon the farther shore
Lands the voyager at last.
stanzas.chorus:
Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy Servant sleeping.

stanzas.text:
There the tears of earth are dried
There its hidden thing are there;
There the work of life is tried
By a juster Judge than here.

There the Shepherd bringing home
Many a lamb forlorn and strayed
Shelters each no more to roam
where the Wolf can never invade.

There the penitents that turn
To the cross their dying eyes
All the love of Jesus learn
At His feet in Paradise.

There no more the powers of hell
Can prevail to mar their peace
Christ the Lord shall guard them well
He who died for their release.

“Earth to earth, and dust dust”
Calmly now the words we say
Left behind we wait in trust
Till the resurrection day.
stanzas.chorus:
Father, in Thy gracious keeping
Leave we now Thy Servant sleeping.

807.englishTitle: SLEEP on beloved sleep and take

stanzas.text:
Calm is thy slumber as an infant’s sleep’
But thou shalt wake no more to toil and weep"
Thine is a perfect rest, secure and deep
Goodnight! Goodnight! Goodnight!.

Until the Easter glory light the skies;
Until the dead in Jesus shall arise,
And He shall come, but not in lowly guise
Goodnight! Goodnight! Goodnight!.

Until made beautiful by love Divine,
Thou in the likeness of thy Lord shall shine,
And He shall bring that golden crown of shine,
Goodnight! Goodnight! Goodnight!.

Only ‘good-night' beloved-not ‘farewell!
A little while, and all His saints shall dwell
In hallowed, union indivisible
Goodnight! Goodnight! Goodnight!.

Until we meet again before His throne,
Clothed in spotless robe He gives His own
Until we know even as we have known
Goodnight! Goodnight! Goodnight!.

808.englishTitle: THE flowers that beautified the field

stanzas.text:
THE flow'rs that beautified the field
That looked tender and fresh
When touched by sickle, it will die
It falls and withers off.

This example is fit for us
According to God's word
Let young and old take heed and know
That they are but like grass.

Put not your trust on fleeting breath
Call not your times your own
Around, we see sickle of death
Cut down thousands of souls.

Those who are spared until this day
Soon, life will also end
Prepare, be wise before the time
The death angel will come.

The grass, when dead, will wake no more
Die, thou, that thou may live
What, if death were the door that leads
To everlasting pain.

O Lord, help us answer Thy call
Let us depart from sin
And when we fall down like the grass
Let our souls come to Thee.

HUSH! blessed are the dead
In Jesus’ arms who rest
And lean their weary head
Forever on His breast.

Oh beautiful a sight!
No darkling veil between
They see the Light of Light
Whom here they loved unseen.

For them the world is past
With all its toil and care
Its withering midnight blast
Its fiery noonday glare.

Them the good shepherd leads
Where storms are never rife
In tranquil dewy meads
Beside the Fount of life.

Ours only are the tears
Who weep around their tomb
The light of bygone years
And shadowmg years to come.

Their voice their touch their smile
Those love-spring flowing o'er
Earth for its little while
Shall never know them more.

O tender hearts and true
Our long last vigil kept
We weep and mourn for you
Nor blame us Jesus wept.

But soon at break of day
His calm Almighty voice
Stronger than death shall say
Awake, arise, and rejoice.

810.englishTitle: HERE we suffer grief and pain

stanzas.text:
HERE we suffer grief and pain
Here we meet to part again
In heaven we part no more.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh, that will be joyful
Joyful, joyful, joyful
Oh that will be joyful
When we meet to part
no more.

stanzas.text:
All who love the Lord below
When they die to heaven will go
And join with saints above.

Little children will be there
Who have sought the Lord by prayer
From every Sunday School.

Teachers too, will meet above
Pastors parent, whom we love
Shall meet to part no more.

Oh, how happy we shall be
For our Saviour we shall see
Exalted on His throne.

There we shall sing for joy
And eternity employ
In praising Christ the Lord.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh, that will be joyful
Joyful, joyful, joyful
Oh that will be joyful
When we meet to part
no more.

811.englishTitle: YEAR in year out souls are revived

stanzas.text:
YEAR in, year out souls are revived
Granted thou unto us
What, where and how ever we be
To the grave we shall end.

I All around us dangers abound
That we may thus ensnared
Epidemics around exists
To send us there beyond.

Eternal joy or woe unend
For all our souls doth wait
Uncaring we trod all about
A’brink of death and grave.

Revive us Lord from our slumber
Path of danger to see
When our souls are hence called oh Lord
To dwell ever with Thee.

812.englishTitle: AS the mourning bell loudly sound

stanzas.text:
AS the mourning bell loudly sound
Calling upon the passing souls
Let every one to probe himself
Are we prepared if death now calls.

Now to forsake all earthly stock
And straight depart the judgment throne
And the voice of the Judge to hear
He shall my lot to me disclose.

WillI be pleased, if He should say
Get thee away from me thou cursed
To eternal furnance in hell
Prepared for satan and his hosts.

Lord Jesus Saviour, save my soul
I repose my trust upon Thee
Perdition way teach me to see
Teach me to live ever with Thee.

813.englishTitle: WE shall stand before the King

stanzas.text:
WE shall stand before the King
With the ANGELS we shall sing
By and by... by and by!...
Walk the bright, the golden shore,
Praising Him for evermore
Beyond by... by and by..
stanzas.chorus:
We shall stand before the King
With the Angels we shall sing;
Glory, glory to our King!
Hallelu-yah! Hallelu-yah
We shall stand... before the King.

stanzas.text:
Ring, ye bells of heaven, ring
We shall stand before Thee
By and by.. by and by...
There our sorrows will be o’er
There His name we will adore,
By and by.. by and by...

stanzas.chorus:
We shall stand before the King
With the Angels we shall sing;
Glory, glory to our King!
Hallelu-yah! Hallelu-yah
We shall stand... before the King.

stanzas.text:
TEN Thousand times ten thousand
In sparkling raiment bright
The armies of the ransomed saints
Throng up the steeps of light
Tis finished, all is finished
Their fight with death and sin
Fling open wide the golden gates
And let the victors in.

What rush of hallelujah
Fills all the earth and sky
What ringing of a thousand harps
Be speaks the triumph nigh!
O day for which creation
And all its tribes were made!
O joy, for all its former woes
A thousand-fold repaid!.

O then what raptured greetings
On Canaan’s happy shore
What knitting severed friendship up
Where partings are no more!
Then eyes with joy shall sparkle
That brimmed with tears of late
Orphans no longer fatherless
Nor widows desolate.

Bring near Thy great salvation
Thou Lamb for sinners slain
Fill up the roll of Thine elect,
Then take Thy power and reigns
Appear, Desire of nations
Thine exiles long for home
Show in the heav‘ns Thy promised sign
Thou Prince and Saviour, come.

815.englishTitle: GOLDEN day a day of God

stanzas.text:
GOLDEN day a day of God
Unblemished heart in the vineyard
Great joy nay found here on the earth
Paradise place of comfort.
stanzas.chorus:
O! Paradise, O! Paradise
We tarry though here on earth
O! Paradise place of light
Christ Jesus reigns there above.

stanzas.text:
Stumble and fall flesh of shame
Thine judgment in death shall be
Snare of sin there forgotten
Paradise shall our abode be.

Nay prayer and may danger
Nay condolence, nay re-stataments
Nay supulcher and no grief
None above, found in paradise.

Christ Jesus Lord on the tree
Sinner cried, remember me
This day thou shall with me be
In paradise heaven above.

Golden resurrection day
Grief ceased as the grave openeth
Glory cometh, dead shall live
To reign with Him in paradise.

Cherubim, Seraphim rejoice
Worthy is it for thy joy
Salvation path, Jesus made
From the earth to heaven above.

Labour hardly for reward
Searching wisely for the gospel
Lest we come short of paradise
Glory be to the Trinity.
stanzas.chorus:
O! Paradise, O! Paradise
We tarry though here on earth
O! Paradise place of light
Christ Jesus reigns there above.

stanzas.text:
THE Church’s one foundation
ls Jesus Christ her Lord
She is His new creation
By water and the word
From heav'n He came and sought her
To be His holy bride
With His own blood He bought her,
And for her life He died.

Elect from every nation
Yet one o’er all the earth
Her charter of salvation
One Lord, one faith, one birth
One holy name she blesses
Partakes one holy food
And to one hope she presses,
With every grace endued.

Though with a scornful wonder
Men see her sore oppressed
By schisms rent asunder
By heresies distressed
Yet saints their watch are keeping
Their cry goes up: How long?
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song.

Mid toil and tribulation
And tumult of her war
She waits the consummation
Of peace for evermore
Till with the vision glorious
Her longing eyes are blest
And the great Church victorious
Shall be the Church at rest.

Yet she on earth hath union
With God the Three in One
And mystic sweet communion
With those whose rest is won
O happy ones and holy!
Lord, give us grace that we
Like them the meek and lowly
On high may dwell with Thee.

SERVANTS of Christ the Lord
Hark! sounds the voice of God
The pathway thee He leads to trail
His way, thee calls to tread.

Father whom all thee serve
Strength hath He to bestow
His promises fervently trust
Fight manfully onward.

Manifest ye the Lord
And His mercies oh great!
Amidst the wretched sinners all
Of Adam’s fallen race.

Account of Christ our Lord
“Farewell to thee we bid
We pray thy Maker and our Lord
To prosper all thy works.

JESUS Thy service bestow
Perfect joy on earth below
Jesus Thy service bestow
Perfect comfort though in death.

Beyond death there is a joy
Joy eternal, ne’er to end
God be mine is all my plea
My joy knows no end for aye.

819.englishTitle: GOD be with you till we meet again

stanzas.text:
GOD be with you till we meet again
By His counsels guide, uphold you
With His sheep securely fold you
God be with you till we meet again.
Chirus: Till we meet, till we meet
Till we meet, ByJesus grace
Till we meet, till we meet
God be with you till we meet again.

God be with you till meet again
‘Neath His wings securely hide you
Daily manna still provide you
God be with you till we meet again.
Chirus: Till we meet...

God be with you till we meet again
When life’s perils thick confound you
Put His arms unfailing round you
God be with you till we meet again.
Chirus: Till we meet...

God be with you till we meet again
Keep love’s banner floating o’er you
Smite death’s threaning wave before you
God will be with you till we meet again.
Chirus: Till we meet, till we meet
Till we meet, ByJesus grace
Till we meet, till we meet
God be with you till we meet again.

820.englishTitle: WE love the place O God

stanzas.text:
WE love the place, O God,
Wherein Thine honour dwells
The joy of Thine abode
All earthly joy excels.

It is the house of prayer
Wherein Thy servants meet
And Thou, O Lord, art there
Thy chosen flock to greet.

We love the sacred font
For there the Holy Dove
Pours out, as He is wont
The effluence from above.

We love the word of life
The word that tells of peace
Of comfort in the strife,
And joys that never cease.

We love to sing below
For mercies freely given
But oh! we long to know
The truimph-song of heaven.

Lord Jesus, give us grace
On earth to love Thee more
In heaven to see Thy face
And with Thy saints adore.

821.englishTitle: COME let us all unite and sing

stanzas.text:
COME let us all unite and sing
God is love!
While heaven and earth their praises bring
God is love!
Let every soul from sin awake
Each in his heart sweet music
And sweetly sing for Jesus sake
God is love!

O tell to earth's remotest bound
God is love
In Christ is full redemption found
God is love
His blood can cleanse our sins away
His Spirit turns our night to day
And leads our souls with joy to say
God is love.

How happy is our portion here
God is love
His promises our spirit cheer
God is love
He is Sun and Shield by day
By night He near our tents will stay
He will be with us all way
God is love!

In Zion we shall sing again
God is love
Yet this shall be our highest strain
God is love
Whilst endless ages roll along
In concert with the heav’nly throng
This shall be still our sweetest song
God is love.

HOLY Father, hear me
Thou art my defender
Be thou ever near me
Loving true, and tender.

Jesus, blessed Master
Lord of Life and glory
Bid the hours fly faster
Till I kneel before Thee.

Comforter denignest
Who abiding in me
All my need divinest,
Move me, draw me, win me.

Holy, Holy, Holy
Come and leave me never,
Thine abode most lowly
Only Thine for ever.

823.englishTitle: SING them over again to me

stanzas.text:
SING them over again to me
Wonderful words of Life
Let me more of their beauty see
Wonderful words of Life
Words of life and beauty
Teach me faith and duty
Beautiful words, wonderful words.
stanzas.chorus:
Wonderful words of Life
Beautiful words of Life.

stanzas.text:
Christ the blessed One, gives to all
Wonderful words of Life
Sinner, list to the loving call
Wonderful words of Life
All so freely given
Wooing us to Heaven.

Sweetly echo the gospel call,
Wonderful words of Life
Offer pardon and peace to all
Wonderful words of Life
Jesus, only Saviour
Sanctify for ever.
stanzas.chorus:
Wonderful words of Life
Beautiful words of Life.

824.englishTitle: JESUS the Head of Holy Band

stanzas.text:
JESUS the Head of Holy Band
Bless us here before we go;
Father, source of plenteous blessing
Descend Thy spirit on us.
stanzas.chorus:
Jah Jehovah - 2ce
Glory, honour to our King. - 6x

stanzas.text:
Christ Jesus, Saviour we do plead,
Save us from world temptation;
Provide for us, bless our handwork,
Let Thy children never lack.

Bless us throughout the days of life
Save (us) from hunger at old age,
Let us not lament we pray Thee
Let us stand firm to the end.

Kindle the light of Thy Spirit,
Amidst Cherub and Seraphim,
As our counterpart in Heaven
Let us all serve Thee with joy.

Remember all our branches Lord
Grant them thy Holy Spirit
Save them from witches and wizards
Be their only protector.

Jehovah Jireh Lord our King
Jehovah Nisi Father
Jehovah Shalom be our guide
Till end of our days on earth.
stanzas.chorus:
Jah Jehovah - 2ce
Glory, honour to our King. - 6x

825.englishTitle: MAY the grace of Christ our Saviour

stanzas.text:
MAY the grace of Christ our Saviour
And the Father’s boundless love
With the Holy Spirit's favour
Rest upon us from above.

Thus may we abide in union
With each other and the Lord
And abide in sweet communion
Joy which earth cannot afford.

826.englishTitle: SAVIOUR again to Thy dear name

stanzas.text:
SAVIOUR, again to Thy dear
name we raise
With one accord our parting
hymn of praise
We stand to bless Thee ere
our worship cease
Then, lowly kneeling, wait
Thy word of peace.

Grant us Thy peace upon our
homeward way
With Thee began, with Thee
shall end the day
Guard Thou the lips from sin,
the hearts from shame
That in this house have called
upon Thy name.

Grant us Thy peace Lord, through
the coming night
Turn Thou for us its darkness into
light
From harm and danger keep Thy
children free
For dark and light are both alike to Thee.

Grant us Thy peace throughout
our ear-thly life.
Our balm in sorrow, and our stay
in strife
Then, when Thy voice shall bid our
con‐flict cease
Call us, O Lord, to Thine eternal peace.

827.englishTitle: GOD is here and that to bless us

stanzas.text:
GOD is here, and that to bless us
With the Spirit’s quickening power
See the cloud already bending
Waits to drop the grateful shower.
stanzas.chorus:
Let it come... O Lord we pray Thee!
Let the shower .. of blessing fall
We are waiting we are waiting
Oh revive, the hearts of all!

stanzas.text:
God is here! we feel His presence
In this consecrated place;
But we need the soul refreshing
Of His free, unbounded grace.

God is here! oh, then believing
Bring to Him our one desire
That His love may now be kindled
Till its flame each heart inspire.

Saviour grant the prayer we offer
While in simple faith we bow
From the windows of Thy mercy
Pour us out a blessing now.
stanzas.chorus:
Let it come... O Lord we pray Thee!
Let the shower .. of blessing fall
We are waiting we are waiting
Oh revive, the hearts of all!

828.englishTitle: BLESS us this day we beseech

stanzas.text:
BLESS us this day we beseech
Thee oh our Lord
Our eyes are lifted up to Thee
Blessings thou gavest Abraham
our Father
We pray Thee to bless us.
stanzas.chorus:
Alpha and Omega
Our hearts are lifted up unto thee
Let us not go unblessed.

stanzas.text:
Holy Trinity the Omnipotent God
Indiscernible deepest Love,
Incomprehensible Great Jehovah
Shower blessings on us.

We lift up our voices to Father today
Let us not lament Lord we pray
Let evil power separate us not from Thee
Protect us Lord we pray.

Thou who brought water from the
rock in those days
For thine elects in olden days
Manna from above raineth to them for meat
We beseech Thee bless us.
stanzas.chorus:
Alpha and Omega
Our hearts are lifted up unto thee
Let us not go unblessed.

stanzas.text:
COME, Jesus reveal Thyself
Come, our hearts teach to know Thee
Come, and set our hearts on fire
Come, and bless us ere we part.

Come, put peace within our hearts
Come, that we all may be blessed
Come, and speak the words of peace,
Come, our faith increase, O Lord.

Come, make all our doubtings flee
Come, and teach us how to pray
Come, and fill our hearts with love,
Come, and lift our hearts to heaven.

Come, and make our hearts rejoice
Come, and say, ‘You are my choice
Come, Thy fold in safety keep
Come, and bless Thy sheep today.

ALL worship now our King
The Holy Son of God
Creator, protector
The Redeemer and Saviour of all.
stanzas.chorus:
Let the whole world how before
God Almighty
Whom all the world hath redeemed
Halleluyah! Raise the victorious song
To the Trinity our blessed King.

stanzas.text:
Breathe thou upon us Lord
Let us Thy glory share
The fountain of our lives
Benevolent King, Glorious, Divine.

The earth and it's fulness
They all to Thee belong
Those who truly believe
Shall, them inherit for ever-more.

The Harvest now is ripe
Let us all be prepared
The Harvester is nigh
The good grain, only, He shall preserve.

When Thou shall here return
Do not deny me, Lord
By Thine bountiful grace
Make us wothy to reign with the saints.
stanzas.chorus:
Let the whole world how before
God Almighty
Whom all the world hath redeemed
Halleluyah! Raise the victorious song
To the Trinity our blessed King.

stanzas.text:
I’ve found a Friend, oh such a friend
He loved me ere I knew Him
He drew me, with the cords of love
And thus He bound me to Him
And round my heart still closer twine
Those ties which naught can sever
For I am His, and He is mine
For ever and ever for aye.

I've found a friend, oh, such a friend
He bled, He died to save me
And not alone the gift of life
But His own self me He gave
Naught that I have my own I call
I hold it for the Giver
My heart, my strength, my life, my all
Are His, and His for ever.

l've found a friend, oh, such a friend
All pow'r to Him is given
To guard me on my onward course
And bring me safe to heaven
Th'eternal glories gleam afar
To nerve my faint endeavour
So now to watch, to work, to war
And then to rest for ever.

I‘ve found a friend, oh, such a friend
So kind, and true and tender
So wise a Counsellor and Guide
So mighty a Defender
From Him who loves me now so well
What pow'r my soul can sever?
Shall life or death, or earth or hell
No, I am His for ever.

832.englishTitle: PRAISE to the Holiest in the height

stanzas.text:
PRAISE to the Holiest in the height
And in the depth be praise
In all His words most wonderful
Most sure in all His ways.

O loving wisdom of our God
When all was sin and shame
A second Adam to the fight
And to the rescue came.

O Wisest love! that flesh and blood
Which did in Adam fail
Should strive afresh against the foe
Should strive and should prevail.

And that a higher gift than grace
Should flesh and blood refine
God‘s Presence and His very self
And Essence all-Divine.

O gen’rous love! that He, Who smote
In Man for man the fee
The double agony in Man
For man should undergo.

And in the garden secretly
And on the Cross on high
Should teach His brethren, and inspire
To suffer and to die.

Praise to the Holiest in the height
And in the depth be praised
In all His words most wonderful
Most sure in all His ways.

THANKS we offer unto God
Who offered us Christ Jesus
To redeem the universe
From the hold of satan and sin.
stanzas.chorus:
Praise Him loudly, offer Him thanks
Holy God the Trinity
For His mercies and favour
Broadly on the Seraphim Band.

stanzas.text:
Divine power of God doth grow
Glory of Jesus manifests
The pow’r of Holy Spirit dwells
Amidst the Band of Seraphim.

All men and nations on earth
Bow down in pray'r unto God
Repent ye in Spirit of Truth
May Father above save us.

Sins increaseth, earth is troubled
Satan pilfers and rejoicing
Let all Christians congregate
In prayers to conquer satan.

All ye pious believers
Jesus knows thine hidden works
No further arguement with God
Thine divine teacher is nigh.

Cherub, Seraph be ready
Priests and Bishops be prepared
Jesus disciples be ready
For the latterday of judgement.

We celebrates anniversary
As commanded Saint Moses
To Christen this Holy Band
Host of Seraphim below.

Band of Moses be ready
‘Misdt Band of Cherub, Seraph
Given us by Father, God
Hoist up its banner high now.

Lo! Pagan and muslims come
All ye Christians follow suit
Let us all praise Holy God
Crown of life may we receive.

Be merciful God to us
Forgive and preserve us all
Be of help, receive our prayers
Now and till eternity.
stanzas.chorus:
Praise Him loudly, offer Him thanks
Holy God the Trinity
For His mercies and favour
Broadly on the Seraphim Band.

834.englishTitle: LET us sing the song of praise

stanzas.text:
LET us sing the song of praise
Hallelujah
Sing the song of praise to Almighty,
For his protection o’er us Hallelujah
Songs of joy to thee God of glory.
stanzas.chorus:
Shout for joy oh ye brethren
Sing chorus of praise to him
Shout for joy oh ye sisters Hallelujah
Sing Chorus of praise to Almighty.

stanzas.text:
Let us sing the song of praise
Halleluyah
For his daily victory on our ways
He saved us from enemies
Halleluyah
Song of joy to thee God of glory.

Let us sing the song of praise
Halleluyah
For his wonderous work to his children
Satan's plan he did destroy Halleluyah
He grant us grace in our temptations.

Let us sing the song of praise
Halleluyah
For development of Holy Spirit
For calling us to the fold Halleluyah
He saved us from straying to the world.

To God (the) Father be praises
Halleluyah
Glory be to God our Lord the Son
To God the Holy Spirit Halleluyah
To Trinity be honour and praise.
stanzas.chorus:
Shout for joy oh ye brethren
Sing chorus of praise to him
Shout for joy oh ye sisters Hallelujah
Sing Chorus of praise to Almighty.  Amin

835.englishTitle: HOW great the glory of our King

stanzas.text:
HOW great the glory of our King
Who abide high above
Oh! what a kid, His hymns can rend
In honour of His name.

Who may recount His strength divine
And of His grace divine
Not one on earth and high above
Their greatness to reveal.

Even Angels around the Lord
Him, may not they discern
But His comandments all they keep
To Him, rend hymns of praise.

I would with them, the hymn to rend
My offering to Him brought
King of glory wilt not despise
Voices of heav’nly kids.

Be ready, my soul and my tongue
To rend the hymns of praise
Unto Almighty Creator
Joy of Angelic hosts.

BLESSED be the power divine
The Truth and the Wisdom
And blessed be the Grace divine
Whom, our salvation earn.

Forbiden fruit, our fathers chew
His glory all was lost
All we descendants thus enslaved
Unto satan and death.

Thanks we give to Father and Son
For His Son, us He gave
He who hath died that we may live
Adopting us for God.

All Father’s commands disobeyed
ls Christ, Son who was slained
His life He offered on the cross
Thus, all our sins He bore.

Alas! He‘s risen from the grave
To heaven He ascend
There in heaven by His honour
All sinners He doth save.

He reigneth on the glorious throne
With divine power and strenght
The chains and bounds of sin He broke
Our liberty we gain.

He shall return, the world to judge
In great honour divine
Thither He shall all saints recall
Out from the grave with joy.

May I partake of the great Joy
Before the Greatest Judge
Redemption songs would I to rend
ln worship with the saints.

837.englishTitle: ALL the poor on earth that I know

stanzas.text:
ALL the poor on earth that I know
Multitude, numberless
What can I offer to my God
For all His gifts received.

My lot is fairer than others
As God cares much for me
More to me than the destitutes
Who wanders all about.

Many are kids walking in rags
ln cold winters about
While I am decked in fitting cloak
Me looking cute all through.

While many others homeless be
No place to live nor dwell
But to me befitting abode
And blessings from above.

Many are they that are liars
Some steal and falsely swear
Thee I learn to worship in awe
From whence l but a babe.

Imagine His favour to me
Much unto me alone
Thou doth deserve that Thee l’ll love
And me to worship Thee.

838.englishTitle: MY God is any hour so sweet

stanzas.text:
MY God, is any hour so sweet
me blush of morn to evening star
As that which calls me to Thy feet,
The hour of prayer.

Blest be that tranquil hour of morn
And blest that hour at solemn eve,
When, on the wings of prayer upborne
The world I leave.

For then a day-spring shines on me
Brighter than morn’s eternal glow
And richer dews descend from Thee
Than earth can know.

Then is my strength by Thee renew'd
Then are my sins by Thee forgiven
Then dost Thou cheer my solitude
With hopes of heaven.

No words can tell what blast relief
There for my every want I find
What strength for warfare, balm for grief
What peace of mind.

Hush’d every doubt: gone every fear
My spirit seems in heaven to stay
And ev’n the penitential tear
Is wiped away.

Lord, till I reach the blissful shore,
No privilege so dear shall be
As thus my inmost soul to pour
ln prayer to Thee.

839.englishTitle: MUST I go and empty handed

stanzas.text:
MUST I go, and empty handed
Thus my dear Redeemer meet?
Not one day of service give Him
Lay no trophy at his feet?
stanzas.chorus:
Must I go, and empty handed
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him
Must I empty handed go?

stanzas.text:
Not at death I shrink nor falter
For my Saviour saves me now
But to meet Him empty handed
Thought of that now clouds my brow.

O the years in singing wasted
Could I but recall the now
I would give them to my Saviour
To His will I'd gladly bow.

O ye saints‘ arouse, be earnest
Up and work while yet tis day
Ere the night of death o‘er take thee
Strive for souls while still you may.

Members of the prayerist Band
Thy sword of victory lift high
Against satan advance to war
For Christ the King of Glory.

Ye Leaders of Cherub, Seraf
Go spread my gospel abroad
Crown of glory all thou shall earn
When cometh the latter-day.
stanzas.chorus:
Must I go, and empty handed
Must I meet my Saviour so?
Not one soul with which to greet Him
Must I empty handed go?

stanzas.text:
JESUS only is our Message
Jesus all our theme shall be
We will lift up Jesus ever
Jesus only will we see.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus only, Jesus ever
Jesus all in all we sing
Saviour; Sanctifier, Healer
Baptizer and coming King.

stanzas.text:
Jesus only is our Saviour
All our guilt He bore away
All our righteousness He gives us
All our strength from day to day.

Jesus is our Sanctifier
Cleansing us from self and sin
And with all His Spirit's fulness
Filling all our hearts within.

Jesus only is our Healer
All our sicknesses He bore
And His risen life and fulness
All His members still may share.

Jesus only is our Power
He’s the gift of Pentecost
Jesus, breathe Thy Pow‘r upon us
Fill us with the Holy Ghost.

And for Jesus we are waiting
Listening for the trumpet‘s sound
Then it will be us and Jesus
Living ever with our God.
stanzas.chorus:
Jesus only, Jesus ever
Jesus all in all we sing
Saviour; Sanctifier, Healer
Baptizer and coming King.

841.englishTitle: AROUND the throne of God in heaven

stanzas.text:
AROUND the throne of God in heaven
Thousands of Children stand
Children whose sins are (all) forgiven
A Holy Happy Band.

In flowing robes of spotless white
See every one array’d
Dwelling in everlasting light
And joy that never fade.

What brought them to that world above
That Heaven so right and fair
Where all is peace, and joy and love,
How came those children there.

Because the Saviour shed his blood
To wash away their sin
Bathed in that precious pure Blood
Behold them white and clean.

On earth they sought the Saviour’s Grace
On earth they love His Name
So now they see His blessed face
And stand before the Lamb.

God is that fountain flowing yet?
Bless‘d Saviour leads us there
That we those happy ones may meet
And in their praises share.

842.englishTitle: WE love all the earthly stock below

stanzas.text:
WE love all the earthly stock below
Cherished by lusty eyes
We love to tarry here on earth
Sav'ring It‘s deadly chills.

Why covet we in bitter chase
When sacred home exists
There shall no sin or evil found
No peril there abide.

O! what a lux‘y there abound
There, all our wish to know
The joy, the love and charity
Abundant!y is found.

The threat of death and deadly pangs
Here on earth not in heaven
The sacred saints in light array
ln sweet immortal praise.

The holy path of Christ to tread
Prepar'd abroad for us
Peaceful, blissful abode on high
The Sacred throne of God.

843.englishTitle: THIS is the day of light

stanzas.text:
THIS is the day of light
Let there be light today
O Day-spring, rise upon our night
And chase its gloom away.

This is the day of rest
Our failing strength renew
On weary brain and troubled breast
Shed Thou Thy freshening dew.

This is the day of peace
Thy peace our spirits fill
Bid Thou the blasts of discord cease
The waves of strife be still.

This is the day of pray'r
Let earth to heav’n draw near
Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there
Come down to meet us here.

This is the first of days
Send forth Thy quick’ning breath
And wake dead souls to love and praise
O Vanquisher of death!  Amen
PART 2
H.C 219 S.M (FE 831) S.M
"For a day in Thy court is better
than a thousand days” - Ps.94:10

WELCOME,  sweet day of rest
That saw the Lord arise
Welcome to this reviving breast
And these rejoicing eyes.

The King Himself comes near
And feasts His saints today
Here may we stay, and see Him here
And love, and praise and pray.

One day of pray’r and praise
His sacred courts within
Is sweeter than ten thousand days
In pleasure’ path of sin.

My willing soul would stay
In such a frame as this
And was to hail the brighter day
Of everlasting bliss.

844.englishTitle: I and all those of my household

stanzas.text:
l and all those of my household
Will worship and serve the Lord God
But I even I will
By my words and by my actions
Show that I know the God of heav'n
And serve Him truthfully.

I will create good example
And remove every obstacle
From the way of my ward
By my life, show them their duty
Yet, in my duty, to obtain
Honour that comes through love.

I’ll be easily entreated
And in wrath remember mercy
The Lord’s true disciple,
I also want to be holy
And bring my household and loved ones
Into the narrow way.

When Thou has put the flame of love
Within this chosen vessels heart
Receive it to Thyself;
Lord, do Thy goodwill within me
Help to show by my life how each
Bible Christian should live.

Grant to me, dear Lord, Thy good grace
Behold, I come to testify
Of Thy wonderful name
That sav’d my soul from perdition
And the grace that is felt within
Of which each tongue can speak.

I who have been set free from sin
Desire my household to be sav'd
I would tell of pardon
To my child, my wife and servants
To make them walk in the good way
To holy heaven bound.

845.englishTitle: YE Holy Saints where goest thou

stanzas.text:
YE Holy Saints where goest thou?
And clutching palm fronds in thine hand
We’re marching on our King to meet
As He hath promiseth to us.
stanzas.chorus:
We’re marching forth, to palace of
our King
Onto the promised land
Whereforth sinners can never dwell
Wherefoth there is eternal rest.

stanzas.text:
Ye sacred Saints to us inform
Of eternal joy there exists
Of the white robes and glorious crown
From Jesus Christ, to us attain.

We hath no dwelling abode here
Dreadful, if here be our abode
Joy at the dawn, weeping at dusk
But naught of this art found above.

Open ajar the door, ye Saints
For earthly Saints to enter in
We of the earth from woe and pains
Now here with Holy God to dwell.

Great multitude from all the world
With satan hath fought, vict’ry won
All adopted children of God
Come O! my friend, ere it’s too late.

The earthly terrain all of naught
With the Lord, come, invest to gain
The earthly friends art all but vain
Un-denying friend art the Lord.

The earth, its savour now is lost
The earthly value, all is dross
Come to the Lord, brethren decide
Eternal joy, all ye may earn.

Twenty and four heavenly beings
We earthly hosts, thy band belong
For the earth, its savour is lost
Heav’nly savour, may we partake.
stanzas.chorus:
We’re marching forth, to palace of
our King
Onto the promised land
Whereforth sinners can never dwell
Wherefoth there is eternal rest.

GRACE! tis a charming sound
Harmonoius to the ear
Heaven with the echo shall resound
And all the earth shall hear!
stanzas.chorus:
Saved by grace alone!
This is all my plea
Jesus died for all mankind
And Jesus died for me.

stanzas.text:
“Twas grace that wrote my name
In Thy eternal book
“Twas grace that gave me to the Lamb
Who all my sorrows took.

Grace taught my wand‘ring feet
To tread the heav’nly road
And new supplies-each hour I meet
While pressing up to God.

Grace taught my soul to pray
And made mine eyes o’er flow
“Twas grace which kept me to this day
Astray not let me go.

Oh, let Thy grace inspire
My soul with strength Divine!
May all my pow'rs to Thee aspire
And all my days be Thine.
stanzas.chorus:
Saved by grace alone!
This is all my plea
Jesus died for all mankind
And Jesus died for me.

stanzas.text:
l need Thee ev‘ry hour
Most gracious Lord
Not tender voice like Thine
Can peace afford.
stanzas.chorus:
I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee
Ev’ry hour I need Thee
Oh, bless me now, my Saviour
I come to Thee!

stanzas.text:
I need Thee every hour
Stay Thou near by
Temptations lose their power
When Thou art nigh.

I need Thee every hour
In joy or pain
Come quickly and abide
Or life is vain.

I need Thee every hour
Teach me Thy will
And Thy rich promises
In me fulfil.

I need Thee every hour
Most Holy One
Oh, make me Thine indeed
Thou blessed Son.
stanzas.chorus:
I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee

Oh, bless me now, my Saviour
I come to Thee!

GIVE glory to the Father
By whom we are made to live
He hears the prayers of youths
He listen to their Sweet Songs.

Give glory unto the Son
Jesus Christ Thou art our King
Come and sing aloud the song
Unto the Lamb of Sinners.

Glory be to Holy Ghost
Like the day of Pentecost
Stir up the souls of the youths
Fill their lips with holy songs.

Glory be to God on high
Three in one and One in Three
For the gospel of our Lord
And our God’s eternal love.

BLESS, Father, bless,
Thy worthy children this day
As we praise Thee for grace to us bestow’d
To us Thy Bounteous blessing daily given
Thy blessful fountain which will
never dry.
stanzas.chorus:
Oh! God of Abram! Oh! God of Light!
For Jesus sake, O! Lord
Hearken to our prayer.

stanzas.text:
Shower Thy blessings over all
of our members
All brothers and sisters in our Council,
Choristers and all workers of this Order,

Oh! God of Aaron! Oh! God of Light!

Quench not Thy Light for ever in this Order,

establish us for ever and evermore
Thou God of Zion, Oh! God of Light,

Bless all the friends and all of our relatives
Members and visitors from every plac,

their movements,
Bless every house with peace and
happiness
Jehovah Shalom Oh! God of Light

Guide Lord Oh! guide our
Country and our members

Provide good food for us throughout
all our life
Good raiment and good health to put it on;
Good house and peaceful living in all our days,
Let nothing suffer us in all our days
Jehovah Jireh, Oh! God of Light,
Bring peace and plentiness to us every day.

Cure, Father, cure the sick and all the feeble,
Bring up to wealth all poverty stricken
Let not hunger be known all amongst members
Close door to death and sicknesses in
our midst
Jehovah-Nissi, Oh! God of Light
Be scepter of vict’ry to us, Thy children.

Thy Grace has kept us living up to this day,
Let our salvation be for Thy Glory,
From death and sickness raging in our
Region, Jesus, protect us with Thy
Wing of Power.
Great God Jehovah! Oh! God of light!
Give us long life and usefulness all
our days.

Great Judgment day where angels
harvest mankind,
When all our deeds before Thee clearly stand,
Number, Oh! Lord our names among
the Righteous,
The Crown of Glory be our merits there
Great God Jehovah! oh! God of Light!
Crown all our efforts with
Thy e‘erlasting Grace.

stanzas.text:
ARISE now and shine the bright and
morning beam
Let Glory of God manifest in thee
The darkness of sin hath be-clouded the earth
Beauty of the belov’d hath manifest.
stanzas.chorus:
Come o! my friends, come and let's rejoice

Our Eternal Rock of Ages
Thine promises Lord fulfill.

The gentiles shall take refuge under
thine light
And all earthly kings shall bow unto Thee
Lift up your eyes and behold round
about thee
Render accounts of the star and blessings.

The sons of the strangers shall build
up thine walls
And their Kings shall minister unto thee
All thine exactors shall be rendered
to naught
Mockers shall be rendered mute forever.

The sun of thy grief shall ne'er

THE Keeper of all creation
Our Omnipotent God
With all our tongues and all our lips
Offer to Thee our praise.

The young and the old give Thee thanks
Thou protecteth us all
For Thine mercies and Thy blessings
On us from ages past.

Burst into joy, soliders of Christ
And to thee sacred Bands
For this anniversary, today
On the surface of earth.

Glorious in Holiness, we plead
Make us to all be Thine
May we not ever Thee reject
But ever worship Thee.

Be benevolent to us all

Divine Guide of all creations

Thine blessings may not satan snatch

Make us all worthy of Thy praise

stanzas.text:
ARE you weary, are you heavy hearted?

Tell Christ Jesus alone.
stanzas.chorus:

Tell Christ Jesus alone.

stanzas.text:
Do the tear flow down your
cheeks unbidden?

Tell Christ Jesus - 2ce

stanzas.text:
PROCLAIM His name abroad
Glorious hymn let us sing
God Omnipotent is our Lord
King of the universe.

Waters and seas He made
Gave He bank to the sea
All waters and rivers He own
And all the vast dry land.

Bow down before His throne
Come worship Christ the Lord
The handiwork of God we are
By His word we were made.

Hark His clarion call now
No not agrief His Spirit
Come as a be-lo-ved to Him
Confess the Lord thine God.

859.englishTitle: WHO are these like stars appearing

stanzas.text:
WHO are these like stars appearing
These before God’s throne who stand
Each a golden crown is wearing
Who are all this glorious band?
Hallelujah! hark they sing
Praising loud their heavenly King.

Who are these in dazzling brightness
Clothed in God's own righteousness
These, whose robes of purest whiteness
Shall their lustre still possess
Still untouch'd by time'es rude hand?
Whence come all this glorious hand?

These are they who have contended
For their Saviour honour long
Resting on till life was ended
Following not the sinful throng
Those, who well the fight sustained
Triumph by the Lamb have gained.

These are they whose heart were riven
Sore with woe and anguish tried
Who in pray’r full oft have striven
With the God they glorified
Now, their painful conflict o’er
God has bid them weep no more.

These are they who watch’d and waited
Offering up to Christ their will
Soul and body consecrated
Day and Night to serve Him still
Now in God’s most holy place
Blest they stand before His face.

860.englishTitle: SPIRIT of wisdom turn our eyes

stanzas.text:
SPIRIT of wisdom, turn our eyes
From earth and earthly vanities
To heav’nly truth and love
Spirit of understanding true
Our souls with heav’nly light endure
To seek the things above.

Spirit of counsel, be our Guide
Teach us, by earthly struggles tried
Our heavenly crown town
Spirit of fortitude, Thy pow’r
Be with us in temptation’s hour
To keep us pure from sin.

Spirit of knowledge, lead our feet
In Thine own paths, so safe and sweet
By angel footsteps trod
Where Thou our Guardian true shalt be
Spirit of gentle piety
To keep us close to God.

Through all our life be ever near
Spirit of God’s most holy fear
In our heart‘s inmost shrine
Our souls with awful reverence fill
To worship His most holy will
All‐righteous and divine.

So lead us, Lord, through peace ur strife,
Onward to everlasting Iife
To win our high reward
So may we fight our lifelong fight
Strong in Thine own unearthly might
And reign with Christ our Lord.

Wisdom and Direction
Wonderful Counsellor

Troubles make me o’ercome
Lead me on to Thine peace
Teach me to sing new hymns to Thee

Like Thee make me to be
Before my demise here
My feet establish firmly Lord
In Thine love make me grow.

Let me witness for Thee
When source of sin destroyed
Save my unblemished soul oh Lord
And make me heaven bound.

The great and Omnipotent God
Thou Egyptians destroyed
Ages past at the deep red sea
My foes destroy l plead.
stanzas.chorus:
Grant me victory oh Lord
Lest the foes me overcome
O'er my foes grant me Victory
Surmount all my problems Lord.

stanzas.text:
Jesus I call out to Thee Lord
Hearken Lord to my cry
Lord I plead thee for victory
Over seen, unseen fends.
stanzas.chorus:
Premature death cast away
Allay all my fears I plead
Lay my heart at rest oh Lord
Let all enemies retreat.

stanzas.text:
Christ Jesus the head of our Band
In Thee I lay my trust
Let me never be put to shame
Provide for all my needs.
stanzas.chorus:
God in Thee I seek refuge
Make my life fav’rable Lord
May wild surging, storms of life
Not befall me Lord I plead.

864.englishTitle: JESUS Thou my Lord my King

stanzas.text:
JESUS Thou my Lord my King
In Thee rest I all my trust
In this world none that I have
Beside Thee my Royal King
Thus vindicate me oh Lord
Vanquish‘d let all my foes be
Grant me joy and victory
Through my sojourn here on earth.

Give me Thine grace Lord I plead
Make me fit Thine own to be
Me un-equalled by my foes
Make my life rosy I plead
Thou who did for Queen Esther
Made her life rosy to her
Turn my life so rosy be
The plans of my foes abort.

Make me prevail Lord I plead
Thou prime of all pow’rs and strength
Impact of the foes to naught
Lord before Thine pow'r divine
Thus my Great God Creator
Subdue all my foes I plead
From my foes Thine rest me grant
From troubles I may prevail.

Thou art been from ages past
Thou art before creation
Thus my Christ Jesus Saviour
All Thine affections reveal
That may I thus experience
Thine glory Lord and Thine strength
That the world may thus behold
Thou art all encompassing power.

Encapsulate me with Thine grace
With Thine glory rne surround
Thine divine strength my refuge be
Thine name my refuge I plead
Thus far that Thine I may be
Shield me from all glare and snares
From the devil, me protect
My life with joy fill I plead.

When I in heaven appear
In Thine bossom let me be
By Thine right side let me be
On Thine reverred throne make me fit
Then my heart with joy be filled
In Thy glory eternal;
ln divine joy eternal
In unfadding grace Oh Lord.

HOLY Spirit, dead reviving
We bow down before Thine throne
Stretch forth Thine hand of life on us
All we multitude renew
Thou Son of Father incarnate
Prophet, priest and Saviour Lord.
stanzas.chorus:
Saviour divine, Saviour divine
Saviour divine, save our souls.

stanzas.text:
Band of Cherubim here on earth
Unite in one accord all
Band of Seraphim here on earth
Work in love and one accord
Be of help to us as we work
Lest we fail nor exhausted.

Work on in the name of Jesus
Discountenance the mockers
Book of Matthew the tenth chapter
Read the verse of ten and six
Descend now in Thine Majesty
Amidst Band of Seraphim.

Fellowship with us in goodwill
With Thine Word enlighten us
Thine divine lamp on us beaming
Oil it for us Lord we plead
When on us our foes are raging
Christ Jesus draw nigh to us.

When darkness shall pervade the sky
Terible things shall occur
All the stars above shall wither
Just like the torrential rain
Be not weary, fervently pray
Yea, all ye my beloved.

When cometh the latter-day now
When parental bond sever
Lest we be ashame Lord we plead
Save members of Seraphim
Inspire us Thine work to do
That we may the truth pursue.

Glory give to Father above
Glory unto His Son give
Give glory to Holy Spirit
Trinity we worship Thee
All our souls are thirsty for Thee
With divine manna us feed.
stanzas.chorus:
Saviour divine, Saviour divine
Saviour divine, save our souls.

stanzas.text:
PEACE perfect peace to Cherub
and Seraph
Establish'd for Christ's exultation here.

Peace Perfect peace to all the
true members
Of universal Cherub, Seraphim.

Peace perfect peace to all with
faith in Christ
Bear His  witness till death their
lives demand.

Peace perfect peace to all with
faith in Christ
Bear poverty tlnroughout their
days on earth.

in Christ

in Christ

of this Band

Let He who sought the downfall
of this band
Be made to know it's hard to kick
the thorns.

When the world and its glory pass away

867.englishTitle: HOLY Saviour Holy Saviour is Father

stanzas.text:
HOLY Saviour, Holy Saviour is Father
Holy Saviour, Holy Saviour is the Son

Holy Saviour is the Trinity.

The protector, the protector’s Father
The protector, the protector is the Son
The protector is the Holy Ghost
The protector is the Trinity.

The provider, the provider is Father
The provider, the provider is the Son
The provider is the Holy Ghost
The provider is the Trinity.

The physician, the physician is Father
The physician, the physician is the Son
The physician is the Holy Ghost
The physician is the Trinity.

Divine Healer, Divine Healer is Father
Divine Healer, Divine Healer is the Son
Divine Healer is the Holy Ghost
Divine Healer is the Trinity.

The conqueror, the conqueror‘s is Father

The conqueror is the Trinity.

The way paver, the way paver‘s the Father
The way paver, the way paver’s the Son

The way paver is the Trinity.

Clap up your hand clap your hand for the Father

868.englishTitle: GOD I have as caring Father

stanzas.text:
GOD I have as caring Father
I am nay not afrightened
Ever how hard the foes may rage
Jesus shall e’er dominate
He’s our faithful and honest friend
Me He will not ever forsake
How ever the tempest may rage
He’ll safely lead me ashore.

Rain may fall and the sun may scorch
Earth may quake, mountains may move
The thunder may roar, fire blaze
Jesu I’ll never betray
He’s the Saviour of the whole world
Many are of this oblivious
He shall all of us ressurrect
At the end, the judgement day.

I am rest assured here on earth
For God I have as Father
Not a woe, me to experience
By the blood of Christ His Son
Here I come unto the fountain
Cleanse me oh my Saviour I plead
Let me never wander away
Draw me gently unto Thee.

Make me steadfast oh Lord I plead
Aboard the Seraphim ark
Let not by insane lunatic
My toillings to be destroyed
God of Saint Orimolade
Who established Seraphim Band
Oh! I bow down and worship Thee
Let my prayers ascend to Thee.

869.englishTitle: LET us give praises unto God

stanzas.text:

870.englishTitle: A Band of life is Seraph Band

stanzas.text:
A Band of life is Seraph Band
A prayerful Band it is
A Band whose trust is not on Roots
A Band whose trust is not on Leaf
Our Jesus Christ Our only Light
Who cures and bless us all.

Be faithful to the end Cherub Seraph
Be active at the work of God
Not with the hope of wordly gain
Don't care about this world’s mockery
To gain the crown of Gold.

Jesus the Lord of Seraphim
Help us that we may not loose in thee
That day of judgement of the world
When all the face of world shall meet
Holy Messiah our glorious King
Let us have space with thee.

HOW amiable is thy tabernacle?
Lord of host
My soul doth faint for court above
For the sparrow pertcheth on the
tree here below
And the swallow nest for herself.
stanzas.chorus:
But blessings be to members
of Band of Seraphim
We inhabit abode of joy with
the Lord Jesus
Blessings we plead, Halleluyah
Blessing we plead, blessings
we plead
Halleluyah, blessing we plead.

stanzas.text:
My soul longeth for sacred abode
high above
To the court of our sacred King
I shall go forth from strength unto
strength for ever
Till I’ll and at the glorious shore.

One day in Thy holy court above,
yes oh Lord
Is better than a thousand days
Divine grace and divine blessings be
Thine oh God
Blessing, His worshippers shall gain.

Holy sacred is our Holy God, Almigthy
Angels, come! let us worship Him
Those who all worship the sacred God,
to the end
Shall earn golden crown at the shore.
stanzas.chorus:
But blessings be to members
of Band of Seraphim
We inhabit abode of joy with
the Lord Jesus
Blessings we plead, Halleluyah
Blessing we plead, blessings
we plead

872.englishTitle: LET us be glad in Jesus Christ

stanzas.text:
Let us be glad in Jesus Christ
Jesus the custodian of joy
whosoever hath receivelh His joy
Sadness and grief shall flee away.

Just believe in His sacred name
Wholly trust and lean on Him
And Savour the sweetness in
His pure blood
Sadness and grief shall flee away.

Cherubim and ye Seraphim
Still art thou in mourning mood
Christ Jesus bid thee shout Halleluyah
Sadness and grief shall flee away.

Art thou by satan afrightened
Witches or be it wizards
Often call on the name of Jesus Christ
Sadness and grief shall flee away.

Let‘s share love with all and sundry
Not within brethren alone
Thence thine prayers will ascend there above
Sadness and grief shall flee away.

All ye who dwellest on earth
Worship the name of Jesus
His name art the balm to soothe thy sadness
Sadness and grief shall flee away.

Be mindful that He’s Wonderful
King and Counsellor divine
Almighty and Omnipotent Father
Majesty Royal Prince of Peace.

Glory we give to Father God
Glory we give to His Son
Glory be to Holy Spirit our zeal
Triune God all our thanks accept.

873.englishTitle: WHEN upon life‘s billows you are

stanzas.text:
WHEN upon life‘s billows you are
tempest tost
When you are discouraged,
thinking all is lost
Count your many blessings,
name them one by one
And it will surprise you what
the Lord hath done.
stanzas.chorus:
Count your blessings name
them one by one
Count your blessings see
what God hath done
Count your blessings name
them one by one
And it will surprise you what
the Lord hath done.

stanzas.text:
Are you ever burdened with a load of care
Does the cross seem heavy you are
called to bear
Count your many blessings every
doubt will fly
And you will keep singing as the
days go by.

When you look at others with their
lands and gold
Think that Christ has promised you
His wealth untold
Count your many blessings wealth
can never buy
Your reward in heaven, nor your home
on high.

So amid the conflict, whether great or small
Do not be disheartened God is over all
Count your many blessings Angels will attend
Help and comfort give you to your
journey‘s end.
stanzas.chorus:
Count your blessings name
them one by one

Count your blessings name

ascends on high.

WE worship Thee, Halleluyah

stanzas.text:
Awake! Awake! All ye faithfuls
Hark, Seraphim proclaim
The infidels wrouht “miracles”
And the faithfuls despise.

Many are sins that all abound
But the worst of them all
Sins committed ‘gainst Holy Ghost
Not ever forgiven.

Many are tribulations here
But the worst of them all
Financial abysmal, ill health
Jesus conquer for us.

Ain’t no reward here reap on earth
For members of Seraph
Who ever work enduringly
Shall at last gain a crown.

All Prayerist be not weary
Visioners, wardens, all
Amidst the foes, all ye abide
Victory shall Father give.

Ye wretched and all ye sicklers
Nay discouraged nor sad
Great provider, the Great Healer
Shall never, thee forsake.

Glory be to Father above
Glory be to the Son
Glory be unto Holy Ghost
